+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridKey } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import {
+  applyChanges,
+  freshRow,
+  mergeChange,
+  overlayRows,
+  rowDiff,
+  savingChanges,
+  trimChange,
+  withPinned,
+} from './edit';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from './flatten';
+import type { PendingChange } from './edit';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  qty: number;
+  price: number;
+  placed: string;
+  at: number;
+  note?: string;
+}
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id' },
+  { field: 'customer' },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' },
+  { id: 'total', dataType: 'number', value: (row) => row.qty * row.price },
+];
+const resolved = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+});
+
+const SAVED: Order = {
+  id: 'DH-1',
+  customer: 'An',
+  qty: 2,
+  price: 10,
+  placed: '2026-11-01',
+  at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1, 8),
+};
+const OTHER: Order = { ...SAVED, id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Bình' };
+const ROWS: readonly Order[] = [SAVED, OTHER, { ...SAVED, id: 'DH-3' }];
+const rowKey = (row: Order) => row.id;
+
+type Change = PendingChange<Order>;
+const update = (data: Partial<Order>, row = SAVED, key: DataGridKey = row.id): Change => ({
+  type: 'update',
+  key,
+  data,
+  row,
+});
+const remove = (row = SAVED, data?: Partial<Order>): Change =>
+  data ? { type: 'remove', key: row.id, row, data } : { type: 'remove', key: row.id, row };
+const insert = (data: Partial<Order>, key = 'flg-new-1'): Change => ({ type: 'insert', key, data });
+const mapOf = (...changes: Change[]) => new Map(changes.map((change) => [change.key, change]));
+
+describe('mergeChange', () => {
+  it('gives the change itself when there was none before, and nothing for an undo of nothing', () => {
+    const change = update({ qty: 3 });
+    expect(mergeChange(undefined, change)).toBe(change);
+    expect(mergeChange(undefined, { type: 'undo' })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('merges the data of an update over an update, and keeps the row it was first made on', () => {
+    const first = update({ qty: 3, customer: 'Chi' });
+    const second = update({ qty: 4 }, { ...SAVED, qty: 3 });
+    const merged = mergeChange(first, second);
+    expect(merged).toEqual({
+      type: 'update',
+      key: 'DH-1',
+      data: { qty: 4, customer: 'Chi' },
+      row: SAVED,
+    });
+    expect(first.data).toEqual({ qty: 3, customer: 'Chi' });
+  });
+
+  it('keeps an insert an insert when it is updated, with the data merged', () => {
+    const merged = mergeChange(insert({ customer: 'Dũng' }), {
+      type: 'update',
+      key: 'flg-new-1',
+      data: { qty: 5 },
+      row: {} as Order,
+    });
+    expect(merged).toEqual({
+      type: 'insert',
+      key: 'flg-new-1',
+      data: { customer: 'Dũng', qty: 5 },
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('forgets a row that was inserted and then removed: it was never saved', () => {
+    expect(
+      mergeChange(insert({ customer: 'Dũng' }), remove({ ...SAVED, id: 'flg-new-1' })),
+    ).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('makes a remove of an update that keeps its data, for an undo to restore', () => {
+    const merged = mergeChange(update({ qty: 3 }), remove());
+    expect(merged).toEqual({ type: 'remove', key: 'DH-1', row: SAVED, data: { qty: 3 } });
+  });
+
+  it('makes an undo of a remove the update it kept, or nothing when it kept none', () => {
+    expect(mergeChange(remove(), { type: 'undo' })).toBeNull();
+    expect(mergeChange(remove(SAVED, { qty: 3 }), { type: 'undo' })).toEqual({
+      type: 'update',
+      key: 'DH-1',
+      data: { qty: 3 },
+      row: SAVED,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('leaves a remove removed when it is removed again, and merges an update made on it into its data', () => {
+    const removed = remove(SAVED, { qty: 3 });
+    expect(mergeChange(removed, remove())).toEqual(removed);
+    expect(mergeChange(removed, update({ customer: 'Chi' }))).toEqual({
+      type: 'remove',
+      key: 'DH-1',
+      row: SAVED,
+      data: { qty: 3, customer: 'Chi' },
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('leaves an update or an insert as it was when an undo comes to it', () => {
+    const changed = update({ qty: 3 });
+    expect(mergeChange(changed, { type: 'undo' })).toBe(changed);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('rowDiff', () => {
+  it('gives the fields of the data that differ from the saved row, and {} when none do', () => {
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { customer: 'An', qty: 3, price: 10 }, resolved)).toEqual({ qty: 3 });
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { customer: 'An', qty: 2 }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, {}, resolved)).toEqual({});
+  });
+
+  it('takes two blanks for equal: null, undefined, an empty text and NaN', () => {
+    const blank = { ...SAVED, note: '' };
+    expect(rowDiff(blank, { note: undefined }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff(blank, { note: null as never }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff({ ...SAVED, qty: Number.NaN }, { qty: undefined }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff(blank, { note: 'x' }, resolved)).toEqual({ note: 'x' });
+    // A blank against a value is a change, whichever side holds the value.
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { note: '' }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff({ ...SAVED, note: 'x' }, { note: '' }, resolved)).toEqual({ note: '' });
+  });
+
+  it('compares a date by its ISO day, a Date or a string alike', () => {
+    const midnight = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1));
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { placed: midnight as never }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(
+      rowDiff({ ...SAVED, placed: midnight as never }, { placed: '2026-11-01' }, resolved),
+    ).toEqual({});
+    const nextDay = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2));
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { placed: nextDay as never }, resolved)).toEqual({ placed: nextDay });
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { placed: '2026-11-02' }, resolved)).toEqual({ placed: '2026-11-02' });
+  });
+
+  it('compares a datetime by its instant', () => {
+    const same = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1, 8));
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { at: same as never }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    const later = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1, 9));
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { at: later as never }, resolved)).toEqual({ at: later });
+  });
+
+  it('compares anything else with Object.is, and a Date that no column reads by its instant', () => {
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { price: 10 }, resolved)).toEqual({});
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { price: 11 }, resolved)).toEqual({ price: 11 });
+    const stamp = new Date(5);
+    expect(
+      rowDiff({ ...SAVED, note: stamp as never }, { note: new Date(5) as never }, resolved),
+    ).toEqual({});
+  });
+
+  it('is not fooled by a field the data names that the saved row has not', () => {
+    expect(rowDiff(SAVED, { note: 'new' }, resolved)).toEqual({ note: 'new' });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('trimChange', () => {
+  it('drops an update that changes nothing, and cuts the others down to what they change', () => {
+    expect(trimChange(update({ qty: 2, customer: 'An' }), resolved)).toBeNull();
+    expect(trimChange(update({ qty: 2, customer: 'Chi' }), resolved)).toEqual(
+      update({ customer: 'Chi' }),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('leaves an insert and a remove as they are', () => {
+    const added = insert({ qty: 1 });
+    const removed = remove(SAVED, { qty: 3 });
+    expect(trimChange(added, resolved)).toBe(added);
+    expect(trimChange(removed, resolved)).toBe(removed);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('applyChanges', () => {
+  describe('with no change', () => {
+    it('gives the same object every time, which shows every row as it is', () => {
+      const first = applyChanges(ROWS, new Map(), rowKey);
+      expect(applyChanges(ROWS, new Map(), rowKey)).toBe(first);
+      expect(first.shown(SAVED, 'DH-1')).toBe(SAVED);
+      expect(first.view(SAVED)).toBe(SAVED);
+      expect(first.pinned.size).toBe(0);
+      expect(first.deleted.size).toBe(0);
+      expect(first.added).toEqual([]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('a changed row', () => {
+    it('is shown as one new object with the fields of the change over it', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 5 })), rowKey);
+      const row = shown.shown(SAVED, 'DH-1');
+      expect(row).toEqual({ ...SAVED, qty: 5 });
+      expect(row).not.toBe(SAVED);
+      expect(SAVED.qty).toBe(2);
+      // Every other row is the object it was.
+      expect(shown.shown(OTHER, 'DH-2')).toBe(OTHER);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the identity of the shown row until its change changes', () => {
+      const change = update({ qty: 5 });
+      const first = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1');
+      expect(applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1')).toBe(first);
+      // Another change on another row leaves it alone.
+      expect(
+        applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change, update({ qty: 1 }, OTHER)), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1'),
+      ).toBe(first);
+      const merged = mergeChange(change, update({ customer: 'Chi' }))!;
+      expect(applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(merged), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1')).not.toBe(first);
+    });
+
+    it('is shown anew when the row of the data is, and keeps the change over it', () => {
+      const change = update({ qty: 5 });
+      const first = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1');
+      const edited = { ...SAVED, customer: 'Server' };
+      const again = applyChanges([edited, OTHER], mapOf(change), rowKey).shown(edited, 'DH-1');
+      expect(again).toEqual({ ...edited, qty: 5 });
+      expect(again).not.toBe(first);
+    });
+
+    it('shows a computed column from the shown fields', () => {
+      const row = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 5 })), rowKey).shown(SAVED, 'DH-1');
+      expect(resolved[5]!.value(row)).toBe(50);
+    });
+
+    it('is pinned, with the rows of the data that have its key', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 5 }), remove(OTHER)), rowKey);
+      expect([...shown.pinned]).toEqual(['DH-1', 'DH-2']);
+      expect([...shown.pinnedRows]).toEqual([SAVED, OTHER]);
+    });
+
+    it('is pinned with the keys the caller adds, the row being edited', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 5 })), rowKey, ['DH-3', 'DH-9']);
+      expect([...shown.pinned].sort()).toEqual(['DH-1', 'DH-3', 'DH-9']);
+      // A key that is no row of the data pins no row.
+      expect([...shown.pinnedRows]).toEqual([SAVED, ROWS[2]]);
+      // And with no change at all, a key to pin is still a result of its own.
+      const editing = applyChanges(ROWS, new Map(), rowKey, ['DH-2']);
+      expect([...editing.pinned]).toEqual(['DH-2']);
+      expect(editing.shown(OTHER, 'DH-2')).toBe(OTHER);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('a removed row', () => {
+    it('is in deleted and pinned, and shown as it is unless it keeps data', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(remove(OTHER)), rowKey);
+      expect([...shown.deleted]).toEqual(['DH-2']);
+      expect(shown.shown(OTHER, 'DH-2')).toBe(OTHER);
+      const kept = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(remove(SAVED, { qty: 9 })), rowKey);
+      expect(kept.shown(SAVED, 'DH-1')).toEqual({ ...SAVED, qty: 9 });
+    });
+
+    it('is no row to a reader of values for a total', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(remove(OTHER), update({ qty: 5 })), rowKey);
+      expect(shown.view(OTHER)).toBeNull();
+      expect(shown.view(SAVED)).toEqual({ ...SAVED, qty: 5 });
+      expect(shown.view(ROWS[2]!)).toBe(ROWS[2]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('an inserted row', () => {
+    it('is added as a row of its data with its key, in the order the changes were made', () => {
+      const shown = applyChanges(
+        ROWS,
+        mapOf(insert({ customer: 'Dũng' }, 'flg-new-2'), update({ qty: 5 }), insert({ qty: 1 })),
+        rowKey,
+      );
+      expect(shown.added).toEqual([
+        { key: 'flg-new-2', row: { customer: 'Dũng' } },
+        { key: 'flg-new-1', row: { qty: 1 } },
+      ]);
+      expect(shown.pinned.has('flg-new-2')).toBe(true);
+      expect(shown.deleted.size).toBe(0);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the identity of its row until its data changes', () => {
+      const change = insert({ customer: 'Dũng' });
+      const first = applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey).added[0]!.row;
+      expect(applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey).added[0]!.row).toBe(first);
+      const merged = mergeChange(change, update({ qty: 5 }, {} as Order, 'flg-new-1'))!;
+      expect(applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(merged), rowKey).added[0]!.row).not.toBe(first);
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('savingChanges', () => {
+  it('gives one change for each row, in the order they were first made', () => {
+    const changes = mapOf(
+      insert({ customer: 'Dũng', qty: 1 }),
+      update({ qty: 5, customer: 'An' }),
+      remove(OTHER),
+    );
+    expect(savingChanges(changes, resolved)).toEqual([
+      { type: 'insert', key: 'flg-new-1', data: { customer: 'Dũng', qty: 1 } },
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { qty: 5 }, row: SAVED },
+      { type: 'remove', key: 'DH-2', row: OTHER },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('does not send an update that changes nothing, nor the data a remove kept', () => {
+    const changes = mapOf(update({ qty: 2 }), remove(OTHER, { qty: 9 }));
+    expect(savingChanges(changes, resolved)).toEqual([{ type: 'remove', key: 'DH-2', row: OTHER }]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for no changes', () => {
+    expect(savingChanges(new Map(), resolved)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('withPinned', () => {
+  it('gives back what the step kept when it kept every pinned row, or none is pinned', () => {
+    const kept = [ROWS[0]!];
+    expect(withPinned(ROWS, kept, new Set())).toBe(kept);
+    expect(withPinned(ROWS, kept, new Set([ROWS[0]!]))).toBe(kept);
+    expect(withPinned(ROWS, ROWS, new Set([ROWS[1]!]))).toBe(ROWS);
+  });
+
+  it('adds the pinned rows the step dropped, in the order of the source', () => {
+    const kept = [ROWS[2]!];
+    expect(withPinned(ROWS, kept, new Set([ROWS[1]!, ROWS[0]!]))).toEqual([
+      ROWS[0],
+      ROWS[1],
+      ROWS[2],
+    ]);
+    // A pinned row that is not in the source is not added.
+    expect(withPinned(ROWS, kept, new Set([{ ...SAVED, id: 'gone' }]))).toBe(kept);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('overlayRows', () => {
+  const keyed = ROWS.map((row): FlatDataRow<Order> => ({
+    kind: 'data',
+    key: row.id,
+    row,
+    level: 1,
+    groups: [],
+    setsize: 0,
+    posinset: 0,
+  }));
+
+  it('is the list itself without changes, and when no pinned row is shown otherwise', () => {
+    expect(overlayRows(keyed, null, undefined)).toBe(keyed);
+    expect(overlayRows(keyed, applyChanges(ROWS, new Map(), rowKey, ['DH-2']), undefined)).toBe(
+      keyed,
+    );
+    expect(overlayRows(keyed, applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(remove(OTHER)), rowKey), undefined)).toBe(
+      keyed,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('shows each changed row as a new flat row with the shown row, and leaves the others as they are', () => {
+    const list = overlayRows(
+      keyed,
+      applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 5 })), rowKey),
+      undefined,
+    );
+    expect(list).not.toBe(keyed);
+    expect(list[0]).toMatchObject({ key: 'DH-1', row: { qty: 5 } });
+    expect(list[1]).toBe(keyed[1]);
+    expect(list[2]).toBe(keyed[2]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the flat row of a change while its shown row is the same, and the list it made before', () => {
+    const change = update({ qty: 5 });
+    const first = overlayRows(keyed, applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey), undefined);
+    const again = overlayRows(keyed, applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(change), rowKey), first);
+    expect(again).toBe(first);
+    const other = overlayRows(keyed, applyChanges(ROWS, mapOf(update({ qty: 6 })), rowKey), first);
+    expect(other[0]).not.toBe(first[0]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('freshRow', () => {
+  it('makes a data row of a new row: added, at level 1, in no group, the same object for the same row', () => {
+    const added = { key: 'flg-new-1', row: { customer: 'Dũng' } as Order };
+    const flat = freshRow(added);
+    expect(flat).toEqual({
+      kind: 'data',
+      key: 'flg-new-1',
+      row: added.row,
+      level: 1,
+      groups: [],
+      setsize: 0,
+      posinset: 0,
+      added: true,
+    });
+    expect(freshRow({ ...added })).toBe(flat);
+    expect(freshRow({ key: 'flg-new-2', row: added.row })).not.toBe(flat);
+  });
+});

+});
+
+describe('flattenTree with new rows', () => {
+  const plain = flattenRows(ROWS, (row) => row.id) as FlatDataRow<Order>[];
+  const added = [fresh('flg-new-1'), fresh('flg-new-2')];
+
+  it('puts them before the list by default and after it with newRowPosition last', () => {
+    expect(outline(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added }))).toEqual([
+      'd1:flg-new-1',
+      'd1:flg-new-2',
+      'd1:a',
+      'd1:b',
+      'd1:c',
+      'd1:d',
+      'd1:e',
+    ]);
+    expect(
+      outline(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added, newRowPosition: 'last' })).slice(-3),
+    ).toEqual(['d1:e', 'd1:flg-new-1', 'd1:flg-new-2']);
+  });
+
+  it('stands outside every group, at level 1, before the first group row or after the last row', () => {
+    const tree = treeOf(STATUS_THEN_ASSIGNEE);
+    const first = flatten(tree, { added: [added[0]!] });
+    expect(first[0]).toBe(added[0]);
+    expect(first[0]).toMatchObject({ level: 1, groups: [], added: true });
+    expect(first[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'group', level: 1 });
+    const last = flatten(tree, { added: [added[0]!], newRowPosition: 'last' });
+    expect(last.at(-1)).toBe(added[0]);
+    expect(last.at(-2)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'data', key: 'd' });
+  });
+
+  it('puts a detail row of an open saved row where it was, and none for a new row', () => {
+    const flat = flatten(null, {
+      keyed: plain,
+      added,
+      detail: true,
+      expandedRows: new Set(['a', 'flg-new-1']),
+    });
+    expect(outline(flat)).toEqual([
+      'd1:flg-new-1',
+      'd1:flg-new-2',
+      'd1:a',
+      'x:a',
+      'd1:b',
+      'd1:c',
+      'd1:d',
+      'd1:e',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('puts the form row of a new row in its place among the new rows, marked added', () => {
+    const flat = flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added, form: { key: 'flg-new-2', added: true } });
+    expect(flat[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'form', key: 'flg-new-2', added: true, level: 1 });
+    expect(flat[1]!.kind === 'form' && flat[1]!.row).toBe(added[1]!.row);
+    expect(flat[0]).toBe(added[0]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives back the list it made before when the new rows are the same objects', () => {
+    const first = flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added });
+    expect(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added: [...added], previous: first })).toBe(first);
+    expect(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added: [added[0]!], previous: first })).not.toBe(first);
+  });
+
+  it('is the keyed rows themselves when there are no new rows, no form and nothing to add', () => {
+    expect(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, added: [] })).toBe(plain);
+  });
+});

+// The targets of spec 3.5 for the steps editing adds, on the same 10 000 rows: the rows over the saved ones
+// (step 2) with 200 changes, the whole pipeline from step 2 for a committed change, and the validation of
+// 100 changed rows. Proposed by the plan: the same 3 times of slack, medians of 5 and the cold run logged.
+const CHANGES_TARGET_MS = 5;
+const COMMIT_TARGET_MS = 5;
+const VALIDATE_TARGET_MS = 5;
+
+describe('performance of editing on 10 000 rows by 9 columns', () => {
+  const orders = makeOrders(10_000);
+  const columns = resolveColumns(
+    COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+      column.field === 'customer'
+        ? { ...column, validationRules: [{ type: 'required' as const }] }
+        : column.field === 'qty'
+          ? {
+              ...column,
+              validationRules: [
+                { type: 'required' as const },
+                { type: 'range' as const, min: 1, max: 20 },
+              ],
+            }
+          : column.field === 'placed'
+            ? {
+                ...column,
+                validationRules: [{ type: 'range' as const, min: '2026-01-01', max: '2026-12-31' }],
+              }
+            : column,
+    ),
+    OPTIONS,
+  );
+  const getKey = (row: Order) => row.id;
+  const read = createTextCache<Order>();
+
+  // 200 updates spread over the rows, each of a new `data` object when `round` changes.
+  const updates = (round: number): Map<string, PendingChange<Order>> =>
+    new Map(
+      Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, index): [string, PendingChange<Order>] => {
+        const row = orders[index * 50]!;
+        return [row.id, { type: 'update', key: row.id, row, data: { qty: round + index } }];
+      }),
+    );
+
+  it('puts 200 changes over 10 000 rows, and reads them back as shown rows', () => {
+    let round = 0;
+    const run = () => applyChanges(orders, updates(round++), getKey);
+    const cold = time(run);
+    const shown = run();
+    expect(shown.pinned.size).toBe(200);
+    expect(shown.pinnedRows.size).toBe(200);
+    expect(shown.shown(orders[0]!, orders[0]!.id).qty).toBe(round - 1);
+    const ms = median(run);
+    console.log(
+      `applyChanges, 200 changes over 10 000 rows: cold ${cold.toFixed(1)} ms, median of ${RUNS} runs ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms (target ${CHANGES_TARGET_MS} ms)`,
+    );
+    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(CHANGES_TARGET_MS * SLACK);
+  });
+
+  it('runs the pipeline from step 2 for a committed change: the changes and the steps that read them', () => {
+    const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+    const filter: DataGridFilter = { search: 'minh' };
+    let round = 0;
+    const run = () =>
+      pipeline.run({
+        data: orders,
+        columns,
+        getKey,
+        sort: [{ field: 'total', direction: 'desc' }],
+        page: { index: 3, size: 100 },
+        remote: false,
+        totalCount: undefined,
+        locale: 'vi-VN',
+        filter,
+        filterColumns: columns,
+        read,
+        grouping: [],
+        groupColumns: columns,
+        summary: {
+          total: resolveSummaryItems([{ column: 'total', type: 'sum' }], columns).items,
+          group: [],
+        },
+        expanded: { allExpanded: true, except: [] },
+        expandedRows: [],
+        hasDetail: undefined,
+        changes: applyChanges(orders, updates(round++), getKey),
+        newRowPosition: 'first',
+        form: null,
+      });
+    // The first run sorts and searches; the runs after it are commits of the same 200 rows.
+    const first = run();
+    expect(first.rows.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    const cold = time(run);
+    const ms = median(run);
+    console.log(
+      `pipeline from step 2, a commit over 200 changed rows (search, sort, total, page): cold ${cold.toFixed(1)} ms, median of ${RUNS} runs ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms (target ${COMMIT_TARGET_MS} ms)`,
+    );
+    expect(run().rows).toBe(first.rows);
+    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(COMMIT_TARGET_MS * SLACK);
+  });
+
+  it('validates 100 changed rows by 9 columns', () => {
+    const labels = mergeLabels(undefined);
+    const rows = orders
+      .slice(0, 100)
+      .map((row, index) => ({ ...row, qty: index % 3 === 0 ? 0 : row.qty }));
+    const run = () => rows.map((row) => validateRow(row, columns, labels));
+    const cold = time(run);
+    const errors = run();
+    expect(errors.filter((one) => one.size > 0)).toHaveLength(34);
+    const ms = median(run);
+    console.log(
+      `validateRow, 100 rows by 9 columns: cold ${cold.toFixed(1)} ms, median of ${RUNS} runs ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms (target ${VALIDATE_TARGET_MS} ms)`,
+    );
+    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(VALIDATE_TARGET_MS * SLACK);
+  });
+});

+
+    it('puts the new rows outside the groups, at level 1, first or last, and out of the keyed rows', () => {
+      const changes = changesOf(insert({ qty: 5 }, 'flg-new-1'), insert({ qty: 6 }, 'flg-new-2'));
+      const first = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, changes, newRowPosition: 'first' }),
+      );
+      expect(first.flat.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([
+        expect.objectContaining({
+          kind: 'data',
+          key: 'flg-new-1',
+          added: true,
+          level: 1,
+          groups: [],
+        }),
+        expect.objectContaining({
+          kind: 'data',
+          key: 'flg-new-2',
+          added: true,
+          level: 1,
+          groups: [],
+        }),
+      ]);
+      expect(first.flat[2]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'group', level: 1 });
+      expect(first.flat[0]).toMatchObject({ row: { qty: 5 } });
+      expect(first.keyed).toHaveLength(30);
+      const last = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, changes, newRowPosition: 'last' }),
+      );
+      expect(keys(last.flat.slice(-2))).toEqual(['flg-new-1', 'flg-new-2']);
+      expect(last.flat).toHaveLength(first.flat.length);
+    });
+
+    it('does not count the new rows: the pager, the pages and the total are the saved rows', () => {
+      const changes = changesOf(insert({ qty: 5 }), insert({ qty: 6 }, 'flg-new-2'));
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ changes, page: { index: 0, size: 10 } }));
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(result.pageCount).toBe(3);
+      expect(result.flat).toHaveLength(32);
+    });
+
+    it('draws the new rows at the top of every page, and at the bottom with newRowPosition last', () => {
+      const changes = changesOf(insert({ qty: 5 }), insert({ qty: 6 }, 'flg-new-2'));
+      for (const index of [0, 1, 2]) {
+        const page = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ changes, page: { index, size: 10 } }));
+        expect(keys(page.visible.slice(0, 2))).toEqual(['flg-new-1', 'flg-new-2']);
+        expect(page.visible).toHaveLength(12);
+        expect(page.visible[2]).toMatchObject({ key: `DH-${index * 10 + 1}` });
+      }
+      const last = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ changes, newRowPosition: 'last', page: { index: 1, size: 10 } }),
+      );
+      expect(keys(last.visible.slice(-2))).toEqual(['flg-new-1', 'flg-new-2']);
+      expect(last.visible[0]).toMatchObject({ key: 'DH-11' });
+    });
+
+    it('keeps a pending delete in the list, and counts it as a row of the page', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ changes: changesOf(remove('DH-2')) }));
+      expect(keys(result.flat)).toContain('DH-2');
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+    });
+
+    describe('the totals', () => {
+      const base = DATA.reduce((n, one) => n + one.qty, 0);
+
+      it('read the shown values, over the rows after the filter and the new rows, without the deleted', () => {
+        // DH-1 is 0 and shown as 100, DH-2 is 7 and deleted, a new row of 5.
+        const changes = changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 100 }), remove('DH-2'), insert({ qty: 5 }));
+        const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ summary: summary(sumQty), changes }));
+        expect(result.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(base + 100 - 7 + 5);
+        const counted = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+          input({ summary: summary([{ column: 'id', type: 'count' }]), changes }),
+        );
+        expect(counted.totals!.get('count:id')!.value).toBe(30 - 1 + 1);
+      });
+
+      it('of a group read the shown values without the deleted, over the rows the group holds by their saved values', () => {
+        const changes = changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 100 }), remove('DH-2'));
+        const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+          input({ grouping: byQty, summary: summary([], sumQty), changes }),
+        );
+        const zero = result.tree!.find((node) => node.value === 0)!;
+        const zeroRows = DATA.filter((one) => one.qty === 0);
+        expect(zero.rows).toEqual(zeroRows);
+        expect(zero.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(100);
+        const seven = result.tree!.find((node) => node.value === 7)!;
+        const sevenRows = DATA.filter((one) => one.qty === 7);
+        expect(seven.rows).toHaveLength(sevenRows.length);
+        expect(seven.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe((sevenRows.length - 1) * 7);
+      });
+    });
+
+    it('stands a form row in the place of its row, counted as that row, and one for a new row not counted', () => {
+      const open = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ form: { key: 'DH-3', added: false } }));
+      expect(open.flat[2]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'form', key: 'DH-3', added: false, level: 1 });
+      expect(open.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(open.keyed).toHaveLength(30);
+      const fresh = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          changes: changesOf(insert({ qty: 5 })),
+          form: { key: 'flg-new-1', added: true },
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(fresh.flat[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'form', key: 'flg-new-1', added: true });
+      expect(fresh.total).toBe(30);
+    });
+
+    it('shows the changes of the row whose form is open in its form row', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-3', { qty: 77 })),
+          form: { key: 'DH-3', added: false },
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(result.flat[2]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'form', row: { id: 'DH-3', qty: 77 } });
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('server mode', () => {
+    it('applies the changes to the page, and puts the new rows at its top or bottom', () => {
+      const changes = changesOf(update('DH-4', { qty: 99 }), insert({ qty: 5 }));
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          remote: true,
+          totalCount: 90,
+          page: { index: 0, size: 30 },
+          sort: qtyAsc,
+          filter: { search: 'zzz' },
+          changes,
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(sorts).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(searches).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(result.visible).toHaveLength(31);
+      expect(result.visible[0]).toMatchObject({ key: 'flg-new-1', added: true });
+      expect(result.visible.find((one) => one.key === 'DH-4')).toMatchObject({ row: { qty: 99 } });
+      expect(result.total).toBe(90);
+      const last = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ remote: true, totalCount: 90, changes, newRowPosition: 'last' }),
+      );
+      expect(last.visible.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ key: 'flg-new-1' });
+      expect(last.totals).toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('what it remembers', () => {
+    it('runs no step for the same changes: a value typed in an editor is no input of the pipeline', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const changes = changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9 }));
+      const held = { filter: { search: 'DH-1' }, sort: qtyAsc, summary: summary(sumQty), changes };
+      const first = pipeline.run(input(held));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input(held));
+      expect(second).toBe(first);
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('runs steps 2 and 7 to 9 for a committed change, and not the search, the filter, the sort or the rows', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { filter: { search: 'DH-1', ...qtyOver5 }, sort: qtyAsc };
+      const first = pipeline.run(
+        input({
+          ...held,
+          summary: summary(sumQty),
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9 })),
+        }),
+      );
+      const second = pipeline.run(
+        input({
+          ...held,
+          summary: summary(sumQty),
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9, id: 'DH-1' })),
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(filters).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(keyedRows).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(second.rows).toBe(first.rows);
+      expect(second.searched).toBe(first.searched);
+      expect(second.keyed).not.toBe(first.keyed);
+      // Only the row that changed is a new object, and so is drawn again.
+      const same = first.keyed.filter((one, at) => second.keyed[at] === one);
+      expect(same).toHaveLength(first.keyed.length - 1);
+    });
+
+    it('runs the search and the filter again only when a key is pinned that was not, or goes', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { filter: { search: 'DH-1', ...qtyOver5 }, sort: qtyAsc };
+      pipeline.run(input({ ...held, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9 })) }));
+      pipeline.run(input({ ...held, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 8 })) }));
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      pipeline.run(
+        input({
+          ...held,
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 8 }), update('DH-2', { qty: 1 })),
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(filters).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      // The row being edited is pinned as well, and a save that clears the changes lets them go.
+      pipeline.run(input({ ...held, changes: null }));
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+      const saved = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, changes: null }));
+      expect(saved.keyed.every((one) => one.row === row(String(one.key)))).toBe(true);
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+    });
+
+    it('reads the pinned rows as a set: the same rows in another order run nothing again', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { filter: { search: 'DH-1' } };
+      pipeline.run(
+        input({
+          ...held,
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9 }), update('DH-2', { qty: 1 })),
+        }),
+      );
+      pipeline.run(
+        input({
+          ...held,
+          changes: changesOf(update('DH-2', { qty: 1 }), update('DH-1', { qty: 9 })),
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(searches).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('groups again for a committed change only when the groups have totals to compute', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 9 })) }));
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 8 })) }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      const items = summary([], sumQty);
+      pipeline.run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, summary: items, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 8 })) }),
+      );
+      pipeline.run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, summary: items, changes: changesOf(update('DH-1', { qty: 7 })) }),
+      );
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('runs the page step alone for a new page, with the new rows kept', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const changes = changesOf(insert({ qty: 5 }));
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ changes, page: { index: 0, size: 10 } }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ changes, page: { index: 1, size: 10 } }));
+      expect(second.flat).toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(second.visible[0]).toBe(first.visible[0]);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the flat row of a new row until its data changes', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const change = insert({ qty: 5 });
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ changes: changesOf(change) }));
+      const same = pipeline.run(input({ changes: changesOf(change) }));
+      expect(same.flat[0]).toBe(first.flat[0]);
+      const other = pipeline.run(input({ changes: changesOf({ ...change, data: { qty: 6 } }) }));
+      expect(other.flat[0]).not.toBe(first.flat[0]);
+    });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts
index d867339..a818d23 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts
@@ -384,3 +384,41 @@ describe('remoteSummaryText', () => {
     expect(written({ column: 'at', type: 'max' }, { not: 'a date' })).toBe('');
   });
 });
+
+describe('computeSummary with a reader of shown rows', () => {
+  // The row `a` is shown with 40 for 4, the row `b` is marked for deletion and the others are as they are.
+  const shown = { ...ROWS[0]!, qty: 40 };
+  const view = (one: Order): Order | null => (one.id === 'a' ? shown : one.id === 'b' ? null : one);
+  const run = (...definitions: DataGridSummaryItem<Order>[]) =>
+    computeSummary(ROWS, resolve(...definitions), view);
+
+  it('counts the rows the reader gives, and none it gives as null', () => {
+    expect(run({ column: 'qty', type: 'count' }).get('count:qty')!.value).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it('sums, averages and takes the least and the greatest of the shown values', () => {
+    const values = run(
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'avg' },
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'max' },
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'min' },
+    );
+    expect(values.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(50);
+    expect(values.get('avg:qty')!.value).toBe(25);
+    expect(values.get('max:qty')).toEqual({ value: 40, row: shown });
+    expect(values.get('min:qty')).toEqual({ value: 10, row: ROWS[3] });
+  });
+
+  it('gives a function type the shown rows, in order, without the removed one', () => {
+    const rows = vi.fn((given: readonly Order[]) => given.map((one) => one.id).join(''));
+    const values = run({ column: 'qty', type: rows });
+    expect(values.get('custom:qty')!.value).toBe('acd');
+    expect(rows.mock.calls[0]![0][0]).toBe(shown);
+  });
+
+  it('is the totals of the rows themselves when the reader gives every row back', () => {
+    const items = resolve({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' }, { column: 'qty', type: 'count' });
+    const plain = computeSummary(ROWS, items);
+    expect(computeSummary(ROWS, items, (one) => one)).toEqual(plain);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b42ad74
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,312 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import { mergeLabels } from '../labels';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridValidationRule } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { validateRow, validateValue } from './validate';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  email: string;
+  qty: number;
+  placed: string;
+  paid: boolean;
+  code: string;
+}
+
+const OPTIONS = {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+};
+const labels = mergeLabels(undefined);
+
+function column(definition: DataGridColumn<Order>) {
+  return resolveColumns([definition], OPTIONS)[0]!;
+}
+
+const customer = column({ field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer' });
+const qty = column({ field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number' });
+const placed = column({
+  field: 'placed',
+  caption: 'Order date',
+  dataType: 'date',
+  format: { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' },
+});
+
+type Rule = DataGridValidationRule<Order, unknown>;
+const check = (value: unknown, rules: Rule[], on = customer, row: Partial<Order> = {}) =>
+  validateValue(value, rules, on, row, labels);
+
+describe('validateValue', () => {
+  let warn: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>;
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    resetDevWarnings();
+    warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+  });
+  afterEach(() => warn.mockRestore());
+
+  describe('what it gives', () => {
+    it('is null for no rules, and for a value that passes every rule', () => {
+      expect(check('', [])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('An', [{ type: 'required' }, { type: 'stringLength', min: 2 }])).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('gives the message of the first rule that fails and runs none after it', () => {
+      const custom = vi.fn(() => 'never');
+      const message = check('', [{ type: 'required' }, { type: 'custom', validate: custom }]);
+      expect(message).toBe('Customer is required');
+      expect(custom).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(
+        check('A', [
+          { type: 'stringLength', min: 2 },
+          { type: 'required', message: 'second' },
+        ]),
+      ).toBe('Customer must be at least 2 characters');
+    });
+
+    it("lets a rule's own message win over the words of the labels", () => {
+      expect(check(null, [{ type: 'required', message: 'Tell us who' }])).toBe('Tell us who');
+      expect(check('abc', [{ type: 'email', message: 'Not mail' }])).toBe('Not mail');
+      expect(check('abc', [{ type: 'pattern', pattern: /^\d+$/, message: 'Digits' }])).toBe(
+        'Digits',
+      );
+      expect(check('abcdef', [{ type: 'stringLength', max: 3, message: 'Short' }])).toBe('Short');
+      expect(check(0, [{ type: 'range', min: 1, message: 'Positive' }], qty)).toBe('Positive');
+    });
+
+    it('writes the default messages with the caption the heading shows and the labels of the grid', () => {
+      expect(check('', [{ type: 'required' }])).toBe('Customer is required');
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'pattern', pattern: /^\d+$/ }])).toBe('Customer is not valid');
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'email' }])).toBe('Customer must be an email address');
+      const custom = mergeLabels({ validation: { required: (caption) => `Thiếu ${caption}` } });
+      expect(validateValue('', [{ type: 'required' }], customer, {}, custom)).toBe(
+        'Thiếu Customer',
+      );
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('required', () => {
+    it('fails every blank value of the column', () => {
+      for (const blank of ['', null, undefined, Number.NaN, new Date(Number.NaN)]) {
+        expect(check(blank, [{ type: 'required' }])).toBe('Customer is required');
+      }
+    });
+
+    it('passes a zero, a false and a text of spaces: only isBlank is blank', () => {
+      expect(check(0, [{ type: 'required' }], qty)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(false, [{ type: 'required' }])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('  ', [{ type: 'required' }])).toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('every rule but required passes a blank value', () => {
+    it('passes a blank for range, stringLength, pattern and email, and leaves custom to the app', () => {
+      const custom = vi.fn(() => 'fails');
+      const rules: Rule[] = [
+        { type: 'range', min: 1 },
+        { type: 'stringLength', min: 3 },
+        { type: 'pattern', pattern: /^\d+$/ },
+        { type: 'email' },
+      ];
+      for (const blank of ['', null, undefined]) expect(check(blank, rules)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(null, [{ type: 'custom', validate: custom }])).toBe('fails');
+      expect(custom).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null, {});
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('range', () => {
+    it('compares numbers by value, with either end alone', () => {
+      const both: Rule = { type: 'range', min: 1, max: 9 };
+      expect(check(5, [both], qty)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(1, [both], qty)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(9, [both], qty)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(0, [both], qty)).toBe('Qty must be between 1 and 9');
+      expect(check(10, [both], qty)).toBe('Qty must be between 1 and 9');
+      expect(check(0, [{ type: 'range', min: 1 }], qty)).toBe('Qty must be at least 1');
+      expect(check(10, [{ type: 'range', max: 9 }], qty)).toBe('Qty must be at most 9');
+      expect(check(10, [{ type: 'range' }], qty)).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('writes the ends as the column writes a value', () => {
+      const money = column({
+        field: 'qty',
+        caption: 'Total',
+        dataType: 'number',
+        format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' },
+      });
+      expect(check(5, [{ type: 'range', min: 10, max: 2500 }], money)).toBe(
+        'Total must be between $10.00 and $2,500.00',
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('compares days by their ISO day, a Date or a string alike', () => {
+      const rule: Rule = { type: 'range', min: '2026-11-01', max: '2026-11-30' };
+      const message = 'Order date must be between Nov 1, 2026 and Nov 30, 2026';
+      expect(check('2026-11-15', [rule], placed)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 15)), [rule], placed)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('2026-10-31', [rule], placed)).toBe(message);
+      expect(check(new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 11, 1)), [rule], placed)).toBe(message);
+      expect(check('2026-12-01', [{ type: 'range', max: '2026-11-30' }], placed)).toBe(
+        'Order date must be at most Nov 30, 2026',
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('passes a value of another type, whose own editor shows its fault', () => {
+      expect(check('abc', [{ type: 'range', min: 1, max: 9 }], qty)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(5, [{ type: 'range', min: 1, max: 9 }], customer)).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('not a day', [{ type: 'range', min: '2026-11-01' }], placed)).toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('stringLength', () => {
+    it('counts the characters of the text, with either end alone', () => {
+      const rule: Rule = { type: 'stringLength', min: 2, max: 4 };
+      expect(check('ab', [rule])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('abcd', [rule])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('a', [rule])).toBe('Customer must be between 2 and 4 characters');
+      expect(check('abcde', [rule])).toBe('Customer must be between 2 and 4 characters');
+      expect(check('a', [{ type: 'stringLength', min: 2 }])).toBe(
+        'Customer must be at least 2 characters',
+      );
+      expect(check('abcde', [{ type: 'stringLength', max: 4 }])).toBe(
+        'Customer must be at most 4 characters',
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('counts a character that takes two code units once, and reads a number as its text', () => {
+      expect(check('😀', [{ type: 'stringLength', max: 1 }])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check(12345, [{ type: 'stringLength', max: 4 }], qty)).toBe(
+        'Qty must be at most 4 characters',
+      );
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('pattern', () => {
+    it('tests the text with the expression', () => {
+      const rule: Rule = { type: 'pattern', pattern: /^DH-\d+$/ };
+      expect(check('DH-12', [rule])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('XX-12', [rule])).toBe('Customer is not valid');
+    });
+
+    it('is not fooled by a global or sticky expression, which remembers where it stopped', () => {
+      const global: Rule = { type: 'pattern', pattern: /^DH-\d+$/g };
+      const sticky: Rule = { type: 'pattern', pattern: /DH/y };
+      for (let time = 0; time < 3; time++) {
+        expect(check('DH-12', [global])).toBeNull();
+        expect(check('DH-12', [sticky])).toBeNull();
+      }
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('email', () => {
+    it('wants one @, a dot after it and no space, and is loose beyond that', () => {
+      for (const good of ['a@b.co', 'first.last@mail.example.vn', 'a+b@c.d']) {
+        expect(check(good, [{ type: 'email' }])).toBeNull();
+      }
+      for (const bad of ['plain', 'a@b', 'a@@b.c', 'a b@c.d', 'a@b .c', '@b.c', 'a@.c', 'a@b.']) {
+        expect(check(bad, [{ type: 'email' }])).toBe('Customer must be an email address');
+      }
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('custom', () => {
+    it("reads a string as the message, and false as an error with the rule's message or the pattern words", () => {
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate: () => 'Taken' }])).toBe('Taken');
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate: () => false, message: 'No' }])).toBe('No');
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate: () => false }])).toBe('Customer is not valid');
+    });
+
+    it('passes true, null, undefined and an empty string', () => {
+      for (const result of [true, null, undefined, '']) {
+        expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate: () => result }])).toBeNull();
+      }
+    });
+
+    it('is given the value and the row being edited', () => {
+      const validate = vi.fn(() => true);
+      check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate }], customer, { id: 'DH-1', qty: 2 });
+      expect(validate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('x', { id: 'DH-1', qty: 2 });
+    });
+
+    it('passes, with one warning, when the rule throws', () => {
+      const validate = () => {
+        throw new Error('boom');
+      };
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate }])).toBeNull();
+      expect(check('x', [{ type: 'custom', validate }])).toBeNull();
+      expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(String(warn.mock.calls[0]![0])).not.toContain('boom');
+    });
+
+    it('ignores a rule of a type it does not know, and a pattern that is no expression', () => {
+      const unknown = { type: 'unique' } as unknown as Rule;
+      const loose = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'abc' } as unknown as Rule;
+      expect(check('x', [unknown, loose])).toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('validateRow', () => {
+  const columns = resolveColumns<Order>(
+    [
+      { field: 'id' },
+      { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }] },
+      {
+        field: 'email',
+        caption: 'Email',
+        validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }, { type: 'email' }],
+      },
+      {
+        field: 'qty',
+        caption: 'Qty',
+        dataType: 'number',
+        validationRules: [{ type: 'range', min: 1 }],
+      },
+    ],
+    OPTIONS,
+  );
+
+  it('gives the message of each column that fails, by column id, in the order of the columns', () => {
+    const errors = validateRow(
+      { id: 'DH-1', customer: '', email: 'nope', qty: 0 },
+      columns,
+      labels,
+    );
+    expect([...errors]).toEqual([
+      ['customer', 'Customer is required'],
+      ['email', 'Email must be an email address'],
+      ['qty', 'Qty must be at least 1'],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('is empty for a row that passes, and checks only the columns it is given', () => {
+    expect(validateRow({ customer: 'An', email: 'a@b.co', qty: 3 }, columns, labels).size).toBe(0);
+    const bad = { customer: '', email: '', qty: 0 };
+    const some = validateRow(bad, [columns[1]!], labels);
+    expect([...some.keys()]).toEqual(['customer']);
+  });
+
+  it('reads the value of a field the row does not have as blank', () => {
+    const errors = validateRow({}, columns, labels);
+    expect([...errors.keys()]).toEqual(['customer', 'email']);
+  });
+
+  it('treats a column whose rules are not an array as having none', () => {
+    const odd = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [{ field: 'customer', validationRules: 'required' as never }],
+      OPTIONS,
+    );
+    expect(validateRow({}, odd, labels).size).toBe(0);
+  });
+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/labels.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/labels.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3b60ad9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/labels.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { sameLabels } from './hooks/use-renewal-warning';
+import { DEFAULT_LABELS, LABEL_RECORDS, mergeLabels } from './labels';
+
+describe('LABEL_RECORDS', () => {
+  it('names every label that is a record of words, read from the defaults and not from a list', () => {
+    const records = Object.entries(DEFAULT_LABELS)
+      .filter(([, value]) => typeof value === 'object')
+      .map(([key]) => key);
+    expect([...LABEL_RECORDS].sort()).toEqual(records.sort());
+    expect(LABEL_RECORDS).toContain('validation');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('mergeLabels', () => {
+  it('merges validation one level deep, so a partial record keeps the words it leaves out', () => {
+    const labels = mergeLabels({ validation: { required: (caption) => `${caption}?` } });
+    expect(labels.validation.required('Customer')).toBe('Customer?');
+    expect(labels.validation.email('Email')).toBe('Email must be an email address');
+    expect(labels.validation.range('Qty', '1', '9')).toBe('Qty must be between 1 and 9');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the defaults of validation when the caller gives none, or gives undefined words', () => {
+    expect(mergeLabels(undefined).validation).toEqual(DEFAULT_LABELS.validation);
+    const labels = mergeLabels({ validation: { required: undefined } });
+    expect(labels.validation.required('Customer')).toBe('Customer is required');
+  });
+
+  it('says one end of a range or a length as "at least" or "at most"', () => {
+    const { validation } = mergeLabels(undefined);
+    expect(validation.range('Qty', '1', undefined)).toBe('Qty must be at least 1');
+    expect(validation.range('Qty', undefined, '9')).toBe('Qty must be at most 9');
+    expect(validation.stringLength('Note', 2, 5)).toBe('Note must be between 2 and 5 characters');
+    expect(validation.stringLength('Note', 2, undefined)).toBe(
+      'Note must be at least 2 characters',
+    );
+    expect(validation.stringLength('Note', undefined, 5)).toBe('Note must be at most 5 characters');
+    expect(validation.pattern('Code')).toBe('Code is not valid');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('sameLabels', () => {
+  it('compares the validation record by its words, as every other record of labels', () => {
+    const required = (caption: string) => `${caption}?`;
+    expect(sameLabels({ validation: { required } }, { validation: { required } })).toBe(true);
+    expect(
+      sameLabels({ validation: { required } }, { validation: { required: (c) => `${c}?` } }),
+    ).toBe(false);
+  });
+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/edit.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/edit.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..71014fa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/edit.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,325 @@
+import type { DataGridChange, DataGridDataType, DataGridKey } from '../types';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from './flatten';
+import { isBlank, toComparable, toFilterKey } from './values';
+
+/**
+ * A change the grid holds and has not saved, one for each row. `data` is the fields of the row (a computed
+ * column's value is turned into fields by its `setValue` when it is set, so a change never holds column
+ * ids). `row` is the saved row the change was made on: it stays when the row leaves `data`, as a row of
+ * another page of a server grid does. A `remove` keeps the `data` of the update it was made over, which an
+ * undo gives back.
+ */
+export type PendingChange<TRow> =
+  | { type: 'insert'; key: string; data: Partial<TRow> }
+  | { type: 'update'; key: DataGridKey; data: Partial<TRow>; row: TRow }
+  | { type: 'remove'; key: DataGridKey; row: TRow; data?: Partial<TRow> };
+
+/** What `mergeChange` is asked: a change to make, or the undo of a remove. */
+export type ChangeRequest<TRow> = PendingChange<TRow> | { type: 'undo' };
+
+/**
+ * The rows as the grid shows them over the saved ones (step 2 of spec 3.5). A row is looked up by its
+ * object or by its key, both of the data it was made from.
+ */
+export interface ShownRows<TRow> {
+  /**
+   * The row as it is shown: a changed row is one new object, `{ ...row, ...data }`, the same object until
+   * its change changes; every other row is the object it was.
+   */
+  shown(row: TRow, key: DataGridKey): TRow;
+  /**
+   * The row as a total reads it: the shown row, or `null` for a row that is marked for deletion, which no
+   * total counts. A row without a change is itself.
+   */
+  view(row: TRow): TRow | null;
+  /**
+   * The keys of the rows that must not move: every key with a change, and the keys the caller asked for
+   * (the row being edited).
+   */
+  pinned: ReadonlySet<DataGridKey>;
+  /** The rows of the data whose key is pinned; the search and the filter keep them whatever they read. */
+  pinnedRows: ReadonlySet<TRow>;
+  /** The keys of the rows marked for deletion. */
+  deleted: ReadonlySet<DataGridKey>;
+  /** The new rows in the order they were added, each as a row of its data, with its temporary key. */
+  added: readonly { key: string; row: TRow }[];
+}
+
+const isFilled = (data: object | undefined): data is object =>
+  data !== undefined && Object.keys(data).length > 0;
+
+/**
+ * The change that stands for `previous` followed by `next`, or `null` for none. An update over an update
+ * merges the data; an insert that is updated stays an insert; an insert that is removed was never saved, so
+ * it is no change; an update that is removed is a remove that keeps the data; an undo of a remove is the
+ * update it kept, or none. An undo of anything else changes nothing.
+ */
+export function mergeChange<TRow>(
+  previous: PendingChange<TRow> | undefined,
+  next: ChangeRequest<TRow>,
+): PendingChange<TRow> | null {
+  if (next.type === 'undo') {
+    if (previous?.type !== 'remove') return previous ?? null;
+    return isFilled(previous.data)
+      ? { type: 'update', key: previous.key, data: previous.data, row: previous.row }
+      : null;
+  }
+  if (!previous) return next;
+  switch (previous.type) {
+    case 'insert':
+      if (next.type === 'remove') return null;
+      if (next.type === 'update') {
+        return { type: 'insert', key: previous.key, data: { ...previous.data, ...next.data } };
+      }
+      return next;
+    case 'update':
+      if (next.type === 'update') {
+        return { ...previous, data: { ...previous.data, ...next.data } };
+      }
+      if (next.type === 'remove') {
+        return isFilled(previous.data)
+          ? { type: 'remove', key: previous.key, row: previous.row, data: previous.data }
+          : { type: 'remove', key: previous.key, row: previous.row };
+      }

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f8dc62e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/validate.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+import { isNumber } from '../../../internal/number';
+import { devWarn } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import type { DataGridLabels, DataGridValidationRule } from '../types';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+import { isBlank, toFilterKey } from './values';
+
+type Rule<TRow> = DataGridValidationRule<TRow, unknown>;
+
+// One `@`, something before it, and after it a dot with something on both sides; no space anywhere. Loose on
+// purpose: the address is confirmed by sending to it, not by a pattern.
+const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
+
+// The ends of a range as the cells write a value: by the column's own format, and as they came when the
+// column cannot write them.
+function end(
+  column: Pick<ResolvedColumn<unknown>, 'valueText'>,
+  value: number | string | undefined,
+): string | undefined {
+  if (value === undefined) return undefined;
+  return column.valueText(value) || String(value);
+}
+
+// The rules of a column as the caller gave them; anything but an array has none.
+function rulesOf<TRow>(column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>): readonly Rule<TRow>[] {
+  const { validationRules } = column.column;
+  return Array.isArray(validationRules) ? (validationRules as readonly Rule<TRow>[]) : [];
+}
+
+// Whether `value` is outside the ends of the rule. Numbers are compared by value and days by their
+// ISO day (a `Date` or a string alike); a value of another type, or an end of another type, is not
+// compared, so the editor of that type shows its own fault.
+function outsideRange<TRow>(
+  rule: Extract<Rule<TRow>, { type: 'range' }>,
+  value: unknown,
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>,
+): boolean {
+  if (column.dataType === 'number' && isNumber(value)) {
+    return (isNumber(rule.min) && value < rule.min) || (isNumber(rule.max) && value > rule.max);
+  }
+  if (column.dataType === 'date') {
+    const day = toFilterKey(value, 'date', 'UTC');
+    if (typeof day !== 'string') return false;
+    return (
+      (typeof rule.min === 'string' && day < rule.min) ||
+      (typeof rule.max === 'string' && day > rule.max)
+    );
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+// What a rule says of a value that is not blank (or is, for `required` and `custom`): the message, or
+// `null` when the value passes.
+function failure<TRow>(
+  rule: Rule<TRow>,
+  value: unknown,
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>,
+  row: Partial<TRow>,
+  labels: DataGridLabels,
+): string | null {
+  const words = labels.validation;
+  const own = typeof rule.message === 'string' ? rule.message : undefined;
+  const { caption } = column;
+  switch (rule.type) {
+    case 'required':
+      return isBlank(value) ? (own ?? words.required(caption)) : null;
+    case 'custom': {
+      let result: string | boolean | null | undefined;
+      try {
+        result = rule.validate(value, row);
+      } catch {
+        devWarn('<DataGrid> a custom validation rule threw; the value passes it.');
+        return null;
+      }
+      if (result === false) return own ?? words.pattern(caption);
+      return typeof result === 'string' && result !== '' ? result : null;
+    }
+  }
+  if (isBlank(value)) return null;
+  switch (rule.type) {
+    case 'range':
+      return outsideRange(rule, value, column)
+        ? (own ?? words.range(caption, end(column, rule.min), end(column, rule.max)))
+        : null;
+    case 'stringLength': {
+      const length = [...String(value)].length;
+      const short = rule.min !== undefined && length < rule.min;
+      const long = rule.max !== undefined && length > rule.max;
+      return short || long ? (own ?? words.stringLength(caption, rule.min, rule.max)) : null;
+    }
+    case 'pattern': {
+      if (!(rule.pattern instanceof RegExp)) return null;
+      // A global or sticky expression remembers where its last match ended.
+      rule.pattern.lastIndex = 0;
+      return rule.pattern.test(String(value)) ? null : (own ?? words.pattern(caption));
+    }
+    case 'email':
+      return EMAIL.test(String(value)) ? null : (own ?? words.email(caption));
+    default:
+      return null;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * The message of the first rule that fails for a value, or `null` when it passes them all; the rules
+ * after the one that fails are not run. Every rule but `required` (and `custom`, which is the app's own)
+ * passes a blank value. A rule's own `message` wins over the words of `labels.validation`, which name the
+ * column's caption and write the ends of a range as the cells write a value. A rule that throws passes,
+ * with a warning, and a rule of a type the grid does not know is ignored.
+ */
+export function validateValue<TRow>(
+  value: unknown,
+  rules: readonly Rule<TRow>[],
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>,
+  row: Partial<TRow>,
+  labels: DataGridLabels,
+): string | null {
+  for (const rule of rules) {
+    const message = failure(rule, value, column, row, labels);
+    if (message !== null) return message;
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The messages of a row, by column id, in the order of the columns, for the columns it is given (the
+ * caller decides which: the cells a row draws, or every column of a form). A field the row does not hold
+ * is a blank.
+ */
+export function validateRow<TRow>(
+  row: Partial<TRow>,
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[],
+  labels: DataGridLabels,
+): ReadonlyMap<string, string> {
+  const errors = new Map<string, string>();
+  for (const column of columns) {
+    const rules = rulesOf(column);
+    if (rules.length === 0) continue;
+    const message = validateValue(column.value(row as TRow), rules, column, row, labels);
+    if (message !== null) errors.set(column.id, message);
+  }
+  return errors;
+}

### Task 3: `DialogContent fullScreenOnPhone`

Spec §4.3 "Dialog toàn màn hình trên điện thoại (EF1, plan F)"; §6.3 Dialog (`fullScreenOnPhone`); §7 lớp 2 ("toàn màn hình ở 390px"), danh sách story; §8 `Dialog.mdx`. Mockup: điện thoại của EF1 (b), dựng bằng Dialog của chính thư viện. Bắt đầu từ commit của Task 2.
- **Prop công khai** `fullScreenOnPhone?: boolean` của `DialogContent` (mặc định `false`): `data-full-screen="phone"` trên `<dialog>` khi giá trị là `true`; chạy cùng `alert` và `movable` (phát hiện 8). `modal.tsx` không đổi.
- **CSS** dưới `@media (max-width: 639.98px)` và `.flg-dialog[data-full-screen='phone']`: panel phủ cửa sổ, không viền, không bo góc, padding đáy theo vùng an toàn; đầu 18px; chân ở đáy, hai nút chia hàng. Không lớp CSS mới.
- **Docs:** mục "Full screen on phones" của `Dialog.mdx`.
- **Story:** `DialogFullScreenPhone` (giao diện, `viewport-390x844`), `DialogFullScreenPhoneLayout`, `DialogFullScreenPhoneScrolls` (`no-visual`). Claude sửa Qty của story 15 → 25 như EF1.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx`, `Dialog.mdx`, `Dialog.test.tsx`, `Dialog.test-d.ts`, `Dialog.stories.tsx`; `src/styles/components/dialog.css`

**Interfaces:**
- Public (export từ `src/index.ts` qua kiểu prop của `DialogContent`, đã có): `DialogContentProps.fullScreenOnPhone?: boolean`.
- DOM và CSS: `dialog.flg-dialog[data-full-screen="phone"]`; không lớp, token hay custom property mới.
- Story: `DialogFullScreenPhone` (`viewport-390x844`); `DialogFullScreenPhoneLayout`, `DialogFullScreenPhoneScrolls` (`no-visual`).
- Task sau dùng: Task 10 (`EditPopup` truyền `fullScreenOnPhone` của `editing.popup`, mặc định `true`); Plan G (changeset nêu prop này).

+/** EF1 (b), the phone: the panel is the screen, the form is one column, Cancel and Save share the row. */
+export const DialogFullScreenPhone: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-390x844'],
+  render: () => <PhoneForm />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const dialog = dialogIn(canvasElement);
+    const panel = await panelOf(dialog);
+    const view = within(dialog);
+    await expect(view.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Edit DH-1028' })).toBeVisible();
+    await expect(view.getByText('Fields marked * are required.')).toBeVisible();
+    // Customer is the first field and takes the focus, as in EF1.

+    // The visual harness shoots at 390x844; a run of the stories sets the window to it first.
+    await withViewport(async (viewport) => {
+      await viewport.set(390, 844);
+      // The panel is the window: no margin, no corners, no border.
+      const box = boxOf(panel);
+      same(box.left, 0);
+      same(box.top, 0);
+      same(box.width, window.innerWidth);
+      same(box.height, window.innerHeight);
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(panel).borderTopLeftRadius).toBe('0px');
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(panel).borderTopWidth).toBe('0px');
+      const cancel = view.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' });
+      const save = view.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' });
+      same(boxOf(cancel).top, boxOf(save).top);
+      same(boxOf(cancel).width, boxOf(save).width);
+    });
+  },
+};
+
+/** Layer 2: the panel's box at 390x844 is the window, and at 1280x720 the `lg` panel, centred. */
+export const DialogFullScreenPhoneLayout: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  render: () => <PhoneForm />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    await withViewport(async (viewport) => {
+      const dialog = dialogIn(canvasElement);
+      const panel = await panelOf(dialog);
+      const footer = panel.querySelector('.flg-card-footer') as HTMLElement;
+      const buttons = Array.from(footer.querySelectorAll('button'));
+      const [cancel, save] = buttons as [HTMLButtonElement, HTMLButtonElement];
+      await expect(buttons).toHaveLength(2);
+
+      await viewport.set(390, 844);
+      let box = boxOf(panel);
+      same(box.left, 0);
+      same(box.top, 0);
+      same(box.width, 390);
+      same(box.height, 844);
+      // The footer ends at the panel's bottom, less its padding: 18px and the safe area.
+      same(boxOf(footer).bottom, 844 - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(panel).paddingBottom));
+      same(boxOf(cancel).width, boxOf(save).width);
+      same(boxOf(cancel).top, boxOf(save).top);
+      // Together the buttons fill the footer's row.
+      same(boxOf(save).right - boxOf(cancel).left, boxOf(footer).width);
+
+      await viewport.set(WIDE.width, WIDE.height);
+      box = boxOf(panel);
+      same(box.width, 640);
+      same(box.left + box.width / 2, WIDE.width / 2);
+      same(box.top + box.height / 2, WIDE.height / 2);
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(panel).borderTopLeftRadius).not.toBe('0px');
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(dialog).paddingTop).toBe('16px');
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(footer).marginTop).toBe('0px');
+    });
+  },
+};
+
+/** A panel taller than the screen scrolls inside, with the footer at the end of what it holds. */

+    id: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    value: (row) => row.price * (row.qty ?? 0),
+  },
+];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={{ mode: 'row' }}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const rowOf = (name: string) => dataRows().find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const cellOf = (row: HTMLElement, caption: string): HTMLElement => {
+  const heads = Array.from(table().querySelectorAll('thead th')).map((head) => head.textContent);
+  return Array.from(row.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > td, :scope > th')).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  )[heads.filter((head) => head !== '').indexOf(caption)]!;
+};
+const edit = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Edit ${name}` });
+const click = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.click());
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, {
+    key: pressed,
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    ...init,
+  });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const startEdit = (name: string) => click(edit(name));
+/** The announcement is set a task after it is said. */
+const tick = () => act(async () => void (await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0))));
+const editedRow = () => table().querySelector<HTMLTableRowElement>('tr[data-editing]');
+const input = (label: string) => within(editedRow()!).getByLabelText(label) as HTMLInputElement;
+const type = (label: string, text: string) =>
+  act(() => void fireEvent.change(input(label), { target: { value: text } }));
+const saveButton = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Save ${name}` });
+/** The first call of a spy, which is what `onSaving` was given. */
+const sent = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>): DataGridChange<Order>[] =>
+  spy.mock.calls[0]![0] as DataGridChange<Order>[];
+const tabbables = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    table().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
+      'input:not([type="hidden"]), button, [role="combobox"], [tabindex="0"]',
+    ),
+  ).filter((element) => element.getAttribute('tabindex') !== '-1');
+
+describe('the column of buttons', () => {

+    expect(cell).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(cell!.hasAttribute('data-actions')).toBe(true);
+    // It is a place of the keyboard with several controls, not a cell of one: no `data-service`.
+    expect(cell!.hasAttribute('data-service')).toBe(false);
+    expect(cell!.parentElement!.lastElementChild).toBe(cell);
+  });
+
+  it('is drawn only while a button can stand in it', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders editing={undefined} />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).toBeNull();

+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'row', allowUpdating: () => false }} />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).not.toBeNull();

+  it('makes every data row 4px taller, and only while it is drawn', () => {

+    expect(height()).toBe('45px');
+    rerender(<Orders density="compact" variant="striped" />);

+    // A caller's height is used as given, and a group row keeps its own.
+    rerender(<Orders rowHeight={50} />);

+    expect(

+
+  it('gives Edit a name from the row header, out of the Tab order, and none to a row that cannot be edited', () => {

+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-2' })).toBeNull();
+    // The empty cell of that row is still a place of the keyboard.

+    expect(empty.querySelector('button')).toBeNull();

+
+  it('names a row by the row header even while that column is hidden, and by its key without one', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={{ hidden: ['id'] }} />);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-1' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        columns={
+          COLUMNS.map((column) => ({ ...column, rowHeader: false })) as DataGridColumn<Order>[]

+      />,
+    );
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-1' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('says its buttons in the words of the labels', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        labels={{
+          actions: 'Thao tác',
+          edit: (name) => `Sửa ${name}`,
+          save: (name) => `Lưu ${name}`,
+          cancelEdit: (name) => `Huỷ sửa ${name}`,

+      />,
+    );
+    expect(table().querySelector('thead')).toHaveTextContent('Thao tác');
+    click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sửa DH-1' }));
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Lưu DH-1' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Huỷ sửa DH-1' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+});

+describe('the editors of a row', () => {

+describe('a custom editor', () => {
+  it('replaces the default one and is given every member of its context', () => {
+    const seen: unknown[] = [];

+      COLUMNS[0]!,
+      {
+        field: 'customer',
+        caption: 'Customer',
+        editor: (ctx) => {
+          seen.push(ctx);
+          return (
+            <button type="button" onClick={() => ctx.setValue(`${ctx.value}!`)}>
+              Shout
+            </button>
+          );
+        },
+      },
+    ];
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders columns={columns} onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    expect(within(editedRow()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Shout' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    const ctx = seen.at(-1) as Record<string, unknown>;
+    expect(Object.keys(ctx).sort()).toEqual(
+      [
+        'autoFocus',
+        'cancel',
+        'commit',
+        'errorId',
+        'invalid',
+        'label',
+        'mode',
+        'row',
+        'setValue',
+        'size',
+        'value',
+      ].sort(),
+    );
+    expect(ctx).toMatchObject({
+      value: 'An',
+      mode: 'row',
+      size: 'md',
+      label: 'Customer',
+      autoFocus: true,
+      invalid: false,
+      errorId: undefined,
+    });
+    expect((ctx.row as Order).id).toBe('DH-1');
+    click(within(editedRow()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Shout' }));
+    expect((seen.at(-1) as { value: unknown }).value).toBe('An!');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    expect(sent(onSaving)).toEqual([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { customer: 'An!' }, row: ORDERS[0] },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the handlers of the element it returns, and gives its own control the focus first', () => {

+describe('onSaving', () => {
+  it('is called once with one update that holds the changed fields only, and the saved row', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(sent(onSaving)).toEqual([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { customer: 'Hoa' }, row: ORDERS[0] },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('is not called when nothing changed or a value is typed back, and the edit ends', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(editedRow()).toBeNull();
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    type('Customer', 'An');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(editedRow()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('turns the editor value back into what the row holds: a Date stays a Date, a lookup its own value', () => {

+    act(() => void fireEvent.change(input('Order date'), { target: { value: '12/01/2026' } }));
+    act(() => void fireEvent.blur(input('Order date')));
+    fireEvent.click(
+      within(editedRow()!)

+    expect(update!.data.placed).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
+    expect((update!.data.placed as Date).getTime()).toBe(Date.UTC(2026, 11, 1));
+    expect(update!.data.status).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it('sets a value column through its setValue, and a number and a box as they are', () => {

+    type('Total', '80');

+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    // Qty 4 and total 80 make a price of 20; the row's other fields are not sent.
+    expect(sent(onSaving)[0]).toMatchObject({

+      'qty',

+
+  it('reads the draft when the button is pressed, and not the one of a render before', () => {

+  it('waits for a Promise: the table is busy, Save loads, the editors cannot change, and resolve ends the edit', async () => {

+  it('keeps the edit and warns once when onSaving throws', () => {
