+describe('the place after a save that moves the row (grouped and paged grids)', () => {
+  const MORE: Order[] = [
+    ...ORDERS,
+    { ...ORDERS[0]!, id: 'DH-4', customer: 'Dung', channel: 'Store', qty: 2 },
+    { ...ORDERS[1]!, id: 'DH-5', customer: 'Em', channel: 'Web', qty: 4 },
+    { ...ORDERS[2]!, id: 'DH-6', customer: 'Giang', channel: 'Phone', qty: 6 },
+  ];
+  // The app saves by writing the change over its data, as the docs say.
+  function Saved(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+    const [data, setData] = useState(MORE);
+    return (
+      <Orders
+        data={data}
+        onSaving={(changes) =>
+          setData(
+            data.map((row) => {
+              const change = changes.find((one) => one.key === row.id);
+              return change && change.type === 'update' ? { ...row, ...change.data } : row;
+            }),
+          )
+        }
+        {...props}
+      />
+    );
+  }
+  const channelColumns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+    COLUMNS[0]!,
+    COLUMNS[1]!,
+    { field: 'channel', caption: 'Channel' },
+  ];
+  // The grouping is by a column that is not drawn; a computed one writes it.
+  const groupedColumns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+    COLUMNS[0]!,
+    COLUMNS[1]!,
+    { field: 'channel', caption: 'Group', visible: false },
+    dataGridColumn<Order>()({
+      id: 'where',
+      caption: 'Where',
+      value: (row) => row.channel,
+      setValue: (row, value) => ({ ...row, channel: String(value) }),
+    }),
+  ];
+  const groupedProps = {
+    columns: groupedColumns,
+    grouping: [{ field: 'channel', direction: 'asc' }] as const,
+    defaultExpandedGroups: { allExpanded: true, except: [] },
+  };
+  const move = (name: string, to: string) => {
+    startEdit(name);
+    type('Where', to);
+    focusOn(input('Where'));
+    press(input('Where'), 'Enter');
+  };
+
+  it('keeps the place on the row when it goes to another group of the page', () => {
+    render(<Saved {...groupedProps} grouping={[...groupedProps.grouping]} />);
+    move('DH-1', 'Web');
+    expect(editedRow()).toBeNull();
+    expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(document.body);
+    // DH-1 is now among the rows of the Web group, and the cell that has the focus is one of its cells.
+    expect(rowOf('DH-1').contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('falls to the row at the same place when the row goes to another page', () => {
+    render(
+      <Saved
+        columns={channelColumns}
+        paging={{ pageSize: 2 }}
+        defaultSort={[{ field: 'channel', direction: 'asc' }]}
+      />,
+    );
+    // Page 1 by channel: DH-3 and DH-6 (Phone). Moving DH-3 to Web takes it off the page.
+    startEdit('DH-3');
+    type('Channel', 'Web');
+    focusOn(input('Channel'));
+    press(input('Channel'), 'Enter');
+    expect(editedRow()).toBeNull();
+    expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(document.body);
+    expect(table().contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the focus in the grid when the row goes into a group that is closed', () => {
+    render(
+      <Saved
+        {...groupedProps}
+        grouping={[...groupedProps.grouping]}
+        defaultExpandedGroups={{ allExpanded: false, except: [] }}
+      />,
+    );
+    // Every group is closed: open the group of DH-1 (Store) and move the row into the Web group, closed.
+    const groups = Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-group-row'));
+    act(() => groups.find((row) => row.textContent?.includes('Store'))!.click());
+    move('DH-1', 'Web');
+    expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(document.body);
+    expect(table().contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
+  });
+});

+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+      COLUMNS[0]!,
+      dataGridColumn<Order>()({ id: 'half', allowEditing: false, value: (row) => row.price }),
+    ];
+    render(<Orders columns={columns} />);
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        editing={undefined}
+        columns={[...columns, dataGridColumn<Order>()({ id: 'x', value: () => 1 })]}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('turn editing off with a warning for a value that is no object or a mode the grid does not have', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders editing={'row' as unknown as DataGridEditing<Order>} />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'cell' } as unknown as DataGridEditing<Order>} />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).toBeNull();
+    const words = warn.mock.calls.map((call) => String(call[0]));
+    expect(words.some((one) => one.includes('editing is not an object'))).toBe(true);
+    expect(words.some((one) => one.includes('editing has an unknown mode: editing is off.'))).toBe(
+      true,
+    );
+  });
+});
+
+describe('strict mode and a grid in a cell of its own', () => {
+  it('edits and saves the same in StrictMode, with one call for one press', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <StrictMode>
+        <Orders onSaving={onSaving} />
+      </StrictMode>,
+    );
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('does not read a value an editor of a column draws as a node it cannot draw', () => {
+    const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+      COLUMNS[0]!,
+      { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', editor: (): ReactNode => null },
+    ];
+    render(<Orders columns={columns} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    expect(editedRow()).not.toBeNull();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
index 2ddf3ab..6a7662f 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
@@ -17,6 +17,21 @@ const groupRenders = vi.hoisted(() => ({ groupRow: 0 }));
 const footerRenders = vi.hoisted(() => ({ footer: 0 }));
 // And the detail rows.
 const detailRenders = vi.hoisted(() => ({ detailRow: 0 }));
+// The editors of a row being edited: the field of a string column is an Input, drawn by its editor alone.
+const editorRenders = vi.hoisted(() => ({ input: 0 }));
+
+// Counting the Inputs tells which editors draw for a key typed.
+vi.mock('../input/Input', async (importOriginal) => {
+  const real = await importOriginal<typeof import('../input/Input')>();
+  const { createElement, forwardRef } = await import('react');
+  return {
+    ...real,
+    Input: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, Parameters<typeof real.Input>[0]>((props, ref) => {
+      editorRenders.input += 1;
+      return createElement(real.Input, { ...props, ref });
+    }),
+  };
+});
 
 // The detail row is a memo component too: a memo of its own that counts.
 vi.mock('./parts/DetailRow', async (importOriginal) => {
@@ -1549,3 +1564,89 @@ describe('the row handles', () => {
     expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
   });
 });
+
+// Editing (phase 6 Plan F): what a key typed in an editor, the start and the end of an edit and an `editing`
+// written in the JSX draw. The draft is in a store that each editor reads its own field of, and the row being
+// edited is a prop of its row.
+describe('editing a row', () => {
+  const COLUMNS_OF_TEXT: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+    { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104, allowEditing: false },
+    { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+    { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+  ];
+  const editable = (props: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof DataGrid<Order>>> = {}) => (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS.slice(0, 5)}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS_OF_TEXT}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={{ mode: 'row' }}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+  const reset = () => {
+    renders.cell = 0;
+    renders.headerCell = 0;
+    renders.toolbar = 0;
+    renders.body = 0;
+    editorRenders.input = 0;
+  };
+  const edit = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Edit ${name}` });
+
+  it('draws the row that starts being edited and no other, and the row that ends, and no other', () => {
+    render(editable());
+    // The active place is on the cell the edit starts from, so the keyboard moves nothing.
+    const row = grid().querySelectorAll('tbody > tr')[1]!;
+    const customer = row.children[1] as HTMLElement;
+    act(() => customer.focus());
+    reset();
+    act(() => void fireEvent.keyDown(customer, { key: 'Enter' }));
+    // The row has the cells of its three columns and the buttons.
+    expect(row).toHaveAttribute('data-editing');
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(4);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    reset();
+    act(() => void fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByLabelText('Customer'), { key: 'Escape' }));
+    expect(row).not.toHaveAttribute('data-editing');
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(4);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the editor of the field and no cell, row, title or other editor for a key typed in it', () => {
+    render(editable());
+    act(() => edit('DH-2').click());
+    reset();
+    const field = screen.getByLabelText('Customer') as HTMLInputElement;
+    act(() => void fireEvent.change(field, { target: { value: 'Hoa' } }));
+    expect(field.value).toBe('Hoa');
+    // One Input drew, which is the one of the customer; the number is a NumberInput that was not asked.
+    expect(editorRenders.input).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    expect(editorRenders.input).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.body).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.toolbar).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws nothing for an editing written in the JSX that says what it said, and for a handler', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(editable({ editing: { mode: 'row' }, onSaving: () => {} }));
+    reset();
+    rerender(editable({ editing: { mode: 'row' }, onSaving: () => {} }));
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    act(() => edit('DH-2').click());
+    reset();
+    rerender(editable({ editing: { mode: 'row' }, onSaving: () => {} }));
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the rows when the mode of editing is another allowUpdating function, which is another row rule', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(editable({ editing: { mode: 'row', allowUpdating: () => true } }));
+    reset();
+    rerender(editable({ editing: { mode: 'row', allowUpdating: () => true } }));
+    // A function is compared by identity: a new one is a new rule.
+    expect(renders.cell).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGridEditing.stories.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridEditing.stories.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8f8fe25
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridEditing.stories.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,446 @@
+import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
+import { expect, fn, waitFor } from 'storybook/test';
+import { realUserEvent } from '../../../.storybook/real-input';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridProps } from './index';
+
+/**
+ * The orders of E2 (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2, mockup question E): the rows DH-1026 to DH-1030 that the mockup draws,
+ * with a status, an assignee, a channel and a note. The names, dates and figures are the mockup's; the words of
+ * the grid and the captions are English.
+ */
+interface EditOrder {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  assignee: string;
+  date: string;
+  status: 'new' | 'processing' | 'delivered' | 'cancelled';
+  channel: string;
+  qty: number;
+  total: number;
+  paid: boolean;
+  note: string;
+}
+
+const EDIT_ORDERS: readonly EditOrder[] = [
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1030',
+    customer: 'Quán Cà phê Mộc',
+    assignee: 'lan',
+    date: '2026-11-07',
+    status: 'delivered',
+    channel: 'Phone',
+    qty: 15,
+    total: 17800000,
+    paid: true,
+    note: 'Giao buổi sáng',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1029',
+    customer: 'Trần Minh Anh',
+    assignee: 'huy',
+    date: '2026-11-06',
+    status: 'processing',
+    channel: 'Website',
+    qty: 4,
+    total: 5200000,
+    paid: false,
+    note: '',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1028',
+    customer: 'Công ty Bình Minh',
+    assignee: 'lan',
+    date: '2026-11-05',
+    status: 'processing',
+    channel: 'Store',
+    qty: 9,
+    total: 8750000,
+    paid: false,
+    note: 'Xuất hoá đơn VAT',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1027',
+    customer: 'Tiệm Hoa Sen',
+    assignee: 'huy',
+    date: '2026-11-04',
+    status: 'delivered',
+    channel: 'Store',
+    qty: 10,
+    total: 12000000,
+    paid: true,
+    note: '',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1026',
+    customer: 'Nguyễn Thị Hà',
+    assignee: 'lan',
+    date: '2026-11-03',
+    status: 'cancelled',
+    channel: 'Website',
+    qty: 1,
+    total: 890000,
+    paid: false,
+    note: 'Khách huỷ',
+  },
+];
+
+const STATUS_ITEMS = [
+  { value: 'new', text: 'New' },
+  { value: 'processing', text: 'Processing' },
+  { value: 'delivered', text: 'Delivered' },
+  { value: 'cancelled', text: 'Cancelled' },
+];
+
+const EDIT_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<EditOrder>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 110, allowEditing: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 150,
+    lookup: { items: STATUS_ITEMS, valueField: 'value', displayField: 'text' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 130 },
+  { field: 'date', caption: 'Order date', dataType: 'date', width: 170 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 80 },
+  {
+    field: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 140,
+    allowEditing: false,
+    format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND', maximumFractionDigits: 0 },
+  },
+];
+
+const meta = {
+  title: 'Components/DataGrid/Editing',
+  component: DataGrid,
+  // Built but not released until the grid is exported (spec phase 6 §2): hidden from the sidebar of the built
+  // docs, still run by the story tests and shot by the visual harness.
+  tags: ['unreleased'],
+  args: {
+    data: EDIT_ORDERS,
+    rowKey: 'id',
+    columns: EDIT_COLUMNS,
+    'aria-label': 'Orders',
+    locale: 'en-US',
+    paging: false,
+    editing: { mode: 'row' },
+  },
+  parameters: {
+    a11y: {
+      config: {
+        rules: [{ id: 'region', enabled: false }],
+      },
+    },
+  },
+} satisfies Meta<DataGridProps<EditOrder>>;
+
+export default meta;
+type Story = StoryObj<DataGridProps<EditOrder>>;
+
+/**
+ * How long a story waits for the grid to show what a key or a press asked of it: the state changes in the
+ * press, and the commit and the focus it gives come in the engine's next rendering update, which Linux WebKit on
+ * x86 (CI) delivers late. `waitFor` waits one second by default; a late update came within five. Each message
+ * says what was missing, so a late update can be told from one that never came.
+ */
+const RENDER_UPDATE = { timeout: 5000 };
+/** And the listbox of a Select and the calendar of a DatePicker, which fade in (up to ten seconds on that WebKit). */
+const POPUP_SHOWN = { timeout: 10000 };
+
+const tableOf = (root: HTMLElement) =>
+  root.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role="grid"], table[role="treegrid"]')!;
+const rowOf = (root: HTMLElement, order: string) =>
+  Array.from(tableOf(root).tBodies[0]!.rows).find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(order))!;
+/** The cell of a row under the title of a column. */
+const cellOf = (root: HTMLElement, order: string, caption: string): HTMLElement => {
+  const heads = Array.from(tableOf(root).tHead!.rows[0]!.cells).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  );
+  const at = heads.findIndex((head) => head.textContent?.trim() === caption);
+  return Array.from(rowOf(root, order).cells).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  )[at] as HTMLElement;
+};
+const editButton = (root: HTMLElement, order: string) =>
+  root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`button[aria-label="Edit ${order}"]`)!;
+const editedRow = (root: HTMLElement) =>
+  tableOf(root).querySelector<HTMLTableRowElement>('tr[data-editing]');
+const editorOf = (root: HTMLElement, caption: string) =>
+  editedRow(root)!.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[aria-label="${caption}"]`)!;
+const active = () => document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
+const nameOf = (element: Element) => element.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? element.tagName;
+
+/**
+ * Editing a row with real keys (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Năm chế độ"): `Enter` on a cell starts the edit in the
+ * editor of that column; `Tab` goes through the editors, then ✓ and ✕, then out of the grid; `Shift+Tab` comes
+ * back; `Enter` in an editor saves and the focus is on that cell; `Esc` gives the edit up and the focus is on the
+ * cell, never on the page. What a key burst does is not counted: the story asserts what it ends in.
+ */
+export const RowEditKeys: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onSaving: fn() },
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    const table = tableOf(root);
+    // The row height of the grid with its buttons: 45px, the height of E2's rows that hold a button.
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028').offsetHeight).toBe(45);
+
+    // `Enter` on the Customer cell starts the edit, in the editor of that column.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer'));
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'the customer editor has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(editedRow(root)).toBe(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028'));
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1030').hasAttribute('data-editing')).toBe(false);
+    await real.fill(editorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa');
+    await expect((editorOf(root, 'Customer') as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe('Nguyễn Văn Hoa');
+
+    // `Tab` visits the editors in order, then ✓ and ✕, then leaves the grid.
+    const seen: string[] = [];
+    for (let tabs = 0; tabs < 7 && table.contains(active()); tabs += 1) {
+      await real.tab();
+      if (table.contains(active())) seen.push(nameOf(active()));
+    }
+    await expect(seen).toEqual([
+      'Status',
+      'Qty',
+      'Order date',
+      'Choose date',
+      'Paid',
+      'Save DH-1028',
+      'Cancel editing DH-1028',
+    ]);
+    await real.tab();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(table.contains(active()), 'the focus left the grid').toBe(false),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    // The row stays being edited.
+    await expect(editedRow(root)).toBe(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028'));
+    // The focus goes back to ✕ (where the page puts it again is the engine's), and `Shift+Tab` goes on to ✓ and the
+    // editors in the opposite order.
+    editedRow(root)!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-label="Cancel editing DH-1028"]')!.focus();
+    const back: string[] = [];
+    for (let tabs = 0; tabs < 7; tabs += 1) {
+      await real.tab({ shift: true });
+      back.push(nameOf(active()));
+    }
+    await expect(back).toEqual([
+      'Save DH-1028',
+      'Paid',
+      'Choose date',
+      'Order date',
+      'Qty',
+      'Status',
+      'Customer',
+    ]);
+
+    // `Enter` in an editor saves: one call, the changed field only, and the focus is on the cell.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editedRow(root), 'the edit ended').toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(saved).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    const [changes] = saved.mock.calls[0] as [{ type: string; key: string; data: object }[]];
+    await expect(changes).toHaveLength(1);
+    await expect(changes[0]).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'update',
+      key: 'DH-1028',
+      data: { customer: 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa' },
+    });
+    await expect(Object.keys(changes[0]!.data)).toEqual(['customer']);
+    await expect(active()).toBe(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer'));
+
+    // `Esc` gives the edit up: the value goes back and the focus is on the cell.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.fill(editorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Khác');
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editedRow(root), 'the edit ended').toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(active()).toBe(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer'));
+    await expect(saved).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer').textContent).toBe('Công ty Bình Minh');
+
+    // The button starts an edit too, on the first editor; ✕ gives it up and the focus is on its cell.
+    await real.click(editButton(root, 'DH-1029'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.click(
+      root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Cancel editing DH-1029"]')!,
+    );
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editedRow(root)).toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(table.contains(active()) && active() !== document.body).toBe(true);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * The popups of the editors take the first `Esc` (spec phase 6 §6.3): with the listbox of the Select open `Esc`
+ * closes it and the row is still being edited; the second `Esc` gives the edit up. The same with the calendar of
+ * the DatePicker.
+ */
+export const RowEditPopups: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onSaving: fn() },
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    const open = (trigger: HTMLElement) =>
+      document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${trigger.getAttribute('aria-controls')}`);
+
+    await real.click(editButton(root, 'DH-1028'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    // The pointer rests on the button of the press, where ✓ and ✕ are now: a tooltip that it opens takes the first
+    // `Esc` (it is dismissed first), so the pointer is taken off the grid.
+    await real.unhover(root);
+
+    // The Select: opened with a key (Enter would save, as it does in any editor), closed by the first Esc.
+    await real.tab();
+    const status = editorOf(root, 'Status');
+    await expect(status).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowDown}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the listbox is open').toBe('true'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await expect(open(status)?.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true);
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the listbox is closed').toBe('false'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await expect(editedRow(root), 'the first Esc only closed the listbox').not.toBeNull();
+    await expect(status).toHaveFocus();
+
+    // The DatePicker: its calendar is opened by its button, and closed by the first Esc.
+    const calendar = editedRow(root)!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-label="Choose date"]')!;
+    await real.click(calendar);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(calendar.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the calendar is open').toBe('true'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(calendar.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the calendar is closed').toBe('false'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await expect(editedRow(root), 'the first Esc only closed the calendar').not.toBeNull();
+
+    // The second Esc gives the edit up, and nothing was saved.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(editedRow(root), `the edit ended (${active().outerHTML.slice(0, 160)})`).toBeNull(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(saved).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    await expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(document.body);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * Edit is there for a screen reader at all times, and drawn by the pointer, the focus and the active place
+ * (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2): `opacity: 0` at rest, 1 under the pointer and while it holds the focus, and the buttons
+ * of the row being edited are always drawn. The rows are read at rest, with the pointer off the grid.
+ */
+export const RowEditHover: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const opacityOf = (order: string) =>
+      Number(
+        getComputedStyle(
+          rowOf(root, order).querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-action-buttons')!,
+        ).opacity,
+      );
+    // The pointer a story before this one left may be over a row: it is taken off the grid first.
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(opacityOf('DH-1029'), 'Edit is hidden at rest').toBe(0),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(opacityOf('DH-1030')).toBe(0);
+    const button = editButton(root, 'DH-1029');
+    // Hidden by `opacity`, never `visibility` or `display`: a screen reader still browses it.
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(button).visibility).toBe('visible');
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(button).display).not.toBe('none');
+    await expect(button.getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('-1');
+
+    await real.hover(rowOf(root, 'DH-1029'));
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(opacityOf('DH-1029'), 'Edit shows under the pointer').toBe(1),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(opacityOf('DH-1030')).toBe(0);
+    await real.unhover(rowOf(root, 'DH-1029'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(opacityOf('DH-1029'), 'Edit hides again').toBe(0), RENDER_UPDATE);
+
+    // The focus shows it too: a row that holds the focus.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1030', 'Customer'));
+    await real.unhover(rowOf(root, 'DH-1030'));
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(opacityOf('DH-1030'), 'Edit shows in the row that has the focus').toBe(1),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(opacityOf('DH-1029')).toBe(0);
+
+    // The buttons of the row being edited are always drawn.
+    await real.click(button);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editedRow(root)).not.toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.unhover(rowOf(root, 'DH-1029'));
+    await expect(opacityOf('DH-1029')).toBe(1);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * What the stylesheet makes of an editor in a real engine (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2): the cell has no padding and
+ * the colour of a control, the field is flush with it (no border, no radius, no shadow, the height of a control),
+ * the cell that holds the focus draws the frame of the accent with its halo, and the row keeps its 45px.
+ */
+export const RowEditLook: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    await real.click(editButton(root, 'DH-1028'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    const cell = cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer');
+    const style = getComputedStyle(cell);
+    await expect(cell.hasAttribute('data-editor')).toBe(true);
+    await expect(style.paddingTop).toBe('0px');
+    await expect(style.paddingLeft).toBe('0px');
+    await expect(style.backgroundColor).not.toBe('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
+    const field = cell.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-input')!;
+    const fieldStyle = getComputedStyle(field);
+    await expect(fieldStyle.borderTopLeftRadius).toBe('0px');
+    await expect(fieldStyle.boxShadow).toBe('none');
+    await expect(fieldStyle.borderTopColor).toBe('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
+    await expect(field.offsetHeight).toBe(34);
+    // The row keeps its height, and the field is as wide as its cell.
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028').offsetHeight).toBe(45);
+    await expect(Math.abs(field.offsetWidth - cell.clientWidth)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
+    // The cell with the focus: the outline and the frame of the accent with its halo (an inner shadow of two layers).
+    await expect(style.outlineStyle).toBe('solid');
+    await expect(style.outlineWidth).toBe('2px');
+    await expect(style.boxShadow.split('inset').length - 1).toBe(2);
+    // The cell that has no focus has the lines of the sides only.
+    const other = cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Qty');
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(other).boxShadow.split('inset').length - 1).toBe(2);
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(other).outlineStyle).toBe('none');
+    // A cell that is no editor is as it was.
+    const order = cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Order');
+    await expect(order.hasAttribute('data-editor')).toBe(false);
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(order).boxShadow).toBe('none');
+  },
+};

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..42dffbd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { editorKind, fromEditorValue, toEditorValue } from './editor-values';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  placed: string | Date | null;
+  paid: boolean;
+  status: number | null;
+  channel: string | null;
+}
+
+const OPTIONS = {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+};
+const STATUSES = [
+  { id: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { id: 2, name: 'Processing' },
+  { id: 3, name: 'Delivered' },
+];
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'customer' },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' },
+  { field: 'status', lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' } },
+];
+const [customer, qty, placed, paid, status] = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, OPTIONS);
+const ROW: Order = {
+  id: 'a',
+  customer: 'An',
+  qty: 3,
+  placed: '2026-11-05',
+  paid: true,
+  status: 2,
+  channel: null,
+};
+
+describe('editorKind', () => {
+  it('picks the editor by the type of the column and by its lookup', () => {
+    expect(editorKind(customer!)).toBe('string');
+    expect(editorKind(qty!)).toBe('number');
+    expect(editorKind(placed!)).toBe('date');
+    expect(editorKind(paid!)).toBe('boolean');
+    expect(editorKind(status!)).toBe('select');
+  });
+
+  it('is a Combobox above twenty items, and searchable forces one or the other', () => {
+    const items = Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, index) => ({ id: index, name: `Item ${index}` }));
+    const make = (searchable?: boolean) =>
+      resolveColumns<Order>(
+        [
+          {
+            field: 'status',
+            lookup: { items, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name', searchable },
+          },
+        ],
+        OPTIONS,
+      )[0]!;
+    expect(editorKind(make())).toBe('combobox');
+    expect(editorKind(make(false))).toBe('select');
+    const few = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name', searchable: true },
+        },
+      ],
+      OPTIONS,
+    )[0]!;
+    expect(editorKind(few)).toBe('combobox');
+    const twenty = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          lookup: { items: items.slice(0, 20), valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' },
+        },
+      ],
+      OPTIONS,
+    )[0]!;
+    expect(editorKind(twenty)).toBe('select');
+  });
+
+  it('is none for a datetime, which has an editor of the caller or none', () => {
+    const [at] = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [{ id: 'at', dataType: 'datetime', value: () => 0 }],
+      OPTIONS,
+    );
+    expect(editorKind(at!)).toBeNull();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('toEditorValue', () => {
+  it('writes a string as the string, and a blank as the empty string', () => {
+    expect(toEditorValue(customer!, ROW)).toBe('An');
+    expect(toEditorValue(customer!, { ...ROW, customer: null })).toBe('');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a number as the number, and a blank as null', () => {
+    expect(toEditorValue(qty!, ROW)).toBe(3);
+    expect(toEditorValue(qty!, { ...ROW, qty: null })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('writes a date as its ISO day, from a string or from a Date', () => {
+    expect(toEditorValue(placed!, ROW)).toBe('2026-11-05');
+    expect(toEditorValue(placed!, { ...ROW, placed: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5)) })).toBe(
+      '2026-11-05',
+    );
+    expect(toEditorValue(placed!, { ...ROW, placed: null })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('writes a boolean as a boolean, and a blank as false', () => {
+    expect(toEditorValue(paid!, ROW)).toBe(true);
+    expect(toEditorValue(paid!, { ...ROW, paid: false })).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('writes a lookup value as the string of the item value, and a value no item has as null', () => {
+    expect(toEditorValue(status!, ROW)).toBe('2');
+    expect(toEditorValue(status!, { ...ROW, status: null })).toBeNull();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('fromEditorValue', () => {
+  it('gives a string and a number back as they are', () => {
+    expect(fromEditorValue(customer!, 'Bình', ROW)).toBe('Bình');
+    expect(fromEditorValue(qty!, 7, ROW)).toBe(7);
+    expect(fromEditorValue(qty!, null, ROW)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('gives a day back as an ISO day when the row held a string, and null for none', () => {
+    expect(fromEditorValue(placed!, '2026-12-01', ROW)).toBe('2026-12-01');
+    expect(fromEditorValue(placed!, null, ROW)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('gives a day back as a Date when the row held a Date: the midnight of the day the cells show (UTC)', () => {
+    const held = { ...ROW, placed: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5)) };
+    const back = fromEditorValue(placed!, '2026-12-01', held);
+    expect(back).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
+    expect((back as Date).getTime()).toBe(Date.UTC(2026, 11, 1));
+    // The cell reads it as the same day: no zone moves it.
+    expect(toEditorValue(placed!, { ...ROW, placed: back as Date })).toBe('2026-12-01');
+  });
+
+  it('gives a lookup string back as the value the item has, whatever its type', () => {
+    expect(fromEditorValue(status!, '3', ROW)).toBe(3);
+    expect(fromEditorValue(status!, null, ROW)).toBeNull();
+    expect(fromEditorValue(status!, 'nope', ROW)).toBeNull();
+  });
+});

Lỗi hiện ở ô (E2) hay ở `Field` (form, popup), trình sửa có `aria-invalid` và `aria-describedby` trỏ vào một bản chữ ẩn của lời báo trong ô (luôn có, nên được đọc ngay khi focus, trước cả Tooltip). Phát hiện khi lập Plan F, theo OQ 6 (a): form và popup hiện và kiểm mọi cột dữ liệu theo thứ tự của layout (hiện, ẩn, đã nhóm) trừ cột có `form.visible: false`, còn `row`, `cell` và `batch` chỉ sửa và kiểm các ô mà dòng đó vẽ; luật chạy theo thứ tự và luật đầu tiên không qua cho lời báo, các luật sau không chạy; mọi luật trừ `required` cho qua giá trị rỗng; `custom` trả chuỗi rỗng là qua, một luật ném lỗi là qua kèm cảnh báo một lần; hai đầu của `range` được viết như ô viết giá trị (`valueText` của cột).

+## Editing
+
+`editing` turns on editing, and the data stays yours: **the grid never changes `data`**. What the user
+types is held until it is saved, and `onSaving` is told; you change your data and pass the new rows.
+This is built in steps, and only the mode `'row'` is here (a later step adds the others).
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid
+  data={orders}
+  rowKey="id"
+  columns={columns}
+  editing={{ mode: 'row' }}
+  onSaving={async (changes) => {
+    // One change for each row: { type: 'update', key, data, row }
+    await save(changes);
+    setOrders(await load());
+  }}
+/>
+```
+
+`editing` is kept by value, so an object written in the JSX draws no row; `allowUpdating` is a function and
+is compared by identity. A value that is no object, or a `mode` the grid does not have, is no editing, with a
+warning.
+
+| `editing` field | Does                                                                                  |
+| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `mode`          | `'row'`: the editable cells of one row become editors at once, with ✓ and ✕           |
+| `allowUpdating` | `true` (default), `false`, or a function `(row) => boolean`: which rows can be edited |
+
+### Row mode
+
+A column of buttons ends the row: **Edit** on each row that `allowUpdating` says yes to. It is drawn while the
+grid can edit a row (not with `allowUpdating: false`), and a row of the grid is then 45px high (a `standard`
+`lined` one; 4px more than without it, since a button is 28px; a `rowHeight` of yours is used as given). Edit
+is there for a screen reader at all times and drawn when the row is hovered or holds the focus (always where
+there is no hover). It is named `labels.edit(name)`, where the name is the text of the row header column, shown
+or not, and the key when no column is the row header.
+
+Press Edit, or <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> on a cell of the row, and every cell that can be edited
+becomes an editor; the one pressed (the first, from Edit) has the focus. The others show their text. Only one
+row is edited at a time: starting another saves the row being edited first, and stays on it if that save does
+not go through. Nothing of this is in the state of the grid (`getState()`, `onStateChange`).
+
+<Kbd keys="tab" /> goes through the editors, then ✓ (`labels.save(name)`) and ✕
+(`labels.cancelEdit(name)`), then out of the grid; the row stays being edited. <Kbd keys="enter" />
+in an editor saves, and <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives the edit up (the first <Kbd keys="esc" /> closes
+the listbox or the calendar of an editor that has one open). When the editors go, the focus goes to
+the cell of the one that had it, never to the page.
+
+### What is edited
+
+`allowEditing` of a column (`true` when left out, or a function `(row) => boolean`) says which cells. A cell is
+shown as text, in the row being edited too, when its column says no, when it computes its value and has no
+`setValue`, when it is a `datetime` with no `editor`, and when it is a `multiline` string column (the Textarea
+comes with the form and the popup, a later step). The grid warns once for a computed column that asks to be
+edited (`allowEditing`) and has no `setValue`, and for a `multiline` that is not on a string column.
+
+The editor of a column is chosen by its type, and is named by the column's caption (`sm` in a `compact` grid,
+`md` elsewhere):
+
+| Column          | Editor                                                                                                        |
+| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `string`        | `Input`                                                                                                       |
+| `number`        | `NumberInput`, in the grid's `locale` and by the column's Intl `format` options                               |
+| `date`          | `DatePicker`; a `Date` in the row is saved as a `Date` at the UTC midnight of the day, a string as an ISO day |
+| `boolean`       | `Checkbox`, in the middle of the cell                                                                         |
+| with a `lookup` | `Select` up to 20 items, `Combobox` above; `lookup.searchable` is `true` or `false` to force one              |
+| `datetime`      | none: give the column an `editor`                                                                             |
+
+A column's own `editor(ctx)` replaces the default. It is given `{ row, value, setValue, commit, cancel,
+invalid, errorId, mode, size, autoFocus, label }`; `setValue` takes the value as the row holds it. The element it
+returns keeps its own handlers. A computed column is edited through its `setValue(row, value)`, which turns the
+value into the fields of the row:
+
+```tsx
+dataGridColumn<Order>()({
+  id: 'total',
+  dataType: 'number',
+  value: (order) => order.qty * order.price,
+  setValue: (order, total) => ({ ...order, price: (total ?? 0) / (order.qty ?? 1) }),
+});
+```
+
+### `onSaving`
+
+Saving calls `onSaving` once with one `update` for the row: `data` holds only the fields that changed (a value
+typed back to what it was is no change), and `row` is the saved row. A row with no change saves nothing, and
+the edit ends. What `onSaving` returns tells how it went:
+
+- Anything but a Promise is a success at once: the edit ends and `labels.announceSaved` is said.
+- A Promise is waited for: the table is `aria-busy`, ✓ is `loading` and the editors cannot change (a field is
+  read-only, and a Select or a Checkbox ignores its change; none is `disabled`, so the focus stays). When it
+  resolves the edit ends and `labels.announceSaved` is said; you change `data`. When it rejects, or when
+  `onSaving` throws (which warns once), the edit stays with what was typed, and can be saved again.
+- Without `onSaving` a save drops the change and ends the edit, and the grid warns once.
+
+A request ends: when the edit is given up, `editing` turns off or its mode changes, or the grid unmounts, the
+grid stops waiting and ignores the answer. The row keeps the place when your new `data` moves it (sorted,
+grouped or on another page); it falls to the row at the same index when the row is gone from the list.
+

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/edit-context.ts b/src/components/data-grid/edit-context.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..527efcc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/edit-context.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './hooks/use-external-store';
+import type { DataGridEditMode, DataGridEditing, DataGridKey } from './types';
+
+/** The row being edited, as the rows read it: apart from the rest, so only that row draws for a change of it. */
+export interface EditTarget {
+  readonly key: DataGridKey;
+  /** The id of the column whose editor takes the focus when the edit starts; `null` is the first one. */
+  readonly focus: string | null;
+  /** Whether a save is pending: the editors cannot change and the save button loads. */
+  readonly saving: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the parts that edit share while `editing` is on: the mode, the actions (the same functions for as long
+ * as the grid lives, so a row that reads them never draws for their sake) and the draft of the row being
+ * edited, which each editor reads its own field of. The row being edited is not here, but in
+ * `EditViewContext`, which the body reads and hands to each row as a prop.
+ */
+export interface EditContextValue<TRow = unknown> {
+  config: DataGridEditing<TRow>;
+  mode: DataGridEditMode;
+  /** The size the editors are drawn at: `sm` in a `compact` grid. */
+  size: 'sm' | 'md';
+  /** The fields typed in the row being edited; `null` while none is. */
+  draft: ExternalStore<Partial<TRow>>;
+  /** Starts editing the row with this key; `columnId` is the column that takes the focus. */
+  start(key: DataGridKey, columnId?: string): void;
+  /** Sets the value of a column of the row being edited, from what a default editor holds. */
+  setValue(columnId: string, value: unknown): void;
+  /** Sets it from a value as the row holds it, which is what a column's own `editor` gives. */
+  setRaw(columnId: string, value: unknown): void;
+  /** Saves the row being edited. */
+  save(): void;
+  /** Gives the edit up. */
+  cancel(): void;
+}
+
+export const EditContext = createContext<EditContextValue | null>(null);
+
+/** The row being edited, for the body; `null` when no row is. */
+export const EditViewContext = createContext<EditTarget | null>(null);
+
+/** The edit context of the grid the part is in; `null` when the grid does not edit. */
+export function useEditContext<TRow>(): EditContextValue<TRow> | null {
+  return useContext(EditContext) as EditContextValue<TRow> | null;
+}

+
+/**

+ * cell holds several controls, so it is a place with a widget mode and not a cell of one control: it has no

+ */

+}

@@ -1,4 +1,11 @@
-import type { DataGridChange, DataGridDataType, DataGridKey } from '../types';
+import type {
+  DataGridChange,
+  DataGridDataType,
+  DataGridEditMode,
+  DataGridEditing,
+  DataGridKey,
+} from '../types';
+import { isDataColumn } from './columns';
 import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
 import type { FlatDataRow } from './flatten';
 import { isBlank, toComparable, toFilterKey } from './values';
@@ -323,3 +330,58 @@ export function freshRow<TRow>(added: { key: string; row: TRow }): FlatDataRow<T
   freshFlat.set(added.row as object, made as FlatDataRow<unknown>);
   return made;
 }
+
+/** The modes whose editors sit in the cells of the rows (the form and the popup, later, do not). */
+const IN_CELL_MODES: readonly DataGridEditMode[] = ['row'];
+
+/**
+ * Whether a row can be edited at all: `allowUpdating` of the editing (`true` when left out, or a function of
+ * the row), and always for a new row, which is edited whatever `allowUpdating` says.
+ */
+export function canUpdate<TRow>(
+  row: TRow,
+  editing: DataGridEditing<TRow> | null,
+  added = false,
+): boolean {
+  if (editing === null) return false;
+  if (added) return true;
+  const { allowUpdating } = editing;
+  return typeof allowUpdating === 'function'
+    ? allowUpdating(row) !== false
+    : allowUpdating !== false;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether the cell of a column in a row can be edited: the one rule every part asks (the cells, the keys, the
+ * form), none repeats it. Editing is on; the row may be updated (`canUpdate`); the column is a data column
+ * whose `allowEditing` says yes for the row (`true` when left out); it has a field to write, or a
+ * `setValue`; a `datetime` has an editor only when the caller gave one; and a `multiline` column is edited in
+ * the form and the popup, and shown as text where the editor sits in the cell.
+ */
+export function canEdit<TRow>(
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>,
+  row: TRow,
+  editing: DataGridEditing<TRow> | null,
+  added = false,
+): boolean {
+  if (editing === null || !isDataColumn(column) || !canUpdate(row, editing, added)) return false;
+  const { column: given } = column;
+  const { allowEditing } = given;
+  if (typeof allowEditing === 'function' ? allowEditing(row) === false : allowEditing === false) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const writes =
+    typeof given.field === 'string' ||
+    ('setValue' in given && typeof given.setValue === 'function');
+  if (!writes) return false;
+  if (column.dataType === 'datetime' && typeof given.editor !== 'function') return false;
+  // A multiline column is a string column; the option of any other type is ignored (the grid warns).
+  if (
+    given.multiline === true &&
+    column.dataType === 'string' &&
+    IN_CELL_MODES.includes(editing.mode)
+  ) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  return true;
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..34ee9d5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/editor-values.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+import { isNumber } from '../../../internal/number';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+import { isBlank } from './values';
+
+/** The editors the grid makes by itself; a `datetime` has none (its column brings an `editor`). */
+export type EditorKind = 'string' | 'number' | 'date' | 'boolean' | 'select' | 'combobox';
+
+/** The longest lookup a Select is used for: a longer one is a list to search, a Combobox. */
+export const SELECT_LIMIT = 20;
+
+/**
+ * The editor a column gets by its type and its lookup (spec phase 6 §6.3): a lookup is a Select up to
+ * `SELECT_LIMIT` items and a Combobox above, and `lookup.searchable` forces one or the other. `null` for a
+ * `datetime`, which has an editor only when the caller gives one.
+ */
+export function editorKind<TRow>(column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>): EditorKind | null {
+  const { choices } = column;
+  if (choices) {
+    const searchable = column.column.lookup?.searchable;
+    return (typeof searchable === 'boolean' ? searchable : choices.length > SELECT_LIMIT)
+      ? 'combobox'
+      : 'select';
+  }
+  switch (column.dataType) {
+    case 'string':
+      return 'string';
+    case 'number':
+      return 'number';
+    case 'date':
+      return 'date';
+    case 'boolean':
+      return 'boolean';
+    default:
+      return null;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * What an editor is given for the value the column holds in the row: the string of a string column (`''` for
+ * a blank), the number (`null` for none), the ISO day of a date, a boolean (`false` for a blank), and for a
+ * lookup the string of the item's value (`null` for none: the Select's placeholder). The same reading the cell
+ * makes, so what the editor shows is what the cell showed.
+ */
+export function toEditorValue<TRow>(column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>, row: TRow): unknown {
+  const value = column.value(row);
+  if (column.choices) return isBlank(value) ? null : String(value);
+  switch (column.dataType) {
+    case 'string':
+      return isBlank(value) ? '' : String(value);
+    case 'number':
+      return isNumber(value) ? value : null;
+    case 'date': {
+      const day = column.filterKey(row);
+      return typeof day === 'string' ? day : null;
+    }
+    case 'boolean':
+      return value === true;
+    default:
+      return value ?? null;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the editor's value is as the row holds it: the string and the number as they are, a lookup string as
+ * the item's own value (a number stays a number; a string no item has is `null`), and a day as the type the
+ * row held: a `Date` goes back as a `Date` at the UTC midnight of the day (a `date` column shows a `Date` by
+ * its UTC day, so a local midnight would show the day before in a zone east of UTC), anything else as the ISO
+ * day. `row` is the row the value is written to, which tells the type that was there.
+ */
+export function fromEditorValue<TRow>(
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>,
+  editorValue: unknown,
+  row: TRow,
+): unknown {
+  if (column.choices) {
+    if (editorValue === null || editorValue === undefined) return null;
+    return column.choices.find((choice) => String(choice.value) === editorValue)?.value ?? null;
+  }
+  if (column.dataType === 'date') {
+    if (typeof editorValue !== 'string') return null;
+    return column.value(row) instanceof Date ? new Date(`${editorValue}T00:00:00Z`) : editorValue;
+  }
+  return editorValue ?? null;
+}

   return rows ? rows[rows.length + row] : undefined;
 }
 
+/**
+ * What the grid orders itself while a row is edited: the controls of a cell that holds an editor (`data-editor`)
+ * and those of the cell of buttons of the row being edited (✓ and ✕, which are in the Tab order after the
+ * editors). The release of the controls leaves them as they are, and a press on one of these cells, that is on
+ * no control of it, is no press on the row.
+ */
+export const EDITOR_CONTROLS_SELECTOR = '[data-editor], tr[data-editing] > [data-actions]';
+
+/** Whether a cell holds controls of its own that the grid puts where they are: an editor, or the buttons. */
+export const holdsEditing = (cell: Element): boolean =>
+  cell.hasAttribute('data-editor') || cell.hasAttribute('data-actions');
+
 /** The four kinds of row the body draws; a spacer, the skeleton rows and the empty row are none. */
 export type RowKind = 'data' | 'group' | 'detail' | 'form';
 
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/edit-keys.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/edit-keys.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4bb86f9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/edit-keys.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import { hasModifier } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import type { KeyContext } from './grid-keys';
+
+/**
+ * The control of an editor a bare `Enter` is not a save from: a button that is not the trigger of a Select or
+ * a Combobox (the calendar of a DatePicker, ✓ and ✕, the steppers of a NumberInput: `Enter` presses them),
+ * a Textarea (a new line), and any control whose popup is open (`Enter` chooses in it).
+ */
+function savesOnEnter(target: Element): boolean {
+  if (target.closest('textarea')) return false;
+  if (target.closest('[aria-expanded="true"]')) return false;
+  return target.tagName !== 'BUTTON' || target.getAttribute('role') === 'combobox';
+}
+
+/**
+ * The keys of editing, tried before every other handler (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Năm chế độ").
+ *
+ * Outside the row being edited, a bare `Enter` or `F2` on a cell of a row that can be edited starts the edit
+ * and puts the focus in the editor of that column, else the first editor of the row; on the cell of the buttons
+ * they keep their widget mode, and `onRowActivate` is for the rows that cannot be edited.
+ *
+ * Inside it, `Enter` saves (from an editor, or a cell of the row that has no control; not from a button, not
+ * from a Textarea, not from a control whose popup is open), and `Esc` gives the edit up, unless a popup of an
+ * editor is open, which takes that first `Esc`. Every other key of an editor, of ✓ and of ✕ is theirs: the
+ * handler takes it without cancelling it, so neither the widget mode's Tab cycle nor a move of the grid runs,
+ * and `Tab` goes to the next stop of the page, the editors, ✓ and ✕ in DOM order and then out of the grid.
+ * The keys of a cell the user stands on, with no control in it, are the grid's (the arrows move).
+ */
+export function editKeys<TRow>(keys: KeyContext<TRow>): boolean {
+  const { editing, event, row, cell, target, column } = keys;
+  if (!editing || row?.kind !== 'data') return false;
+  const onActions = cell.hasAttribute('data-actions');
+  if (!Object.is(editing.target(), row.key)) {
+    if (!keys.bare || (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== 'F2')) return false;
+    if (onActions || !editing.canStart(row.row)) return false;
+    event.preventDefault();
+    editing.start(row.key, column.id);
+    return true;
+  }
+  const inside = target !== cell;
+  if (event.key === 'Escape' && !hasModifier(event) && !event.shiftKey) {
+    // The popup of an editor is closed by the first `Esc`, which the control answers itself.
+    if (target.closest('[aria-expanded="true"]')) return true;
+    event.preventDefault();
+    editing.cancel();
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (event.key === 'Enter' && keys.bare && !onActions && (!inside || savesOnEnter(target))) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    editing.save();
+    return true;
+  }
+  // A key of a control of the row being edited (an editor, ✓, ✕) is the control's own.
+  return inside;
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-editing.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-editing.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9c06801
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-editing.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,326 @@
+import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { RefObject } from 'react';
+import { devWarn } from '../../../internal/warn';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { applyChanges, canUpdate, rowDiff, savingChanges } from '../engine/edit';
+import type { PendingChange, ShownRows } from '../engine/edit';
+import { fromEditorValue } from '../engine/editor-values';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import type { EditContextValue, EditTarget } from '../edit-context';
+import { focusInto, ownCell } from '../grid-dom';
+import type { DataGridEditing, DataGridKey, DataGridLabels, DataGridProps } from '../types';
+import { createExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+export interface EditingOptions<TRow> {
+  /** The `editing` prop, made safe and kept by value: `undefined` is no editing. */
+  editing: DataGridEditing<TRow> | undefined;
+  onSaving: DataGridProps<TRow>['onSaving'];
+  /** Every resolved column: a value column's `setValue` and the fields a save compares are read from them. */
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /**
+   * The data rows of the list, which a key is looked up in: the grid writes the list of the last commit into it
+   * (the pipeline that makes the list reads this hook's changes, so the list cannot be a plain option).
+   */
+  keyed: { readonly current: readonly FlatDataRow<TRow>[] };
+  data: readonly TRow[];
+  getKey: (row: TRow, index: number) => DataGridKey;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  announce: (text: string) => void;
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+  size: 'sm' | 'md';
+}
+
+/** What the keys of the grid ask of the edit state: the same functions for as long as the grid lives. */
+export interface EditKeyActions<TRow> {
+  /** The key of the row being edited; `null` when none is. */
+  target(): DataGridKey | null;
+  /** Whether a row can be edited (`allowUpdating`). */
+  canStart(row: TRow): boolean;
+  start(key: DataGridKey, columnId?: string): void;
+  save(): void;
+  cancel(): void;
+}
+
+export interface Editing<TRow> {
+  /** What the editing parts share; `null` when the grid does not edit. */
+  context: EditContextValue<TRow> | null;
+  /** The row being edited, for the body. */
+  target: EditTarget | null;
+  /** What the keys call; `null` when the grid does not edit. */
+  keys: EditKeyActions<TRow> | null;
+  /** The unsaved changes over the rows, for the pipeline: only a pending or a failed save leaves one. */
+  shown: ShownRows<TRow> | null;
+  /** Whether a save is pending: the table is busy. */
+  saving: boolean;
+}
+
+type Changes<TRow> = ReadonlyMap<DataGridKey, PendingChange<TRow>>;
+const NO_CHANGES: Changes<never> = new Map();
+
+const isThenable = (value: unknown): value is PromiseLike<void> =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  typeof (value as { then?: unknown }).then === 'function';
+
+/** Whether two `editing` values say the same: the mode and the function (by identity) of `allowUpdating`. */
+export function sameEditing(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
+  if (Object.is(a, b)) return true;
+  if (typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object' || a === null || b === null) return false;
+  const left = a as Partial<DataGridEditing<unknown>>;
+  const right = b as Partial<DataGridEditing<unknown>>;
+  return left.mode === right.mode && Object.is(left.allowUpdating, right.allowUpdating);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The state of editing (spec phase 6 §6.3): the row being edited, what the user typed in it, a pending save and
+ * the one function for each thing the user does (start, set a value, save, cancel). Every way to do one goes
+ * through here: the button, the keys. Nothing of it is the grid's `state`: it is not controlled, and not in
+ * `getState()` or `onStateChange`.
+ *
+ * The draft is in a store that each editor reads its own field of, so a key typed in an editor draws that
+ * editor and nothing else; the row being edited is read by the body, so starting and ending an edit draws that
+ * row. A save reads the draft when it is asked for (never a render's), and a request ends: a Promise that
+ * settles after the edit was ended, the mode changed or the grid unmounted is not waited for.
+ */
+export function useEditing<TRow>(options: EditingOptions<TRow>): Editing<TRow> {
+  const { editing, onSaving, resolved, keyed, data, getKey, labels, announce, tableRef, size } =
+    options;
+  const [target, setTarget] = useState<{ key: DataGridKey; focus: string | null } | null>(null);
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+  const [changes, setChanges] = useState<Changes<TRow>>(NO_CHANGES);
+  const [draft] = useState<ExternalStore<Partial<TRow>>>(createExternalStore);
+  // Counts the edits: an answer that comes after another edit began, the mode changed or the grid went is
+  // not the one waited for. `pending` is whether a save is waiting, read by the next press and not by a render.
+  const session = useRef(0);
+  const pending = useRef(false);
+  // The changes the grid holds, as the last `setChanges` left them: the saved row of a key that has one, which
+  // the list shows over (`keyed` holds the shown row).
+  const held = useRef<Changes<TRow>>(NO_CHANGES);
+  // What the functions below read: the values of the last commit, and the key of the row being edited, which
+  // `start` and `end` write at once so that a press before the next commit sees the edit it just made.
+  const latest = useRef({ editing, onSaving, resolved, labels, announce, tableRef });
+  const current = useRef<{ key: DataGridKey; focus: string | null } | null>(null);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = { editing, onSaving, resolved, labels, announce, tableRef };
+  });
+  const mode = editing?.mode ?? null;
+
+  const reset = useCallback((): void => {
+    session.current += 1;
+    pending.current = false;
+    current.current = null;
+    draft.set(null);
+    setTarget(null);
+    setSaving(false);
+    held.current = NO_CHANGES;
+    setChanges(NO_CHANGES);
+  }, [draft]);
+
+  const end = useCallback((): void => {
+    // The focus goes to the cell of the editor that had it, before the editors go: never to `<body>`.
+    const table = latest.current.tableRef.current;
+    const active = document.activeElement;
+    if (table && active && table.contains(active)) {
+      const row = active.closest('tr[data-editing]');
+      const cell = row ? ownCell(active, table) : null;
+      if (cell && row?.contains(cell)) focusInto(cell, cell);
+    }
+    reset();
+  }, [reset]);
+
+  // A mode that changes, editing that turns off and the grid going each end the edit and drop what was typed;
+  // nothing is sent, and a save that is pending is no longer waited for.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    reset();
+    return () => {
+      session.current += 1;
+    };
+  }, [mode, reset]);
+
+  // The saved row of a key: the one a change was made on while a save is pending or failed (the list shows the row
+  // with the change over it), else the row of the list.
+  const rowOf = useCallback(
+    (key: DataGridKey): TRow | undefined => {
+      const change = held.current.get(key);
+      if (change?.type === 'update') return change.row;
+      return keyed.current.find((flat) => Object.is(flat.key, key))?.row;
+    },
+    [keyed],
+  );
+
+  const save = useCallback(
+    (after?: () => void): void => {
+      const now = latest.current;
+      const edited = current.current;
+      if (!edited || !now.editing || pending.current) return;
+      const { key } = edited;
+      const row = rowOf(key);
+      const typed = draft.get();
+      const diff = row !== undefined && typed !== null ? rowDiff(row, typed, now.resolved) : {};
+      // No change is no save; and without `onSaving` the change is dropped, which the grid has warned about.
+      if (
+        row === undefined ||
+        Object.keys(diff).length === 0 ||
+        typeof now.onSaving !== 'function'
+      ) {
+        end();
+        after?.();
+        return;
+      }
+      const change: PendingChange<TRow> = { type: 'update', key, data: diff, row };
+      const settled = (): void => {
+        now.announce(now.labels.announceSaved);
+        end();
+        after?.();
+      };
+      let result: unknown;
+      try {
+        result = now.onSaving(savingChanges(new Map([[key, change]]), now.resolved));
+      } catch {
+        // A throw is a reject: the edit stays.
+        devWarn('<DataGrid> onSaving threw; the edit stays open.');
+        return;
+      }
+      if (!isThenable(result)) {
+        settled();
+        return;
+      }
+      const mine = session.current;
+      pending.current = true;
+      setSaving(true);
+      held.current = new Map([[key, change]]);
+      setChanges(held.current);
+      result.then(
+        () => {
+          if (session.current === mine) settled();
+        },
+        () => {
+          // The edit stays: the change is kept over the row, and the editors take the keys again.
+          if (session.current !== mine) return;
+          pending.current = false;
+          setSaving(false);
+        },
+      );
+    },
+    [draft, end, rowOf],
+  );
+
+  const start = useCallback(
+    (key: DataGridKey, columnId?: string): void => {
+      const now = latest.current;
+      if (!now.editing) return;
+      const row = rowOf(key);
+      if (row === undefined || !canUpdate(row, now.editing)) return;
+      const begin = (): void => {
+        if (rowOf(key) === undefined) return;
+        const next = { key, focus: columnId ?? null };
+        current.current = next;
+        draft.set({});
+        setTarget(next);
+      };
+      if (current.current === null) {
+        begin();
+        return;
+      }
+      if (Object.is(current.current.key, key)) return;
+      // One row at a time: the row being edited is saved first, and stays when its save does not go through.
+      save(begin);
+    },
+    [draft, rowOf, save],
+  );
+
+  // Writes the value of a column into the draft. `raw` says whether it is the value as the row holds it (a custom
+  // editor's) or what a default editor holds, which `fromEditorValue` turns into the row's.
+  const write = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, value: unknown, raw: boolean): void => {
+      const now = latest.current;
+      const edited = current.current;
+      const typed = draft.get();
+      if (!edited || typed === null || pending.current) return;
+      const row = rowOf(edited.key);
+      const column = now.resolved.find((one) => one.id === columnId);
+      if (row === undefined || !column) return;
+      const held = { ...row, ...typed };
+      const converted = raw ? value : fromEditorValue(column, value, held);
+      const given = column.column;
+      const field = given.field;
+      const compute = 'setValue' in given ? given.setValue : undefined;
+      let next: Partial<TRow> | undefined;
+      if (typeof field === 'string') {
+        next = { ...typed, [field]: converted } as Partial<TRow>;
+      } else if (typeof compute === 'function') {
+        try {
+          next = { ...typed, ...compute.call(given, held, converted) };
+        } catch {
+          devWarn('<DataGrid> a column setValue threw; the value is not set.');
+        }
+      }
+      if (next) draft.set(next);
+    },
+    [draft, rowOf],
+  );
+
+  const setValue = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, value: unknown): void => write(columnId, value, false),
+    [write],
+  );
+  const setRaw = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, value: unknown): void => write(columnId, value, true),
+    [write],
+  );
+
+  const cancel = useCallback((): void => {
+    if (current.current !== null) end();
+  }, [end]);
+
+  // The functions the parts call are the same for as long as the grid lives, so nothing that reads them draws
+  // for their sake.
+  const saveNow = useCallback((): void => save(), [save]);
+
+  const keys = useMemo<EditKeyActions<TRow> | null>(
+    () =>
+      mode === null
+        ? null
+        : {
+            target: () => current.current?.key ?? null,
+            canStart: (row) => canUpdate(row, latest.current.editing ?? null),
+            start,
+            save: saveNow,
+            cancel,
+          },
+    [mode, start, saveNow, cancel],
+  );
+
+  const context = useMemo<EditContextValue<TRow> | null>(
+    () =>
+      editing
+        ? {
+            config: editing,
+            mode: editing.mode,
+            size,
+            draft,
+            start,
+            setValue,
+            setRaw,
+            save: saveNow,
+            cancel,
+          }
+        : null,
+    [editing, size, draft, start, setValue, setRaw, saveNow, cancel],
+  );
+
+  const view = useMemo<EditTarget | null>(
+    () => (target ? { key: target.key, focus: target.focus, saving } : null),
+    [target, saving],
+  );
+
+  const shown = useMemo(
+    () => (changes.size === 0 ? null : applyChanges(data, changes, getKey)),
+    [changes, data, getKey],
+  );
+
+  return { context, target: view, keys, shown, saving };
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/ActionsCell.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ActionsCell.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a4e0c9b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ActionsCell.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+import type { MouseEvent, ReactNode } from 'react';
+import { CheckIcon, CloseIcon, PencilIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { IconButton } from '../../icon-button/IconButton';
+import { TooltipContent, TooltipRoot, TooltipTrigger } from '../../tooltip/Tooltip';
+import type { EditTarget } from '../edit-context';
+import { useEditContext } from '../edit-context';
+import { canUpdate } from '../engine/edit';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import type { PinPlace } from '../engine/layout';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { pinAttributes } from './pin-attributes';
+
+/** One button of the column of buttons: named, with its own tooltip, which says what the name says. */
+function ActionButton({
+  label,
+  children,
+  ...props
+}: {
+  label: string;
+  variant: 'primary' | 'ghost';
+  loading?: boolean;
+  /** `-1` takes the button out of the Tab order: the grid's keys reach it. */
+  tabIndex?: number;
+  onClick: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
+  children: ReactNode;
+}) {
+  return (
+    <TooltipRoot describe={false}>
+      <TooltipTrigger>
+        <IconButton size="sm" aria-label={label} {...props}>
+          {children}
+        </IconButton>
+      </TooltipTrigger>
+      <TooltipContent>{label}</TooltipContent>
+    </TooltipRoot>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The cell of the column of buttons in a data row (spec phase 6 §3.6 "Ô có nhiều control", §4.3 E2). It is a
+ * place of the keyboard with several controls, so it is no cell of one control (no `data-service`): `Enter` and
+ * `F2` go into its buttons, which are out of the Tab order, but ✓ and ✕ of the row being edited, which Tab
+ * visits after the editors. A row no action is allowed on has an empty cell, which is still a place. Edit is
+ * there for the screen reader and the keyboard always, and drawn only when the row is hovered, holds the focus
+ * or holds the active place (`opacity`, never `visibility`).
+ */
+export function ActionsCell<TRow>({
+  flat,
+  isActive,
+  editing,
+  pin,
+}: {
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow>;
+  isActive: boolean;
+  /** The row being edited, when it is this one. */
+  editing: EditTarget | null;
+  pin: PinPlace | undefined;
+}) {
+  const { labels, rowHeader, textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>();
+  const text = rowHeader ? textOf(flat.row, rowHeader) : '';
+  const name = text === '' ? String(flat.key) : text;
+  let buttons: ReactNode = null;
+  if (edit && editing) {
+    buttons = (
+      <>
+        <ActionButton
+          key="save"
+          label={labels.save(name)}
+          variant="primary"
+          loading={editing.saving}
+          onClick={(event) => {
+            // A button that is not focused by a press (Safari) leaves the editor focused, whose text is
+            // settled on blur: the button takes the focus first, so the draft a save reads is complete.
+            event.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+            edit.save();
+          }}
+        >
+          <CheckIcon width={16} height={16} />
+        </ActionButton>
+        <ActionButton
+          key="cancel"
+          label={labels.cancelEdit(name)}
+          variant="ghost"
+          onClick={() => edit.cancel()}
+        >
+          <CloseIcon width={16} height={16} />
+        </ActionButton>
+      </>
+    );
+  } else if (edit && canUpdate(flat.row, edit.config)) {
+    buttons = (
+      <ActionButton
+        key="edit"
+        label={labels.edit(name)}
+        variant="ghost"
+        tabIndex={-1}
+        onClick={() => edit.start(flat.key)}
+      >
+        <PencilIcon width={16} height={16} />
+      </ActionButton>
+    );
+  }
+  return (
+    <td
+      className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-cell flg-data-grid-actions"
+      data-actions=""
+      data-align="end"
+      // While the row is edited its buttons ✓ and ✕ are in the Tab order, so the cell is not a stop of its own.
+      tabIndex={isActive && !editing ? 0 : -1}
+      {...pinAttributes(pin)}
+    >
+      {buttons ? (
+        <span className="flg-data-grid-action-buttons" data-editing={editing ? '' : undefined}>
+          {buttons}
+        </span>
+      ) : null}
+    </td>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The title of the column of buttons: a place of the keyboard with no control, and the words `labels.actions`
+ * hidden in it, which a table header with no name would fail an accessibility check without.
+ */
+export function ActionsHead({ isActive, pin }: { isActive: boolean; pin: PinPlace | undefined }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext();
+  return (
+    <th
+      scope="col"
+      className="flg-table-head flg-data-grid-head"
+      tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}
+      {...pinAttributes(pin)}
+    >
+      <span className="flg-visually-hidden">{labels.actions}</span>
+    </th>
+  );
+}
