diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/editors/CellEditor.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/editors/CellEditor.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f349dae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/editors/CellEditor.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+import { useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
+import { getFocusables } from '../../../../internal/focus';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { Checkbox } from '../../../checkbox/Checkbox';
+import { Combobox, ComboboxItem } from '../../../combobox/Combobox';
+import { DatePicker } from '../../../date-picker/DatePicker';
+import { Input } from '../../../input/Input';
+import { NumberInput } from '../../../number-input/NumberInput';
+import { Select, SelectItem } from '../../../select/Select';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../../engine/columns';
+import { editorKind, toEditorValue } from '../../engine/editor-values';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from '../../engine/flatten';
+import { useEditContext } from '../../edit-context';
+import type { EditContextValue } from '../../edit-context';
+import { focusInto } from '../../grid-dom';
+import { useGridContext } from '../../grid-context';
+import type { ExternalStore } from '../../hooks/use-external-store';
+import type { DataGridEditorContext } from '../../types';
+
+/**
+ * What one editor reads of the draft: its own field, as `read` makes it of the row with the draft over it.
+ * The snapshot is remembered by the draft and the row it was made from, and is the earlier value while the new
+ * one is the same, so a key typed in another editor draws this one for nothing, and a value made anew in each
+ * read (a computed column's) never loops.
+ */
+function useDraftValue<TRow, T>(
+  store: ExternalStore<Partial<TRow>>,
+  row: TRow,
+  read: (held: TRow) => T,
+): T {
+  const kept = useRef<{ draft: Partial<TRow> | null; row: TRow; value: T } | null>(null);
+  const snapshot = (): T => {
+    const draft = store.get();
+    const last = kept.current;
+    if (last && last.draft === draft && last.row === row) return last.value;
+    const value = read(draft === null ? row : { ...row, ...draft });
+    const same = last !== null && Object.is(last.value, value);
+    kept.current = { draft, row, value: same ? last.value : value };
+    return kept.current.value;
+  };
+  return useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, snapshot, snapshot);
+}
+
+interface EditorProps<TRow> {
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow>;
+  edit: EditContextValue<TRow>;
+  /** Whether a save is pending: the editors cannot change. */
+  saving: boolean;
+}
+
+// `String` options an Intl format of the column gives a NumberInput.
+function numberOptions<TRow>(column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>): Intl.NumberFormatOptions | undefined {
+  const { format } = column.column;
+  return typeof format === 'object' && format !== null && !column.choices
+    ? (format as Intl.NumberFormatOptions)
+    : undefined;
+}
+
+/** The editor the grid makes for the type of a column (`editorKind`): the cell edits the value as the cell shows it. */
+function DefaultEditor<TRow>({ column, flat, edit, saving }: EditorProps<TRow>) {
+  const { locale } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const kind = editorKind(column);
+  const value = useDraftValue(edit.draft, flat.row, (held) => toEditorValue(column, held));
+  const set = (next: unknown): void => edit.setValue(column.id, next);
+  const common = { size: edit.size, 'aria-label': column.caption } as const;
+  switch (kind) {
+    case 'string':
+      return (
+        <Input
+          {...common}
+          autoComplete="off"
+          value={value as string}
+          readOnly={saving}
+          onChange={(event) => set(event.target.value)}
+        />
+      );
+    case 'number':
+      return (
+        <NumberInput
+          {...common}
+          locale={locale}
+          formatOptions={numberOptions(column)}
+          value={value as number | null}
+          readOnly={saving}
+          onValueChange={set}
+        />
+      );
+    case 'date':
+      return (
+        <DatePicker
+          {...common}
+          locale={locale}
+          value={value as string | null}
+          readOnly={saving}
+          onValueChange={set}
+        />
+      );
+    case 'boolean':
+      return (
+        <span className="flg-data-grid-editor-box">
+          <Checkbox
+            aria-label={column.caption}
+            checked={value === true}
+            onCheckedChange={(checked) => set(checked)}
+          />
+        </span>
+      );
+    case 'select':
+      return (
+        <Select {...common} value={value as string | null} onValueChange={(next) => set(next)}>
+          {column.choices!.map((choice) => (
+            <SelectItem key={String(choice.value)} value={String(choice.value)}>
+              {choice.text}
+            </SelectItem>
+          ))}
+        </Select>
+      );
+    case 'combobox':
+      return (
+        <Combobox {...common} value={value as string | null} onValueChange={(next) => set(next)}>
+          {column.choices!.map((choice) => (
+            <ComboboxItem key={String(choice.value)} value={String(choice.value)}>
+              {choice.text}
+            </ComboboxItem>
+          ))}
+        </Combobox>
+      );
+    default:
+      return null;
+  }
+}
+
+/** The editor a column's own `editor` makes: it is given the value as the row holds it. */
+function OwnEditor<TRow>({
+  column,
+  flat,
+  edit,
+  takeFocus,
+}: EditorProps<TRow> & { takeFocus: boolean }) {
+  // A column's `editor` was typed for the value of its own field, and the grid calls it with the value it read
+  // from that field, so `any` is the one honest type for a list of columns (as `ResolvedCell` is).
+  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
+  const own = column.column.editor as (ctx: DataGridEditorContext<TRow, any>) => ReactNode;
+  const held = useDraftValue(edit.draft, flat.row, (now) => ({
+    row: now as Partial<TRow>,
+    value: column.value(now) ?? null,
+  }));
+  // The grid's own editors keep the draft apart for each field; this one reads the value and the row as one
+  // object, which is the same while the draft and the row are.
+  return own({
+    row: held.row,
+    value: held.value,
+    setValue: (next: unknown) => edit.setRaw(column.id, next),
+    commit: () => {},
+    cancel: edit.cancel,
+    invalid: false,
+    errorId: undefined,
+    mode: edit.mode,
+    size: edit.size,
+    autoFocus: takeFocus,
+    label: column.caption,
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The editor of a cell of the row being edited (spec phase 6 §6.3): the column's own `editor` when it has one,
+ * else the one its type has. It takes the focus when it appears, if it is the one the edit was started on (a
+ * layout effect, so the focus is there before the browser paints): the first control of the cell, scrolled
+ * into view the least it takes, never by the browser's own scroll.
+ */
+export function CellEditor<TRow>({
+  column,
+  flat,
+  takeFocus,
+  saving,
+}: {
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow>;
+  /** Whether the editor takes the focus when it appears. */
+  takeFocus: boolean;
+  saving: boolean;
+}) {
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>()!;
+  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const root = box.current;
+    const cell = root?.closest<HTMLElement>('td, th');
+    if (!takeFocus || !root || !cell) return;
+    const control = getFocusables(root)[0];
+    if (control) focusInto(control, cell);
+    // Once, when the editor appears: a press on a later render never takes the focus back.
+  }, []);
+  const props = { column, flat, edit, saving };
+  return (
+    <div ref={box} className="flg-data-grid-editor">
+      {typeof column.column.editor === 'function' ? (
+        <OwnEditor {...props} takeFocus={takeFocus} />
+      ) : (
+        <DefaultEditor {...props} />
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

   }
+  /* Editing in the rows (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2). The column of buttons: 72px, the buttons at the end of the
+     cell, 2px apart (✓ and ✕ of the row being edited 4px), 8px from the edge. The cell has the classes of
+     a data cell, so it is a place of the keyboard like the others. */
+  .flg-data-grid-table .flg-data-grid-actions {

+    overflow: visible;

+  }

+    vertical-align: middle;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-action-buttons[data-editing] {
+    gap: 4px;
+  }
+  /* Edit is there for a screen reader and a key at all times, and drawn only while the row is hovered or holds
+     the focus (never `visibility` or `display`, which would take it out of what a screen reader browses), and
+     always where there is no hover to show it. The buttons of the row being edited are always drawn. The row
+     that holds the active place is no case of its own: the place that has the keyboard is the focused cell, and
+     a place with no focus (the first row, before the grid is used) must not show a button at rest. */
+  .flg-data-grid-action-buttons:not([data-editing]) {
+    opacity: 0;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-row:is(:hover, :focus-within) .flg-data-grid-action-buttons {
+    opacity: 1;
+  }
+  @media (hover: none) {
+    .flg-data-grid-action-buttons {
+      opacity: 1;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /* A cell that holds an editor has no padding, and the editor's field is flush with it: the cell is the
+     field (E2). Table's cell paints no background of its own, and a pinned cell that is solid on a scrolled
+     side paints one with seven selectors, so the editor box has the colour too and is above it. */
+  .flg-data-grid-table :is(td, th).flg-data-grid-cell[data-editor] {
+    padding: 0;
+    overflow: visible;
+    background: var(--flg-control-bg);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-editor {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    width: 100%;
+    min-width: 0;
+    background: var(--flg-control-bg);
+  }
+  /* The field takes the width of the cell (an Input is a flex item, as wide as its content otherwise). */
+  .flg-data-grid-editor > :not(.flg-data-grid-editor-box) {
+    flex: 1;
+    min-width: 0;
+  }
+  /* The field of an editor: no border, no radius, no background, no shadow, no outline (the focus is drawn on
+     the cell). The input's own rules have up to five selectors and the focus and open states of Select,
+     Combobox and DatePicker colour the border, so these double the classes to win over them. */
+  .flg-data-grid-table :is(td, th)[data-editor][data-editor] .flg-input.flg-input {
+    border-color: transparent;
+    border-radius: 0;
+    background: transparent;
+    box-shadow: none;
+    outline: 0;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-table :is(td, th)[data-editor][data-editor] .flg-number-input.flg-input > button {
+    border-radius: 0;
+  }
+  /* A boolean is a box in the middle of the cell. */
+  .flg-data-grid-editor-box {
+    display: flex;
+    justify-content: center;
+    width: 100%;
+  }
+  /* The editors of the row being edited have a line down each side (row mode). */
+  .flg-data-grid-table tr[data-editing] > [data-editor] {
+    box-shadow:
+      inset 1px 0 0 var(--flg-control-border),
+      inset -1px 0 0 var(--flg-control-border);
+  }
+  /* The editor that has the focus: its cell has the frame of 2px in the accent and the halo of 18% around it,
+     inside the cell (no clip of the frame cuts it). The outline is transparent in the default theme and is
+     the sign under `prefers-contrast: more`, where the token has a colour. */
+  .flg-data-grid-table :is(td, th)[data-editor]:focus-within {
+    outline: 2px solid var(--flg-focus-outline-color);
+    outline-offset: -2px;
+    box-shadow:
+      inset 0 0 0 2px var(--flg-accent-solid),
+      inset 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--flg-accent-solid) 18%, transparent);
+  }
 }

+// What validation, a rejected save and Delete add (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Kiểm tra dữ liệu", "Xoá", §4.3 E2).
+const RULED: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  COLUMNS[0]!,
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 140, validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }] },
+  {
+    field: 'qty',
+    caption: 'Qty',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    validationRules: [{ type: 'range', min: 1, max: 9 }],
+  },
+  {
+    field: 'placed',
+    caption: 'Order date',
+    dataType: 'date',
+    width: 150,
+    validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }],
+  },
+];
+// The cells only: an Input says data-invalid of itself too.
+const invalidCells = () =>
+  Array.from(editedRow()!.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [data-invalid]'));
+// What the live regions of the page say (an editor may have a region of its own).
+const said = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-live="polite"]'),
+    (region) => region.textContent,
+  ).join(' ');
+const leave = (from: string, to: string) => {
+  focusOn(input(from));
+  focusOn(input(to));
+};
+/** The words that an invalid editor is described by: the hidden copy of the message, in its cell. */
+const describedBy = (label: string): string | undefined => {
+  const id = input(label).getAttribute('aria-describedby');
+  return id ? (document.getElementById(id)?.textContent ?? undefined) : undefined;
+};
+
+describe('validation in the cells', () => {
+  it('marks a field when its editor lets go of the focus: the cell, the editor and the hidden words', () => {
+    render(<Orders columns={RULED} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', '');
+    // Nothing is said while the field is being typed in.
+    expect(invalidCells()).toHaveLength(0);
+    leave('Customer', 'Qty');
+    expect(invalidCells()).toEqual([cellOf(editedRow()!, 'Customer')]);
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
+    expect(describedBy('Customer')).toBe('Customer is required');
+    expect(input('Qty')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid');
+  });
+
+  it('describes the editor of every type by the words of its message: text, number, date, list and box', () => {
+    const bad = [{ type: 'custom', validate: () => 'Bad', message: 'Bad' } as const];
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={[
+          COLUMNS[0]!,
+          { ...COLUMNS[1]!, validationRules: bad },
+          { ...COLUMNS[2]!, validationRules: bad },
+          { ...COLUMNS[3]!, validationRules: bad },
+          { ...COLUMNS[4]!, validationRules: bad },
+          { ...COLUMNS[5]!, validationRules: bad },
+        ]}
+      />,
+    );
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    const row = editedRow()!;
+    for (const label of ['Customer', 'Status', 'Qty', 'Order date', 'Paid']) {
+      // A Select names its button and its list alike: the button is the one that is refused.
+      const control = within(row)
+        .getAllByLabelText(label)
+        .find((one) => one.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true');
+      expect(control, label).toBeDefined();
+      const id = control!.getAttribute('aria-describedby');
+      expect(document.getElementById(id!), label).toHaveTextContent('Bad');
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the words of the first rule that fails, from labels.validation or the rule', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={[
+          RULED[0]!,
+          RULED[1]!,
+          {
+            ...RULED[2]!,
+            validationRules: [{ type: 'range', min: 1, max: 9, message: 'Too many' }],
+          },
+        ]}
+        labels={{ validation: { required: (caption) => `${caption} đang trống` } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', '');
+    type('Qty', '12');
+    leave('Customer', 'Qty');
+    leave('Qty', 'Customer');
+    expect(describedBy('Customer')).toBe('Customer đang trống');
+    expect(describedBy('Qty')).toBe('Too many');
+  });
+
+  it('clears the mark at the next commit of the field, once it passes', () => {
+    render(<Orders columns={RULED} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', '');
+    leave('Customer', 'Qty');
+    expect(invalidCells()).toHaveLength(1);
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    // Still marked until the commit: the words do not flicker while the user types.
+    expect(invalidCells()).toHaveLength(1);
+    leave('Customer', 'Qty');
+    expect(invalidCells()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(input('Customer')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid');
+    expect(input('Customer')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby');

+
+  it('sends nothing on a save with errors, focuses the first of them and says how many fields', async () => {

+    startEdit('DH-1');

+
+  it('saves once the fields pass, with the changed fields only', () => {

+describe('a save that is refused', () => {
+  const alert = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid [role="alert"]');
+  const refuse = (reason: unknown) => vi.fn(() => Promise.reject(reason));
+  const failedEdit = async (reason: unknown, props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> = {}) => {
+    const onSaving = refuse(reason);
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} {...props} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    click(saveButton('DH-1'));
+    await act(async () => {});
+    return onSaving;
+  };
+
+  it('keeps the edit and shows one error alert with the words of the error', async () => {
+    await failedEdit({ message: 'Server is busy' });
+    expect(editedRow()).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(input('Customer').value).toBe('Hoa');
+    expect(alert()).toHaveTextContent('Server is busy');
+    expect(alert()).toHaveAttribute('data-status', 'error');
+    expect(document.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid [role="alert"]')).toHaveLength(1);
+    // Between the toolbar and the main part, outside the frame.
+    expect(alert()!.nextElementSibling).toHaveClass('flg-data-grid-main');
+  });
+
+  it('says labels.saveFailed for an error with no words', async () => {
+    await failedEdit(new Error(''));
+    expect(alert()).toHaveTextContent('The changes could not be saved.');
+  });
+
+  it('says its own words when labels give them', async () => {

+    expect(alert()).toHaveTextContent('Không lưu được');
+  });
+
+  it('is dismissed by its button, and the focus goes to the place and not to the page', async () => {
+    await failedEdit({ message: 'Server is busy' });
+    const dismiss = within(alert()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss' });
+    focusOn(dismiss);
+    click(dismiss);
+    expect(alert()).toBeNull();
+    expect(editedRow()).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(document.body);
+    expect(table().contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('goes at the next save, and the next refusal shows its own words', async () => {
+    const onSaving = await failedEdit({ message: 'First' });
+    expect(alert()).toHaveTextContent('First');

+
+  it('goes when the edit is given up, or editing turns off', async () => {

+    await act(async () => {});
+    expect(alert()).not.toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders editing={undefined} onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    expect(alert()).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');

+
+  it('leaves the focus where it was, and the save button ready again', async () => {

+describe('Delete', () => {
+  // jsdom has no showModal(): a stand-in that toggles `open` and fires `close`, as a browser does.
+  const original = {
+    showModal: HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal,
+    close: HTMLDialogElement.prototype.close,
+  };
+  beforeAll(() => {
+    HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal = function showModal(this: HTMLDialogElement) {
+      this.setAttribute('open', '');
+    };
+    HTMLDialogElement.prototype.close = function close(this: HTMLDialogElement) {
+      if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) return;
+      this.removeAttribute('open');
+      this.dispatchEvent(new Event('close'));
+    };
+  });
+  afterAll(() => Object.assign(HTMLDialogElement.prototype, original));
+  const deleting = (more: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> = {}) => (
+    <Orders editing={{ mode: 'row', allowDeleting: true }} {...more} />
+  );
+  const noConfirm = { mode: 'row', allowDeleting: true, confirmDelete: false } as const;
+  const del = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Delete ${name}` });
+  const confirm = () => document.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>('dialog.flg-dialog');
+  const confirmOpen = () => confirm()?.hasAttribute('open') === true;
+
+  it('draws no button without allowDeleting, one after Edit with it, and none where the function says no', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Delete/ })).toBeNull();
+    rerender(deleting());
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: /^Delete/ })).toHaveLength(3);
+    const cell = cellOf(rowOf('DH-1'), 'Actions');
+    expect(
+      Array.from(cell.querySelectorAll('button'), (button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label')),
+    ).toEqual(['Edit DH-1', 'Delete DH-1']);
+    expect(del('DH-1')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    rerender(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'row', allowDeleting: (row) => row.id !== 'DH-2' }} />);
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Delete DH-2' })).toBeNull();
+    expect(edit('DH-2')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('draws the column for a grid that can delete and not update, with no Edit', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'row', allowUpdating: false, allowDeleting: true }} />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ })).toBeNull();
+    expect(del('DH-1')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('draws none on the row being edited, which has Save and Cancel', () => {
+    render(deleting());
+    startEdit('DH-1');
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Delete DH-1' })).toBeNull();
+    expect(del('DH-2')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('opens one dialog with the title, the name of the row and Cancel focused', () => {
+    render(deleting());
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(true);
+    expect(document.querySelectorAll('dialog.flg-dialog')).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(confirm()).toHaveAttribute('role', 'alertdialog');
+    expect(confirm()).toHaveAccessibleName('Delete this row?');
+    expect(confirm()).toHaveAccessibleDescription('DH-2 will be deleted.');
+    const buttons = within(confirm()!).getAllByRole('button');
+    expect(buttons.map((button) => button.textContent)).toEqual(['Cancel', 'Delete']);
+    expect(buttons[0]).toHaveFocus();
+  });
+
+  it('sends one remove when Delete is chosen in the dialog, and the dialog is closed first', async () => {
+    let resolve!: () => void;
+    const onSaving = vi.fn(() => new Promise<void>((done) => (resolve = done)));
+    render(deleting({ onSaving }));
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    click(within(confirm()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }));
+    expect(sent(onSaving)).toEqual([{ type: 'remove', key: 'DH-2', row: ORDERS[1] }]);
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    // The dialog does not wait for the answer; the table does.
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(false);
+    expect(table()).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
+    await act(async () => resolve());
+    expect(table()).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-busy');
+    await tick();
+    expect(said()).toContain('Row deleted');
+  });
+
+  it('sends nothing on Cancel or Esc, and gives the focus back to the cell of the row', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(deleting({ onSaving }));
+    focusOn(del('DH-2'));
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    click(within(confirm()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(false);
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(cellOf(rowOf('DH-2'), 'Actions')).toHaveFocus();
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    act(() => void fireEvent(confirm()!, new Event('cancel', { cancelable: true })));
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(false);
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('sends the remove at once without the confirm, and the focus goes to the cell of the row', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(deleting({ onSaving, editing: noConfirm }));
+    focusOn(del('DH-2'));
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    expect(confirm()).toBeNull();
+    expect(sent(onSaving)).toEqual([{ type: 'remove', key: 'DH-2', row: ORDERS[1] }]);
+    expect(cellOf(rowOf('DH-2'), 'Actions')).toHaveFocus();
+  });
+
+  it('shows the alert when the delete is refused, and the rows stay', async () => {
+    render(deleting({ onSaving: () => Promise.reject({ message: 'In use' }) }));
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    click(within(confirm()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }));
+    await act(async () => {});
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid [role="alert"]')).toHaveTextContent('In use');
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: /^Delete/ })).toHaveLength(3);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores a second press while the first delete is pending', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn(() => new Promise<void>(() => {}));
+    render(deleting({ onSaving, editing: noConfirm }));
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    click(del('DH-3'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('closes the dialog for good when its row leaves the rows, when editing turns off or its mode changes', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(deleting());
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(true);
+    rerender(deleting({ data: ORDERS.filter((order) => order.id !== 'DH-2') }));
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(false);
+    rerender(deleting());
+    expect(confirmOpen()).toBe(false);
+    click(del('DH-2'));
+    rerender(<Orders editing={undefined} />);
+    expect(document.querySelector('dialog')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('reaches Delete by keys: Enter into the cell of the buttons, then Tab', () => {
+    render(deleting());
+    const cell = cellOf(rowOf('DH-2'), 'Actions');
+    focusOn(cell);
+    press(cell, 'Enter');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(edit('DH-2'));
+    press(document.activeElement as HTMLElement, 'Tab');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(del('DH-2'));
+  });
+
+  it('draws no dialog and no alert for a grid that does not edit', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={undefined} />);
+    expect(document.querySelector('dialog')).toBeNull();
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-alert')).toBeNull();
+  });
+});

+
+/** A rule that every story of an error uses: the customer is required. */
+const REQUIRED_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<EditOrder>[] = EDIT_COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+  column.field === 'customer'
+    ? { ...column, validationRules: [{ type: 'required' as const }] }
+    : column,
+);
+
+/**
+ * The words of an error in a cell (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2 "Ô có lỗi"): the cell is marked when the editor lets
+ * go of an empty required field, the editor is described by hidden words, and the tooltip opens below the cell
+ * while it holds the focus and while the pointer is on it, inside the stage, and closes when neither is.
+ */
+export const EditErrorTooltip: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { columns: REQUIRED_COLUMNS, onSaving: fn() },
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const tip = () =>
+      Array.from(editedRow(root)!.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="tooltip"]')).find(
+        (one) => one.textContent === 'Customer is required',
+      );
+    await real.click(editButton(root, 'DH-1029'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.fill(editorOf(root, 'Customer'), '');
+    await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer').hasAttribute('data-invalid')).toBe(false);
+    await real.tab();
+    const cell = cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(cell.hasAttribute('data-invalid'), 'the cell is marked').toBe(true),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    const customer = editorOf(root, 'Customer');
+    await expect(customer.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');
+    await expect(
+      document.getElementById(customer.getAttribute('aria-describedby')!)?.textContent,
+    ).toBe('Customer is required');
+    // The focus is on the next editor and the pointer is off the grid: no tooltip.
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    await expect(tip()?.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(false);
+    // The frame is the danger colour, whether or not the cell has the focus.
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(cell).boxShadow).toContain('inset');
+
+    // The focus comes back: the tooltip opens below the cell, lined up with its start, inside the stage.
+    customer.focus();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(tip()?.matches(':popover-open'), 'the tooltip opens on the focus').toBe(true),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    const below = () => {
+      const box = tip()!.getBoundingClientRect();
+      const at = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
+      return { box, at };
+    };
+    // The floating layer places it a frame after it opens.
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(below().box.top, 'the tooltip is below the cell').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
+          below().at.bottom,
+        ),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(Math.abs(below().box.left - below().at.left)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4);
+    const stage = canvasElement.closest('.flg-stage') ?? canvasElement;
+    await expect(below().box.bottom).toBeLessThanOrEqual(stage.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 1);
+
+    // The focus goes: it closes. The pointer on the cell opens it again.
+    editorOf(root, 'Status').focus();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(tip()?.matches(':popover-open'), 'the tooltip closes').toBe(false),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.hover(cell);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(tip()?.matches(':popover-open'), 'the tooltip opens on the pointer').toBe(true),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.unhover(cell);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(tip()?.matches(':popover-open'), 'the tooltip closes').toBe(false),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    // A save with the field still empty sends nothing and puts the focus on the editor.
+    await real.click(root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Save DH-1029"]')!);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(customer, 'the focus is on the refused field').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(args.onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  },
+};

+/** The grid of the stories of Delete: the rows are dropped from `data` when the app is told to remove them. */
+function DeletableGrid(props: DataGridProps<EditOrder>) {
+  const [data, setData] = useState<readonly EditOrder[]>(EDIT_ORDERS);
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      {...props}
+      data={data}
+      onSaving={(changes) => {
+        props.onSaving?.(changes);
+        const gone = new Set(changes.flatMap((one) => (one.type === 'remove' ? [one.key] : [])));
+        setData((now) => now.filter((order) => !gone.has(order.id)));
+      }}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * Delete with real keys (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Xoá"): `Enter` on the cell of the buttons goes into them, `Tab` goes
+ * from Edit to Delete, `Enter` opens the confirm with Cancel focused, `Esc` closes it and the focus is on the cell
+ * of the row, never on the page; Delete in the dialog sends one remove and the focus goes to the row now at that
+ * place.
+ */
+export const DeleteKeys: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { editing: { mode: 'row', allowDeleting: true }, onSaving: fn() },
+  render: (args) => <DeletableGrid {...args} />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    const dialog = () => document.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>('dialog.flg-dialog[open]');
+    const remove = (order: string) =>
+      root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`button[aria-label="Delete ${order}"]`)!;
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Actions').focus();
+    await expect(active()).toBe(cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Actions'));
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editButton(root, 'DH-1029')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(remove('DH-1029')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog(), 'the confirm is open').not.toBeNull(), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await expect(dialog()!.textContent).toContain('DH-1029 will be deleted.');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(active().textContent, 'Cancel has the focus').toBe('Cancel'),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    // Esc closes it, and the focus is on the cell of the row.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog(), 'the confirm closed').toBeNull(), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(active(), 'the focus is on the cell of the buttons').toBe(
+          cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Actions'),
+        ),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(saved).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    // Delete in the dialog: Tab from Cancel to Delete, Enter.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editButton(root, 'DH-1029')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.tab();
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog()).not.toBeNull(), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(active().textContent).toBe('Cancel'), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(active().textContent).toBe('Delete');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog(), 'the confirm closed').toBeNull(), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await expect(saved).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    const [changes] = saved.mock.calls[0] as [{ type: string; key: string }[]];
+    await expect(changes).toMatchObject([{ type: 'remove', key: 'DH-1029' }]);
+    // The row is gone and the focus is in the grid, on the row now at its place.
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(root.textContent, 'the row left').not.toContain('DH-1029'),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(tableOf(root).contains(active()), 'the focus is in the grid').toBe(true),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(active().closest('tr')).toBe(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028'));
+  },
+};
+
+/** The rows of E2 as the mockup draws them (names, dates and figures are the mockup's). */
+const E2_ORDERS: readonly EditOrder[] = [
+  ['DH-1026', 'Nhà sách Đông A', '2026-11-04', 'delivered', 40, 32400000],
+  ['DH-1027', 'Phạm Gia Bảo', '2026-11-05', 'cancelled', 1, 890000],
+  ['DH-1028', 'Cà phê Sương Sớm', '2026-11-05', 'processing', 25, 9750000],
+  ['DH-1029', 'Hoàng Đức Long', '2026-11-06', 'delivered', 3, 2100000],
+  ['DH-1030', 'Công ty Thịnh Vượng', '2026-11-07', 'new', 60, 54000000],
+].map(([id, customer, date, status, qty, total]) => ({
+  id: id as string,
+  customer: customer as string,
+  assignee: 'lan',
+  date: date as string,
+  status: status as EditOrder['status'],
+  channel: 'Store',

+const E2_BADGES = {

+  processing: { variant: 'warning', text: 'Processing' },

+  cancelled: { variant: 'danger', text: 'Cancelled' },
+} as const;
+
+/** E2's columns: the six of the crop, the status as a Badge with a lookup, the total read-only. */
+const E2_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<EditOrder>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 110, allowEditing: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 260 },

+
+/** The grid of E2 (a): in a card as wide as the mockup's, 1317px, with the 10px of padding the mockup gives it. */
+const E2Grid = (props: Partial<DataGridProps<EditOrder>>) => (

+    </Card>
+  </div>
+);
+
+/**
+ * E2, crop a (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2): DH-1028 in row mode, its editable cells as editors (Customer focused with
+ * the frame of 2px and the halo, a DatePicker, a Select, a NumberInput; Order and Total as text; ✓ and ✕ 4px
+ * apart), DH-1029 hovered with Edit and Delete 2px apart (the harness hovers what has `data-visual-hover`). Not
+ * as in the mockup: every row is 45px (the owner's choice, OQ 1: the mockup's resting rows are 35.6px), the
+ * action column is 72px and last, the words are English, and the caret is not drawn.
+ */
+export const EditRow: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  render: () => <E2Grid />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (real) await real.unhover(root);
+    editButton(root, 'DH-1028').click();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(editorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'the customer editor has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect((editorOf(root, 'Customer') as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe('Cà phê Sương Sớm');
+    await expect((editorOf(root, 'Order date') as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe('05/11/2026');
+    await expect(editorOf(root, 'Status').textContent).toContain('Processing');
+    await expect((editorOf(root, 'Qty') as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe('25');
+    // Order and Total are text, not editors.
+    for (const caption of ['Order', 'Total'])
+      await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', caption).hasAttribute('data-editor')).toBe(false);
+    await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Total').textContent).toContain('9.750.000');
+    const save = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Save DH-1028"]')!;
+    const cancel = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Cancel editing DH-1028"]')!;
+    await expect(
+      Math.round(cancel.getBoundingClientRect().left - save.getBoundingClientRect().right),
+    ).toBe(4);
+    // DH-1029 shows Edit and Delete, 2px apart, as the row under the pointer does.
+    const hovered = rowOf(root, 'DH-1029');
+    hovered.setAttribute('data-visual-hover', '');
+    const pair = [
+      editButton(root, 'DH-1029'),
+      root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Delete DH-1029"]')!,
+    ];
+    await expect(
+      Math.round(pair[1]!.getBoundingClientRect().left - pair[0]!.getBoundingClientRect().right),
+    ).toBe(2);
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028').offsetHeight).toBe(45);
+    // The columns and the buttons fit the frame.
+    const frame = tableOf(root).parentElement!;
+    await expect(frame.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(frame.clientWidth);
+    await noTitleIsCut(canvasElement);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * The confirm before a delete (outside the mockups: the Dialog's own look): the grid of E2 with the dialog open for
+ * DH-1027 and Cancel focused. The stage is the viewport, as the Dialog's stories have it.
+ */
+export const ConfirmDelete: Story = {
+  parameters: { stage: 'viewport' },
+  render: () => <E2Grid />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {

+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(document.activeElement?.textContent, 'Cancel has the focus').toBe('Cancel'),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await noTitleIsCut(canvasElement);
+  },
+};

 ### Row mode
 
-A column of buttons ends the row: **Edit** on each row that `allowUpdating` says yes to. It is drawn while the
-grid can edit a row (not with `allowUpdating: false`), and a row of the grid is then 45px high (a `standard`
+A column of buttons ends the row: **Edit** on each row that `allowUpdating` says yes to, then **Delete** on each
+row that `allowDeleting` says yes to (see Deleting rows). It is drawn while a button can stand in it (not with
+`allowUpdating: false` and no `allowDeleting`), and a row of the grid is then 45px high (a `standard`
 `lined` one; 4px more than without it, since a button is 28px; a `rowHeight` of yours is used as given). Edit
 is there for a screen reader at all times and drawn when the row is hovered or holds the focus (always where
 there is no hover). It is named `labels.edit(name)`, where the name is the text of the row header column, shown
@@ -1701,6 +1704,74 @@ A request ends: when the edit is given up, `editing` turns off or its mode chang
 grid stops waiting and ignores the answer. The row keeps the place when your new `data` moves it (sorted,
 grouped or on another page); it falls to the row at the same index when the row is gone from the list.
 
+### Validation
+
+A column's `validationRules` is a list of rules, run in order; the first that fails gives the message and the
+rest do not run. Every rule but `required` passes a blank value.
+
+| Rule           | Fails when                                                                            |
+| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `required`     | the value is blank (empty text, no number, no date)                                   |
+| `range`        | a number, or an ISO day, is outside `min` and `max` (either may be left out)          |
+| `stringLength` | the text is shorter than `min` or longer than `max` characters                        |
+| `pattern`      | the text does not match the `RegExp`                                                  |
+| `email`        | the text is not one `@` with a dot after it (loose on purpose)                        |
+| `custom`       | `validate(value, row)` returns a text (the message) or `false` (the rule's `message`) |
+
+A rule's own `message` wins; otherwise the words are `labels.validation`, a record merged one level deep
+(`required(caption)`, `range(caption, min, max)`, `stringLength`, `pattern`, `email`). A rule that throws passes,
+with one warning.
+
+A field is checked when its editor lets go of the focus (to another cell of the page; a popup of the editor
+is part of it), or when the editor calls `ctx.commit()`; and **every cell of the row that can be edited** is
+checked when the row is saved, the ones nobody touched too (a row that changed nothing is not saved, so it is
+not checked). A save with a field that fails sends nothing, puts the focus on the first of them in the order of
+the cells, and says `labels.announceErrors(n)`, where `n` is the number of fields. A field that was fixed loses
+its mark at its next commit, not while it is typed in; the mark of a field whose column has no rule stays
+until the row is saved again.
+
+A refused cell has a frame of 2px in the danger colour (an outline in forced colours) and an icon at the end of
+its editor. The message is hidden text in the cell that the editor is described by (`aria-invalid`,
+`aria-describedby`; a custom `editor` is given `invalid` and `errorId`), and the same words open in a tooltip
+below the cell while it holds the focus or the pointer.
+
+### Errors when saving
+
+When the Promise `onSaving` returned rejects (or `onSaving` throws), the edit stays and one error alert shows
+between the toolbar and the table, with a button that takes it away. Its words are the `message` of what was
+thrown when that is a text, else `labels.saveFailed`; the alert is its own announcement. It goes when it is
+dismissed (the focus goes to the place of the grid), at the next save, when the edit is given up, and when
+`editing` turns off. The focus stays where it was.
+
+Reject with a `DataGridSaveError` to mark the fields the server refused:
+
+```tsx
+onSaving={async (changes) => {
+  const answer = await post(changes);
+  if (!answer.ok) {
+    throw {
+      message: 'Some fields are wrong.',
+      fieldErrors: [{ key: 'DH-1028', field: 'customer', message: 'Already taken' }],
+    };
+  }
+}}
+```
+
+A `field` that names a column the row draws (by id, else by `field`) marks that cell with the message; one the
+row does not draw (a hidden column, another row) adds its message to the alert's words.
+
+### Deleting rows
+
+`allowDeleting` puts **Delete** (`labels.delete(name)`) after Edit, 2px apart, shown as Edit is, on rows that are
+not being edited. With `confirmDelete` (the default) it opens one dialog for the grid, with `labels.deleteTitle`,
+`labels.deleteDescription(name)`, Cancel (`labels.cancelButton`, focused first) and Delete
+(`labels.deleteConfirm`); <Kbd keys="esc" /> and Cancel close it. Delete in the dialog closes it and calls
+`onSaving([{ type: 'remove', key, row }])`; the dialog does not wait for the answer, the table is `aria-busy`
+while a Promise is pending, a reject shows the alert, and `labels.announceRowDeleted` is said when it has gone
+through. Without `confirmDelete` the press sends at once. The focus goes to the cell of the row's buttons when
+the dialog closes or the press sends, and to the row now at its place when your `data` drops the row. A dialog
+whose row leaves the rows shown, or whose feature turns off, closes for good.
+

 ## Props
 
-| Prop                     | Type                                        | Default      | Does                                                                                      |
-| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
-| `data`                   | `readonly TRow[]`                           |              | The rows                                                                                  |
-| `rowKey`                 | `keyof TRow` or `(row) => string \| number` |              | What a row is known by                                                                    |
-| `columns`                | `readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[]`           |              | The columns; a stable array                                                               |
-| `caption`                | `ReactNode`                                 |              | The title and the name                                                                    |
-| `description`            | `ReactNode`                                 |              | What the grid is about                                                                    |
-| `captionAs`              | `'h2'` to `'h6'` or `'div'`                 | `'h3'`       | The element of the caption                                                                |
-| `toolbar`                | `false \| (items) => ReactNode`             |              | `false` keeps the caption only; a function places the items                               |
-| `variant`                | `'lined' \| 'striped' \| 'minimal'`         | `'lined'`    | The look of a Table                                                                       |
-| `density`                | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`  | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                                                       |
-| `rowHeight`              | `number`                                    |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's                                           |
-| `locale`                 | `string`                                    | `'en-US'`    | The language of numbers and dates (see below)                                             |
-| `timeZone`               | `string`                                    | `'UTC'`      | The zone a `datetime` is shown in                                                         |
-| `height`                 | `number \| string`                          |              | The height of the grid; with it the heading sticks                                        |
-| `scrolling`              | `'standard' \| 'virtual'`                   | `'standard'` | `'virtual'` draws only the rows near the view                                             |
-| `loading`                | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | Skeleton rows with no row, a layer over the rows                                          |
-| `rowClassName`           | `(row) => string \| undefined`              |              | A class for a row; a stable function                                                      |
-| `allowSorting`           | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowSorting`                                              |
-| `allowResizing`          | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowResizing`                                             |
-| `allowReordering`        | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowReordering`                                           |
-| `allowPinning`           | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowPinning`                                              |
-| `allowHiding`            | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHiding`                                               |
-| `sortMode`               | `'single' \| 'multiple'`                    | `'multiple'` | Whether a press with a modifier adds a level                                              |
-| `sort`                   | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort, in order (controlled)                                                           |
-| `defaultSort`            | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort at first                                                                         |
-| `onSortChange`           | `(sort) => void`                            |              | Called with the sort a press asks for                                                     |
-| `filter`                 | `DataGridFilter`                            |              | The search and the conditions of the columns (controlled)                                 |
-| `defaultFilter`          | `DataGridFilter`                            |              | The filter at first                                                                       |
-| `onFilterChange`         | `(filter) => void`                          |              | Called with the filter a change asks for                                                  |
-| `paging`                 | `false \| { pageSize?, pageSizes? }`        | see above    | A page's size at first, and the sizes offered                                             |
-| `page`                   | `DataGridPage`                              |              | The page, from 0 (controlled)                                                             |
-| `defaultPage`            | `DataGridPage`                              |              | The page at first                                                                         |
-| `onPageChange`           | `(page) => void`                            |              | Called with the page that is asked for                                                    |
-| `onStateChange`          | `(state, changed) => void`                  |              | The whole state and the part that changed, after any callback of a part of it             |
-| `onRowActivate`          | `(row, key) => void`                        |              | Called by Enter or a double press on a row                                                |
-| `rowReorder`             | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A column of handles that moves rows; see Reordering rows                                  |
-| `onRowReorder`           | `(from, to, position) => void`              |              | Called once for each move: the row `from` goes `'before'` or `'after'` the row `to`       |
-| `editing`                | `{ mode, allowUpdating }`                   |              | Turns on editing, a column of buttons; see Editing                                        |
-| `onSaving`               | `(changes) => void \| Promise<void>`        |              | Called when the user saves, one change for each row; a Promise is waited for              |
-| `selectionMode`          | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'`          | `'none'`     | Whether rows can be chosen, and how many                                                  |
-| `selectAllMode`          | `'page' \| 'all'`                           | `'page'`     | What the box in the title chooses                                                         |
-| `selectOnRowClick`       | `boolean`                                   | see above    | Whether a press on a row chooses it                                                       |
-| `selectedKeys`           | `readonly (string \| number)[]`             |              | The chosen rows (controlled)                                                              |
-| `defaultSelectedKeys`    | `readonly (string \| number)[]`             |              | The chosen rows at first                                                                  |
-| `onSelectedKeysChange`   | `(keys) => void`                            |              | Called with the keys a press asks for                                                     |
-| `remote`                 | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | Server mode: `data` is the page                                                           |
-| `totalCount`             | `number`                                    |              | The rows there are in all, in server mode                                                 |
-| `columnLayout`           | `DataGridColumnLayout`                      |              | The layout of the columns (controlled)                                                    |
-| `defaultColumnLayout`    | `Partial<DataGridColumnLayout>`             |              | Parts of the layout at first                                                              |
-| `onColumnLayoutChange`   | `(layout) => void`                          |              | Called with the layout a person asks for                                                  |
-| `columnChooser`          | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A toolbar button that shows and hides the columns                                         |
-| `searchPanel`            | `boolean \| { placeholder?: string }`       | `false`      | A search field in the toolbar; see Search                                                 |
-| `groupPanel`             | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A tray of chips in the toolbar, and a way to drag a title in; see The group panel         |
-| `filterRow`              | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A row of filter cells under the titles; see The filter row                                |
-| `allowFiltering`         | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowFiltering`                                            |
-| `headerFilter`           | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A funnel on the titles that list the values; see The header filter                        |
-| `allowHeaderFiltering`   | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHeaderFiltering`                                      |
-| `filterPanel`            | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | A bar that says the conditions, with Clear and Apply; see The filter panel                |
-| `grouping`               | `readonly DataGridGroupItem[]`              |              | The levels of the grouping (controlled); see Grouping                                     |
-| `defaultGrouping`        | `readonly DataGridGroupItem[]`              |              | The grouping at first                                                                     |
-| `onGroupingChange`       | `(grouping) => void`                        |              | Called with the grouping a person asks for                                                |

+/**
+ * Whether a row can be deleted: `allowDeleting` of the editing (`false` when left out, or a function of the
+ * row, of which only a `true` answer counts).
+ */
+export function canDelete<TRow>(row: TRow, editing: DataGridEditing<TRow> | null): boolean {
+  if (editing === null) return false;
+  const { allowDeleting } = editing;
+  return typeof allowDeleting === 'function' ? allowDeleting(row) === true : allowDeleting === true;
+}

+  const { allowUpdating, allowDeleting } = editing;
+  return allowUpdating !== false || (allowDeleting !== undefined && allowDeleting !== false);
+}

@@ -385,3 +404,55 @@ export function canEdit<TRow>(

+/** What a rejected save says: the words of the alert, and the cells it marks, by column id. */
+export interface SaveFailure {
+  message: string;
+  fields: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
+}
+
+/** Whether `value` is a text with something in it. */
+const isWords = (value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value !== '';
+
+/**
+ * What a rejected save says (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Sửa dữ liệu"). The words are the error's `message` when it is a
+ * text, else `saveFailed`. `fieldErrors` of the row with this `key` that name one of `columns` (the cells the
+ * row draws; by id, then by `field`) mark that cell, the first message of a cell winning; every other message
+ * (a field the row does not draw, another row) is added to the words. Entries of another shape are left out,
+ * and so are the properties an error only inherits.
+ */
+export function readSaveError<TRow>(
+  reason: unknown,
+  key: DataGridKey,
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[],
+  saveFailed: string,
+): SaveFailure {
+  // A property of the reason; one that only a prototype gives is none, but `message`, which a class of errors
+  // may well keep there. A getter that throws is no property.
+  const own = (name: string): unknown => {
+    if (typeof reason !== 'object' || reason === null) return undefined;
+    try {
+      return name === 'message' || Object.hasOwn(reason, name)
+        ? (reason as Record<string, unknown>)[name]
+        : undefined;
+    } catch {
+      return undefined;
+    }
+  };
+  const message = own('message');
+  const fields = new Map<string, string>();
+  const extra: string[] = [];
+  const list = own('fieldErrors');
+  for (const entry of Array.isArray(list) ? (list as unknown[]) : []) {
+    if (typeof entry !== 'object' || entry === null) continue;
+    const { key: at, field, message: words } = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (typeof field !== 'string' || !isWords(words)) continue;
+    const column = Object.is(at, key)
+      ? (columns.find((one) => one.id === field) ??
+        columns.find((one) => one.column.field === field))
+      : undefined;
+    if (!column) extra.push(words);
+    else if (!fields.has(column.id)) fields.set(column.id, words);
+  }
+  return { message: [isWords(message) ? message : saveFailed, ...extra].join(' '), fields };
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/ConfirmDelete.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ConfirmDelete.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..29c17f8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ConfirmDelete.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import {
+  Dialog,
+  DialogContent,
+  DialogDescription,
+  DialogFooter,
+  DialogHeader,
+  DialogTitle,
+} from '../../dialog/Dialog';
+import type { DeleteAsk } from '../hooks/use-editing';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+
+/**
+ * The dialog that asks before a row is deleted (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Xoá"): one for the grid, after the table.
+ * `DialogContent alert` of size `sm`; Cancel has the focus first, and Esc or Cancel close it. Delete closes it and
+ * sends the delete, which the dialog does not wait for. It goes for good when its row is no longer among the rows
+ * shown, and with the feature (the grid does not render it then). When it closes, the focus goes back to the place
+ * of the grid, which is the cell the button that opened it is in: that button is not drawn until the row is
+ * hovered, so the dialog's own way back would leave the focus on something nobody sees.
+ */
+export function ConfirmDelete<TRow>({
+  ask,
+  present,
+  onClose,
+  onDelete,
+  restoreFocus,
+}: {
+  /** The row asked about; `null` while the dialog is closed. */
+  ask: DeleteAsk<TRow> | null;
+  /** Whether that row is among the rows shown. */
+  present: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  onDelete: () => void;
+  /** Gives the focus to the place of the grid. */
+  restoreFocus: () => void;
+}) {
+  const { labels, rowHeader, textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const cancel = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const open = ask !== null && present;
+  // A row that went while it was asked about: the dialog is closed for good.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (ask !== null && !present) onClose();
+  }, [ask, present, onClose]);
+  // Once, when it goes from open to closed: after the dialog has put the focus where it keeps it.
+  const wasOpen = useRef(false);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (open) wasOpen.current = true;
+    else if (wasOpen.current) {
+      wasOpen.current = false;
+      restoreFocus();
+    }
+  }, [open, restoreFocus]);
+  const text = ask && rowHeader ? textOf(ask.row, rowHeader) : '';
+  const name = ask ? (text === '' ? String(ask.key) : text) : '';
+  return (
+    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(next) => !next && onClose()}>
+      <DialogContent alert size="sm" initialFocus={cancel}>
+        <DialogHeader>
+          <DialogTitle>{labels.deleteTitle}</DialogTitle>
+          <DialogDescription>{labels.deleteDescription(name)}</DialogDescription>
+        </DialogHeader>
+        <DialogFooter>
+          <Button ref={cancel} variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
+            {labels.cancelButton}
+          </Button>
+          <Button variant="danger" onClick={onDelete}>
+            {labels.deleteConfirm}
+          </Button>
+        </DialogFooter>
+      </DialogContent>
+    </Dialog>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditError.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditError.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0c7214a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditError.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+/* eslint-disable jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions -- the box only watches the focus and the pointer of the editor it holds, and keeps a press on its own padding from taking the focus; it is no control. */
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import type { FocusEvent, ReactNode, Ref } from 'react';
+import { AlertCircleIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { TooltipContent, TooltipRoot, TooltipTrigger } from '../../tooltip/Tooltip';
+
+/**
+ * The box of an editor in a cell (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2 "Ô có lỗi"). It holds the editor and, while the field is
+ * refused, the icon at its end (`pointer-events: none`), the words hidden in the cell for the editor to be
+ * described by (always there while invalid, so they are read on focus before any tooltip), and the same words in a
+ * tooltip of the library, below the box and lined up with its start, which is open while the cell has the focus
+ * within or the pointer is on it. The tooltip is controlled and never opens by its own triggers, so it says
+ * what is the matter and not what the control is. The box is the tooltip's trigger and is out of the Tab order, so
+ * a press on its own padding keeps the focus where it is. `Esc` closes the tooltip first (the Tooltip takes that key, as
+ * a tooltip does), and the next `Esc` is the editor's: the tooltip is let go of for as long as the focus stays.
+ */
+export function EditorBox({
+  message,
+  errorId,
+  boxRef,
+  onSettle,
+  children,
+}: {
+  /** Why the field is refused; `undefined` while it is not. */
+  message: string | undefined;
+  /** The id the hidden words have, which the editor is described by. */
+  errorId: string;
+  boxRef: Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
+  /** Called when the focus leaves the box: the field is settled. */
+  onSettle: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
+  children: ReactNode;
+}) {
+  const [within, setWithin] = useState(false);
+  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
+  const open = message !== undefined && (within || over);
+  return (
+    <TooltipRoot
+      open={open}
+      onOpenChange={(next) => {
+        if (next) return;
+        setWithin(false);
+        setOver(false);
+      }}
+      describe={false}
+    >
+      <TooltipTrigger>
+        <div
+          ref={boxRef}
+          className="flg-data-grid-editor"
+          tabIndex={-1}
+          onFocus={() => setWithin(true)}
+          onBlur={(event: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
+            if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setWithin(false);
+            onSettle(event);
+          }}
+          onPointerEnter={() => setOver(true)}
+          onPointerLeave={() => setOver(false)}
+          onMouseDown={(event) => {
+            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) event.preventDefault();
+          }}
+        >
+          {children}
+          {message === undefined ? null : (
+            <>
+              <AlertCircleIcon
+                className="flg-data-grid-editor-alert"
+                width={16}
+                height={16}
+                aria-hidden="true"
+              />
+              <span id={errorId} className="flg-visually-hidden">
+                {message}
+              </span>
+            </>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      </TooltipTrigger>
+      {message === undefined ? null : (
+        <TooltipContent side="bottom" align="start" sideOffset={6}>
+          <span className="flg-data-grid-error-text">
+            <AlertCircleIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden="true" />
+            {message}
+          </span>
+        </TooltipContent>
+      )}
+    </TooltipRoot>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveError.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveError.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..df54228
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveError.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+import { Alert } from '../../alert/Alert';
+
+/**
+ * The alert of a save that was refused (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 E2 "Lỗi khi lưu"): one `Alert` `error` with a
+ * button that takes it away, between the toolbar and the frame. Its `role="alert"` is its announcement, so the
+ * grid's region says nothing more. When it goes while the focus is in it (the button that took it away), the
+ * focus goes to the place of the grid, never to the page.
+ */
+export function SaveError({
+  message,
+  onDismiss,
+  restoreFocus,
+}: {
+  message: string;
+  /** Takes the alert away. */
+  onDismiss: () => void;
+  /** Gives the focus to the place of the grid. */
+  restoreFocus: () => void;
+}) {
+  return (
+    <Alert
+      status="error"
+      role="alert"
+      onDismiss={(event) => {
+        const held = event.currentTarget.closest('.flg-alert')?.contains(document.activeElement);
+        onDismiss();
+        if (held) restoreFocus();
+      }}
+    >
+      {message}
+    </Alert>
+  );
+}

### Task 6: chế độ `cell`

Spec §3.6 bảng phím (`Enter`, `F2`, ký tự in được, `Space` trên ô `boolean` ở `cell`; Tab qua các dòng); §4.3 E2 ô của chế độ `cell`; §6.3 dòng `cell` của bảng chế độ, `startEditAction`, "Chế độ `cell` khi Promise đang chờ", `DataGridChange` (F3); §7 danh sách story. Mockup E2 (b): trái `EditCell`, phải `EditCellError`. Bắt đầu từ commit của Task 5.
- **`mode: 'cell'`**, `startEditAction` (`'click'`, `'dblClick'`): một trình sửa một lúc trong ô; bắt đầu bằng nhấn, `Enter`, `F2` hay một ký tự (thay giá trị, gõ đúng một lần); `Space` và cú nhấn trên ô `boolean` đảo và chốt (OQ 9, F5) (phát hiện 11).
- **Chốt** khi rời ô, `Enter`, Tab / Shift+Tab (qua các dòng; ở hai đầu focus về ô và phím không bị huỷ); mỗi lần chốt một `onSaving([update])` với trường của ô; một hàng đợi khi lần lưu đang chờ; từ chối giữ giá trị trong ô với dáng lỗi.
- **F3:** `row` của mỗi thay đổi là dòng như đang hiện lúc gửi. **F4:** Tab ở grid ảo lộ dòng cửa sổ chưa vẽ như `↓`. **F5:** cú nhấn trên ô `boolean`.
- `flushSync` cho Tab trong Firefox (chấp nhận, có chú thích). Cột thao tác ở `cell` chỉ có Xoá (OQ 7; `hasEditButton`).
- Story: `CellEditKeys`, `CellEditPopupKeys` (`no-visual`), `EditCell`, `EditCellError` (1280×720). Spec §3.6, §6.3 sửa (phát hiện 24).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.cell-edit.test.tsx`
- Modify: `src/components/data-grid/types.ts`, `normalize.ts`, `edit-context.ts`, `grid-dom.ts`, `engine/edit.ts`, `engine/edit.test.ts`, `editing.test-d.ts`, `hooks/edit-keys.ts`, `hooks/grid-pointer.ts`, `hooks/use-editing.ts`, `parts/ActionsCell.tsx`, `parts/Cell.tsx`, `parts/DataRow.tsx`, `parts/editors/CellEditor.tsx`, `DataGrid.mdx`, `DataGrid.editing.test.tsx`, `DataGrid.renders.test.tsx`, `DataGrid.virtual.test.tsx`, `DataGridEditing.stories.tsx`; `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md`
