+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { WARN_PREFIX, resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridChange, DataGridColumn, DataGridProps } from './index';
+
+// Cell mode (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Năm chế độ", "Chế độ `cell` khi Promise đang chờ", §3.6): the cell that is the one
+// editor, the ways to start, `Tab` across the rows, one `onSaving` for each commit, and the queue while a save is
+// pending. What needs a real engine (focus in a browser, the look) is proven in the stories.
+
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  status: number | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  paid: boolean;
+  price: number;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { id: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { id: 2, name: 'Processing' },
+];
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', customer: 'An', status: 1, qty: 3, paid: false, price: 10 },
+  { id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Bình', status: 2, qty: 5, paid: true, price: 20 },
+  { id: 'DH-3', customer: 'Chi', status: 1, qty: 1, paid: false, price: 30 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, allowEditing: false, width: 100 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 140 },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 140,
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 80 },
+  {
+    id: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    value: (row) => row.price * (row.qty ?? 0),
+  },
+];
+
+const REQUIRED: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+  column.field === 'customer'
+    ? { ...column, validationRules: [{ type: 'required' as const }] }
+    : column,
+);
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={{ mode: 'cell' }}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const rowOf = (name: string) => dataRows().find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const cellOf = (row: HTMLElement, caption: string): HTMLElement => {
+  const heads = Array.from(table().querySelectorAll('thead th')).map((head) => head.textContent);
+  return Array.from(row.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > td, :scope > th')).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  )[heads.filter((head) => head !== '').indexOf(caption)]!;
+};
+const cell = (name: string, caption: string) => cellOf(rowOf(name), caption);
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, {
+    key: pressed,
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    ...init,
+  });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const clickOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => void fireEvent.click(element));
+const editors = () => Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('td[data-editor]'));
+const input = (label: string) => within(table()).getByLabelText(label) as HTMLInputElement;
+const type = (label: string, text: string) =>
+  act(() => void fireEvent.change(input(label), { target: { value: text } }));
+const sentAt = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>, call = 0): DataGridChange<Order>[] =>
+  spy.mock.calls[call]![0] as DataGridChange<Order>[];
+/** A promise the test settles. */
+function deferred() {
+  let resolve!: () => void;
+  let reject!: (reason: unknown) => void;
+  const promise = new Promise<void>((yes, no) => {
+    resolve = yes;
+    reject = no;
+  });
+  return { promise, resolve, reject };
+}
+const flush = () => act(async () => {});
+
+describe('the cell that is edited', () => {
+  it('is the one editor: a cell with data-editing, no editing row, no side lines, no buttons of a row', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-2', 'Customer')]);
+    expect(cell('DH-2', 'Customer')).toHaveAttribute('data-editing');
+    expect(table().querySelector('tr[data-editing]')).toBeNull();
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(input('Customer').value).toBe('Bình');
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^(Edit|Save|Cancel editing)/ })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('draws no column of buttons without allowDeleting, and Delete alone with it', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+    expect(table().querySelector('.flg-data-grid-actions')).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'cell', allowDeleting: true }} />);
+    const buttons = Array.from(
+      cellOf(rowOf('DH-1'), 'Actions').querySelectorAll('button'),
+      (button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label'),
+    );
+    expect(buttons).toEqual(['Delete DH-1']);
+  });
+
+  it('is not a cell that cannot be edited: a read-only cell, a value column with no setValue, the buttons', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'cell', allowDeleting: true }} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Order'));
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Total'));
+    clickOn(cellOf(rowOf('DH-1'), 'Actions'));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('is not a cell of a row that allowUpdating refuses', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'cell', allowUpdating: (row) => row.id !== 'DH-2' }} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('starting', () => {
+  it('a press does it, chooses no row and activates nothing', () => {
+    const onRowActivate = vi.fn();
+    const onSelectedKeysChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        selectionMode="single"
+        onSelectedKeysChange={onSelectedKeysChange}
+        onRowActivate={onRowActivate}
+      />,
+    );
+    const customer = cell('DH-1', 'Customer');
+    clickOn(customer);
+    act(() => void fireEvent.doubleClick(customer));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([customer]);
+    expect(onSelectedKeysChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(onRowActivate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    // A press on a cell that cannot be edited is the row's, as before.
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Order'));
+    expect(onSelectedKeysChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('with startEditAction dblClick the first press only places, and the double press opens one editor', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'cell', startEditAction: 'dblClick' }} />);
+    const customer = cell('DH-1', 'Customer');
+    clickOn(customer);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    act(() => void fireEvent.doubleClick(customer));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([customer]);
+    expect(table().querySelectorAll('input[aria-label="Customer"]')).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('Enter and F2 keep the value, with the caret at its end', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    expect(press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), 'Enter')).toBe(true);
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(input('Customer').value).toBe('An');
+    expect(input('Customer').selectionStart).toBe(2);
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Escape');
+    focusOn(cell('DH-2', 'Qty'));
+    press(cell('DH-2', 'Qty'), 'F2');
+    expect(input('Qty')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-2', 'Qty')]);
+  });
+
+  it('a character replaces the value, and is typed once', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    expect(press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), 'x')).toBe(true);
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(input('Customer').value).toBe('x');
+  });
+
+  it('a character does nothing on a Select cell, with a modifier, or as an arrow, and Space on text is not one', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Status'));
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Status'), 'p');
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), 'x', { ctrlKey: true });
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), 'x', { metaKey: true });
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), 'ArrowDown');
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), ' ');
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('a press on a boolean cell toggles and commits it, as Space does: one call, no editor, no row chosen', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    const onSelectedKeysChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        onSaving={onSaving}
+        selectionMode="single"
+        onSelectedKeysChange={onSelectedKeysChange}
+      />,
+    );
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Paid'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving)).toMatchObject([{ type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { paid: true } }]);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(onSelectedKeysChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('with startEditAction dblClick a boolean cell is toggled by the double press, once', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} editing={{ mode: 'cell', startEditAction: 'dblClick' }} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Paid'));
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    act(() => void fireEvent.doubleClick(cell('DH-1', 'Paid')));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('Space on a boolean cell toggles and commits it, and chooses no row; on any other cell it chooses', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    const onSelectedKeysChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        onSaving={onSaving}
+        selectionMode="single"
+        onSelectedKeysChange={onSelectedKeysChange}
+      />,
+    );
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Paid'));
+    expect(press(cell('DH-1', 'Paid'), ' ')).toBe(true);
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving)).toMatchObject([{ type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { paid: true } }]);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(onSelectedKeysChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    focusOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    press(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'), ' ');
+    expect(onSelectedKeysChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('committing', () => {
+  it('Enter sends one update with the changed field, closes the editor and keeps the focus on the cell', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    expect(press(input('Customer'), 'Enter')).toBe(true);
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving)).toEqual([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1', data: { customer: 'Hoa' }, row: ORDERS[0] },
+    ]);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+  });
+
+  it('leaving the cell commits it, once, and a value equal to the saved one sends nothing', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    focusOn(cell('DH-3', 'Order'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Khác');
+    type('Customer', 'Bình');
+    focusOn(cell('DH-3', 'Order'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Qty'));
+    press(input('Qty'), 'Enter');
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('pressing another cell commits the first and opens the second', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    focusOn(cell('DH-2', 'Qty'));
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Qty'));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-2', 'Qty')]);
+  });
+
+  it('Esc gives the value back, sends nothing, and keeps the focus on the cell', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    expect(press(input('Customer'), 'Escape')).toBe(true);
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveTextContent('An');
+  });
+
+  it('does not send a commit that fails its rules: the editor stays, with its error', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} columns={REQUIRED} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', '');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveAttribute('data-invalid');
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Customer is required');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('Tab', () => {
+  it('commits the cell and opens the next editable one, across the rows, skipping what cannot be edited', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Qty'));
+    type('Qty', '7');
+    expect(press(input('Qty'), 'Tab')).toBe(true);
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    // Paid is next, then the row below: Order and Total are not editable.
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Paid')]);
+    const box = within(editors()[0]!).getByRole('checkbox');
+    expect(box).toHaveFocus();
+    press(box, 'Tab');
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-2', 'Customer')]);
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+    // Shift+Tab goes back across the row boundary.
+    expect(press(input('Customer'), 'Tab', { shiftKey: true })).toBe(true);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Paid')]);
+  });
+
+  it('at the last editable cell commits, puts the focus on the cell and does not cancel the key', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    focusOn(cell('DH-3', 'Paid'));
+    press(cell('DH-3', 'Paid'), 'Enter');
+    const box = within(editors()[0]!).getByRole('checkbox');
+    act(() => void fireEvent.click(box));
+    expect(press(box, 'Tab')).toBe(false);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(cell('DH-3', 'Paid')).toHaveFocus();
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('before the first editable cell does the same with Shift+Tab', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    expect(press(input('Customer'), 'Tab', { shiftKey: true })).toBe(false);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+  });
+
+  it('stays on the cell, with its error, when the commit fails its rules', () => {
+    render(<Orders columns={REQUIRED} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', '');
+    expect(press(input('Customer'), 'Tab')).toBe(true);
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveAttribute('data-invalid');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('while a save is pending', () => {
+  it('shows the value in its cell and sends the next commit after the answer, in order', async () => {
+    const first = deferred();
+    const second = deferred();
+    const onSaving = vi.fn().mockReturnValueOnce(first.promise).mockReturnValueOnce(second.promise);
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    // The value is shown while the answer is awaited, and the grid can be edited on.
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveTextContent('Hoa');
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-2', 'Customer')]);
+    type('Customer', 'Lan');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    // Queued: nothing is sent yet, and the row shows its value.
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(cell('DH-2', 'Customer')).toHaveTextContent('Lan');
+    await act(async () => first.resolve());
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 0)).toMatchObject([{ key: 'DH-1', data: { customer: 'Hoa' } }]);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 1)).toMatchObject([{ key: 'DH-2', data: { customer: 'Lan' } }]);
+    await act(async () => second.resolve());
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+  });
+
+  it('sends each queued commit of one row with its own field', async () => {
+    const first = deferred();
+    const onSaving = vi.fn().mockReturnValueOnce(first.promise);
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Tab');
+    // Status is a Select: leave it as it is, then the quantity.
+    press(within(editors()[0]!).getByRole('combobox'), 'Tab');
+    type('Qty', '9');
+    press(input('Qty'), 'Enter');
+    await act(async () => first.resolve());
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 1)).toMatchObject([{ key: 'DH-1', data: { qty: 9 } }]);
+    expect(Object.keys((sentAt(onSaving, 1)[0] as { data: object }).data)).toEqual(['qty']);
+  });
+
+  it('sends each commit with the row as it is shown then: the commits before it are in its row', async () => {
+    const first = deferred();
+    const second = deferred();
+    const onSaving = vi.fn().mockReturnValueOnce(first.promise).mockReturnValueOnce(second.promise);
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Tab');
+    press(within(editors()[0]!).getByRole('combobox'), 'Tab');
+    type('Qty', '9');
+    press(input('Qty'), 'Enter');
+    // Two commits of one row, the first still pending: the second is sent after the answer, over the first.
+    await act(async () => first.resolve());
+    const [change] = sentAt(onSaving, 1) as unknown as [{ data: Partial<Order>; row: Order }];
+    expect(change.row).toMatchObject({ customer: 'Hoa', qty: 3 });
+    expect({ ...change.row, ...change.data }).toMatchObject({ customer: 'Hoa', qty: 9 });
+    await act(async () => second.resolve());
+    // Once the queue is empty a new commit is over the row the app holds.
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Mai');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 2)).toMatchObject([{ row: { customer: 'An', qty: 3 } }]);
+  });
+
+  it('puts a refused value back in its cell with the words of the error and the alert', async () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn(() => Promise.reject({ message: 'Server is busy' }));
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    await flush();
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+    expect(input('Customer').value).toBe('Hoa');
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveAttribute('data-invalid');
+    expect(input('Customer')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Server is busy');
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid [role="alert"]')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'Server is busy',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('sends the refused value again on Enter, and drops it on Esc', async () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn(() => Promise.reject({ message: 'No' }));
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    await flush();
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 1)).toMatchObject([{ key: 'DH-1', data: { customer: 'Hoa' } }]);
+    await flush();
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+    // The first Esc closes the tooltip of the error, which the Tooltip takes; the second drops the value.
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Escape');
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([cell('DH-1', 'Customer')]);
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Escape');
+    expect(editors()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(cell('DH-1', 'Customer')).toHaveTextContent('An');
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid [role="alert"]')).toBeNull();
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+  });
+
+  it('goes on with the queue after a refusal', async () => {
+    const first = deferred();
+    const onSaving = vi
+      .fn()
+      .mockReturnValueOnce(first.promise)
+      .mockReturnValueOnce(Promise.resolve());
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Lan');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    await act(async () => first.reject({ message: 'No' }));
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(sentAt(onSaving, 1)).toMatchObject([{ key: 'DH-2' }]);
+  });
+
+  it('is dropped with the feature: nothing is sent after editing turns off', async () => {
+    const first = deferred();
+    const onSaving = vi.fn().mockReturnValue(first.promise);
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    clickOn(cell('DH-1', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Hoa');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    clickOn(cell('DH-2', 'Customer'));
+    type('Customer', 'Lan');
+    press(input('Customer'), 'Enter');
+    rerender(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} editing={undefined} />);
+    await act(async () => first.resolve());
+    expect(onSaving).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the warnings', () => {
+  it('cell is a mode the grid has: it does not warn of an unknown mode', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(warn.mock.calls.filter(([text]) => String(text).includes(WARN_PREFIX))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+function Between(props: DataGridProps<EditOrder>) {

+/**

+ * at the end; `Enter` on a cell starts it and a character opens it with that character as its text, typed once;
+ * `Tab` commits the cell and opens the next one that can be edited, across the rows, and each commit is one

+ * does is not counted: the story asserts what it ends in.

@@ -1653,6 +1655,43 @@ in an editor saves, and <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives the edit up (the first <Kbd key
 the listbox or the calendar of an editor that has one open). When the editors go, the focus goes to
 the cell of the one that had it, never to the page.
 
+### Cell mode
+
+`mode: 'cell'` edits one cell at a time. There is no Edit button, so the column of buttons is drawn only with
+`allowDeleting` (Delete alone, shown on the row that is hovered or holds the focus); without it the rows are
+as high as the rows of a grid with no editing. The one cell that is edited is an editor with the frame of
+the focus and no lines at its sides (the lines are the sign of a row).
+
+A cell is started by a press (`startEditAction: 'click'`, the default; `'dblClick'`: the first press only
+places the focus and the double press starts the edit), by <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> (the value
+is kept and the caret is at its end), or by typing a character: an editor with a text field (a string, a
+number, a date, a lookup that is searched) opens with that character as its text, typed once; on a Select or
+a Checkbox a character does nothing. A press on a cell that can be edited chooses no row and activates none
+(`onRowActivate` is for the rows and the cells that cannot be edited). A press on a boolean cell, and
+
+<Kbd keys="space" /> on it, flip it and save it, with no editor opened and no row chosen (with
+`startEditAction: 'dblClick'` the double press flips it, once; <Kbd keys="enter" /> and
+<Kbd keys="f2" /> open its Checkbox); on any other cell <Kbd keys="space" /> chooses the row as it
+did.
+
+A cell is saved when it is left: the focus goes anywhere else, <Kbd keys="enter" /> (the editor closes and the
+focus stays on the cell), or <Kbd keys="tab" /> and <Kbd keys="shift+tab" />, which save it and open the next
+or the previous cell that can be edited, across the rows. At the last editable cell <Kbd keys="tab" /> saves it,
+leaves the focus on the cell and goes on out of the grid; <Kbd keys="shift+tab" /> does the same before the
+first. <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives the value up and the focus stays on the cell (the first <Kbd keys="esc" />
+closes a popup of the editor, and the tooltip of an error). Nothing is sent when the value is the one the cell
+shows. A value that fails its rules is not sent: the editor stays open with the error look.
+
+**Each save is one `onSaving`**, with one `update` that holds only the fields of that cell. While a
+Promise is pending the grid can be edited on: the cell shows its new value, and the next saves wait
+and are sent one after the other, in order. The `row` of each `update` is the row as the grid shows
+it when that save is sent: the saved row with the saves sent before it, so `{ ...row, ...data }` is
+the whole new row and never reverts an earlier cell of the same row. When a save is refused, the
+value goes back into its cell with the error look and the words of the error (the field the error
+names, else the error's `message`, else `labels.saveFailed`) and the alert shows too; <Kbd keys="enter" />
+there sends it again and <Kbd keys="esc" /> drops it; the saves that wait go on. If another cell is being edited at that moment the refused value is only in the alert. Turning
+`editing` off or changing its mode drops what waits.
+

Mockup: nút thêm của G1, dấu dòng mới của E2 (c) (ảnh ở Task 8). Bắt đầu từ commit của Task 6.
- **`allowAdding`**, `newRowPosition`, prop `initNewRow`, mục thanh công cụ `addButton` (nút `primary` `md` cuối thanh), handle `addRow()`; khoá `flg-new-N` duy nhất suốt đời grid (phát hiện 12).
- **`row`**: dòng mới mở ở chế độ sửa; ✓ gửi một `insert`, ✕ bỏ. **`cell`** (OQ 8): lần chốt chỉ điền; một `insert` khi vị trí rời dòng, ở Tab ra khỏi grid và khi focus rời grid (F6); dòng mới không giữ gì bị bỏ.

 ### Row mode
 
@@ -1811,6 +1813,35 @@ through. Without `confirmDelete` the press sends at once. The focus goes to the
 the dialog closes or the press sends, and to the row now at its place when your `data` drops the row. A dialog
 whose row leaves the rows shown, or whose feature turns off, closes for good.
 
+### Adding rows
+
+`allowAdding` puts the **Add row** button (`labels.addRow`, a primary `md` button with a plus) last in the toolbar, and
+enables `ref.current.addRow()`, which does the same and does nothing without `allowAdding`. A new row is a row of
+the grid that is not in `data`: its key is `flg-new-1`, `flg-new-2`, … (a counter of the grid that never gives a
+number twice; a key of `data` that equals one is skipped, with a warning), and it is edited whatever
+`allowUpdating` says. `labels.announceRowAdded` is said.
+
+- **Where it stands.** At the top of the page shown (`newRowPosition: 'first'`) or at its bottom (`'last'`), outside
+  every group, whatever the sort; the search and the filter keep it. It stands on every page and is **not
+  counted**: the pager, the "rows found" sentence and "select all" read the rows of `data`
+  only. It has no box, no handle and no detail button (their cells are empty and still places of the keyboard),
+  and <Kbd keys="space" />, a press, a double press and <Kbd keys="enter" /> never choose, move or activate it.
+- **Its fields.** `initNewRow()` gives the fields it starts with; it is read each time a row is added (never kept from
+  the first render), a throw is caught and warned once, and the row then starts empty. The cells that no editor
+  holds say "+ (new)" (`labels.newRow`) in the row header's cell, and a dash where a read-only cell has nothing to
+  show.
+- **Row mode.** The row opens in edit mode with the focus in its first editor. ✓ and <Kbd keys="enter" /> call
+  `onSaving([{ type: 'insert', key, data }])` with the fields `initNewRow()` gave and the ones that were set, after
+  every cell the row draws has been checked; ✕ and <Kbd keys="esc" /> drop the row and send nothing. Adding while a row
+  is edited saves that row first, and adds none if that save does not go through (one row at a time). A grid that
+  only adds (`allowUpdating: false`) still has the column of buttons, for ✓ and ✕.
+- **Cell mode.** The first cell that can be edited opens. The commits of its cells only fill the row; it is sent as
+  one `insert` when the place of the keyboard leaves the row, when another cell is started, when another row is
+  added, or when <Kbd keys="tab" /> leaves the grid after the last cell, once the fields it draws have been
+  checked (a row that fails keeps the place, with the editor of the first failing cell open and marked). A row that
+  was given nothing is dropped, never sent. A refused insert keeps the row, with the alert, and is sent again the
+  next time the place leaves it. With `allowDeleting`, Delete gives a new row up with no question.

 ## Props
 
-| Prop                     | Type                                                                     | Default      | Does                                                                                      |
-| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
-| `data`                   | `readonly TRow[]`                                                        |              | The rows                                                                                  |
-| `rowKey`                 | `keyof TRow` or `(row) => string \| number`                              |              | What a row is known by                                                                    |
-| `columns`                | `readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[]`                                        |              | The columns; a stable array                                                               |
-| `caption`                | `ReactNode`                                                              |              | The title and the name                                                                    |
-| `description`            | `ReactNode`                                                              |              | What the grid is about                                                                    |
-| `captionAs`              | `'h2'` to `'h6'` or `'div'`                                              | `'h3'`       | The element of the caption                                                                |
-| `toolbar`                | `false \| (items) => ReactNode`                                          |              | `false` keeps the caption only; a function places the items                               |
-| `variant`                | `'lined' \| 'striped' \| 'minimal'`                                      | `'lined'`    | The look of a Table                                                                       |
-| `density`                | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`                               | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                                                       |
-| `rowHeight`              | `number`                                                                 |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's                                           |
-| `locale`                 | `string`                                                                 | `'en-US'`    | The language of numbers and dates (see below)                                             |
-| `timeZone`               | `string`                                                                 | `'UTC'`      | The zone a `datetime` is shown in                                                         |
-| `height`                 | `number \| string`                                                       |              | The height of the grid; with it the heading sticks                                        |
-| `scrolling`              | `'standard' \| 'virtual'`                                                | `'standard'` | `'virtual'` draws only the rows near the view                                             |
-| `loading`                | `boolean`                                                                | `false`      | Skeleton rows with no row, a layer over the rows                                          |
-| `rowClassName`           | `(row) => string \| undefined`                                           |              | A class for a row; a stable function                                                      |
-| `allowSorting`           | `boolean`                                                                | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowSorting`                                              |
-| `allowResizing`          | `boolean`                                                                | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowResizing`                                             |
-| `allowReordering`        | `boolean`                                                                | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowReordering`                                           |
-| `allowPinning`           | `boolean`                                                                | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowPinning`                                              |
-| `allowHiding`            | `boolean`                                                                | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHiding`                                               |
-| `sortMode`               | `'single' \| 'multiple'`                                                 | `'multiple'` | Whether a press with a modifier adds a level                                              |
-| `sort`                   | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`                                            |              | The sort, in order (controlled)                                                           |
-| `defaultSort`            | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`                                            |              | The sort at first                                                                         |
-| `onSortChange`           | `(sort) => void`                                                         |              | Called with the sort a press asks for                                                     |
-| `filter`                 | `DataGridFilter`                                                         |              | The search and the conditions of the columns (controlled)                                 |
-| `defaultFilter`          | `DataGridFilter`                                                         |              | The filter at first                                                                       |
-| `onFilterChange`         | `(filter) => void`                                                       |              | Called with the filter a change asks for                                                  |
-| `paging`                 | `false \| { pageSize?, pageSizes? }`                                     | see above    | A page's size at first, and the sizes offered                                             |
-| `page`                   | `DataGridPage`                                                           |              | The page, from 0 (controlled)                                                             |
-| `defaultPage`            | `DataGridPage`                                                           |              | The page at first                                                                         |
-| `onPageChange`           | `(page) => void`                                                         |              | Called with the page that is asked for                                                    |
-| `onStateChange`          | `(state, changed) => void`                                               |              | The whole state and the part that changed, after any callback of a part of it             |
-| `onRowActivate`          | `(row, key) => void`                                                     |              | Called by Enter or a double press on a row                                                |
-| `rowReorder`             | `boolean`                                                                | `false`      | A column of handles that moves rows; see Reordering rows                                  |
-| `onRowReorder`           | `(from, to, position) => void`                                           |              | Called once for each move: the row `from` goes `'before'` or `'after'` the row `to`       |
-| `editing`                | `{ mode, allowUpdating, allowDeleting, confirmDelete, startEditAction }` |              | Turns on editing, a column of buttons; see Editing                                        |
-| `onSaving`               | `(changes) => void \| Promise<void>`                                     |              | Called when the user saves, one change for each row; a Promise is waited for              |

+    color: var(--flg-accent-text);
+    font-weight: var(--flg-weight-semibold);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-new-text {
+    color: var(--flg-text-muted);
+    font-weight: var(--flg-weight-regular);
+    font-style: italic;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-new-blank {
+    color: var(--flg-text-muted);
+  }

### Task 8: chế độ `batch`: dấu của ô đã sửa, dòng chờ xoá và Hoàn tác, thanh lưu, dòng 41–43

Spec §3.6 (thanh lưu là một điểm Tab; DOM); §4.2 (dải 12%); §4.3 E2 "Batch"; §4.4 `grid-changed-frame`, `grid-new-row-text`, `grid-wash-badge`, `grid-deleted-text`, `grid-deleted-badge`, `grid-savebar` (hai check), contrast-more; §4.5 (ô đã sửa, dòng chờ xoá, thanh lưu); §4.6 `UndoIcon`; §6.3 dòng `batch`, "Thanh lưu của batch", handle `saveChanges()`, `cancelChanges()`, nhãn; spec 0+1 §4.9 dòng 41, 42, 43 và đoạn của chúng, nhãn dòng 2. Mockup E2 (c) (`EditBatch`). Bắt đầu từ commit của Task 7.
- **`mode: 'batch'`**: trình sửa như `cell` (`editsCells`), lần chốt chỉ ghi thay đổi; **dấu** của ô đã sửa (`[data-changed]`), dòng chờ xoá (`[data-deleted]`, Hoàn tác), dòng mới (phát hiện 13).
- **Thanh lưu** (`SaveBar`): con đầu của khung, số dòng có thay đổi, Discard changes, Save changes; **handle** `saveChanges()`, `cancelChanges()` ở mọi chế độ.
- **Tương phản:** sáu check của §4.4 cùng `grid-savebar-icon`; dòng **41, 42, 43** trong `contrast-exceptions.ts`, spec 0+1 §4.9, `ExceptionTable.test.tsx`, `Accessibility.mdx`.
- **F8:** dòng mới mà `insert` của nó đang chờ chỉ đọc. **F9:** dải trên ô ghim đặc. **F10:** lần lưu batch bị từ chối đánh dấu các ô được nêu (`CellFault`). **F11:** play của `EditBatch` kết thúc không ô nào có focus.
- Story: `BatchKeys`, `BatchPinnedMarks` (`no-visual`), `EditBatch` (`viewport-1440x720`). Spec §4.4, §6.3 sửa (phát hiện 24).

+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { createRef } from 'react';
+import type { Ref } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { WARN_PREFIX, resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type {
+  DataGridChange,
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridEditing,
+  DataGridHandle,
+  DataGridProps,
+} from './index';
+
+// Batch mode (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Chế độ batch", §4.3 E2 (c)): a commit is a change that is marked and sent to nothing,
+// a row is marked for deletion and Undo gives it back, the save bar counts the rows that have a change, and one
+// `onSaving` sends them all. What needs a layout engine (the look, the focus in a real browser) is in the stories.
+
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  status: number | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  price: number;
+  paid: boolean;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { id: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { id: 2, name: 'Processing' },
+];
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', customer: 'An', status: 1, qty: 3, price: 10, paid: false },
+  { id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Bình', status: 2, qty: 5, price: 20, paid: false },
+  { id: 'DH-3', customer: 'Chi', status: 1, qty: 1, price: 30, paid: true },
+  { id: 'DH-4', customer: 'Dung', status: 2, qty: 7, price: 40, paid: false },
+];
+
+const REQUIRED_RULE = [{ type: 'required' as const }];
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, allowEditing: false, width: 100 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 140, validationRules: REQUIRED_RULE },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 140,
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 80 },
+  {
+    id: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    value: (row) => row.price * (row.qty ?? 0),
+  },
+];
+const BATCH: DataGridEditing<Order> = { mode: 'batch', allowDeleting: true, allowAdding: true };
+
+function Orders({
+  gridRef,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { gridRef?: Ref<DataGridHandle> }) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      ref={gridRef}
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={BATCH}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const rowOf = (id: string) => dataRows().find((row) => row.children[0]!.textContent?.includes(id))!;
+const newRows = () => dataRows().filter((row) => row.hasAttribute('data-new'));
+const bar = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-savebar');
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, {
+    key: pressed,
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    ...init,
+  });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const click = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.click());
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const input = (label: string) => within(table()).getByLabelText(label) as HTMLInputElement;
+const type = (label: string, text: string) =>
+  act(() => void fireEvent.change(input(label), { target: { value: text } }));
+const cellOf = (row: HTMLElement, caption: string): HTMLElement => {
+  const heads = Array.from(table().querySelectorAll('thead th')).map((head) => head.textContent);
+  return Array.from(row.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > td, :scope > th')).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  )[heads.filter((head) => head !== '').indexOf(caption)]!;
+};
+const live = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-live="polite"]'),
+    (region) => region.textContent,
+  ).join(' ');
+const sentAt = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>, call = 0): DataGridChange<Order>[] =>
+  spy.mock.calls[call]![0] as DataGridChange<Order>[];
+const tick = () => act(async () => void (await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0))));
+function deferred() {
+  let resolve!: () => void;
+  let reject!: (reason: unknown) => void;
+  const promise = new Promise<void>((yes, no) => {
+    resolve = yes;
+    reject = no;
+  });
+  return { promise, resolve, reject };
+}
+/** Starts the edit of a cell, types a value and commits it with Enter. */
+const change = (order: string, caption: string, value: string) => {
+  click(cellOf(rowOf(order), caption));
+  type(caption, value);
+  press(input(caption), 'Enter');
+};
+const deleteButton = (order: string) =>
+  screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Delete ${order}` }) as HTMLElement;
+const undoButton = (order: string) =>
+  screen.queryByRole('button', { name: `Undo deleting ${order}` });
+const addRow = () => click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add row' }));
+
+describe('the marks of a change', () => {
+  it('marks the cell that changed, says it in hidden words after the value, and sends nothing', () => {
+    const onSaving = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSaving={onSaving} />);
+    change('DH-1', 'Customer', 'Hoa');
+    const cell = cellOf(rowOf('DH-1'), 'Customer');
+    expect(cell).toHaveAttribute('data-changed');
+    expect(cell).toHaveTextContent('Hoa');
+    expect(within(cell).getByText('changed')).toHaveClass('flg-visually-hidden');
+    expect(cell.textContent).toBe('Hoachanged');
+    expect(onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('marks no other cell of the row, and not the column that is computed from the one that changed', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    change('DH-1', 'Qty', '4');
+    const row = rowOf('DH-1');
+    const marked = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('[data-changed]'));

+  it('send every change in one onSaving: an insert, an update with the changed fields, a remove', async () => {

+/**
+ * Batch mode with real keys (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Chế độ batch"): `Enter` commits a cell as a change that is
+ * marked and sent to nothing; `Tab` goes from the toolbar through the save bar (Discard changes, Save changes) into
+ * the grid; `Enter` on Save changes sends every change in one `onSaving`; the focus is in the grid after the bar goes,
+ * after a save and after Discard changes, never on the page. What a burst of keys does is not counted.
+ */
+export const BatchKeys: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: {
+    editing: { mode: 'batch', allowAdding: true, allowDeleting: true },
+    searchPanel: true,
+    onSaving: fn(),
+  },
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    const table = tableOf(root);
+    const bar = () => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-savebar');
+    const toolbarButton = () =>
+      Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-toolbar button')).at(-1)!;
+    await real.unhover(root);
+
+    // `Enter` commits a cell: a change, a bar, and nothing sent.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.fill(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(bar(), 'the bar shows').not.toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(bar()!.textContent).toContain('1 unsaved change');
+    await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer').hasAttribute('data-changed')).toBe(true);
+    await expect(saved).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-main')!.firstElementChild).toBe(bar());
+    await expect(toolbarButton().getAttribute('data-variant')).toBe('secondary');
+
+    // `Tab` from the last button of the toolbar goes through the bar into the grid, and `Shift+Tab` back.
+    toolbarButton().focus();
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(active().textContent).toBe('Discard changes');
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(active().textContent).toBe('Save changes');
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(table.contains(active()), 'the grid has the focus').toBe(true);
+    await real.tab({ shift: true });
+    await expect(active().textContent).toBe('Save changes');
+
+    // `Enter` on Save changes sends the one change; the bar goes and the focus is in the grid.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(saved, 'one onSaving').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    const [changes] = saved.mock.calls[0] as [{ type: string; key: string; data: object }[]];
+    await expect(changes).toMatchObject([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1028', data: { customer: 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa' } },
+    ]);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(bar(), 'the bar went').toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(table.contains(active()), 'the focus is in the grid, not on the page').toBe(true),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(toolbarButton().getAttribute('data-variant')).toBe('primary');
+
+    // A mark for deletion, and Discard changes: the focus is in the grid again.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1030', 'Customer'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Delete DH-1030"]')!.click();
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1030').hasAttribute('data-deleted'), 'the row is marked').toBe(true),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(bar()!.textContent).toContain('1 unsaved change');
+    toolbarButton().focus();
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(active().textContent).toBe('Discard changes');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(bar(), 'the bar went').toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1030').hasAttribute('data-deleted')).toBe(false);
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(table.contains(active()), 'the focus is in the grid, not on the page').toBe(true),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(saved, 'discarding sends nothing').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+
+    // A press on the words of the bar moves no focus.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.fill(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Một cái tên');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(bar()).not.toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    const place = active();
+    await real.click(bar()!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-savebar-text')!);
+    await expect(active(), 'the press on the words left the focus where it was').toBe(place);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * E2, crop c (spec phase 6 §4.3 E2 "Batch"): batch mode in a card with its toolbar and the save bar joined to the top of
+ * the frame. The new row is first ("+ (new)", "—" in Total), DH-1027 is marked for deletion (red wash, muted, struck,
+ * Undo, the cell of the buttons not struck) and DH-1028 has two changed cells (Order date, Status): "3 unsaved changes".
+ * Not as in the mockup: every row is 45px (OQ 1; the mockup's resting rows are 35.6px), the add button is `md`, last and
+ * `secondary` while the bar shows (G1, spec §4.3), the action column is 72px and last, the words are English, and G1's
+ * export button is Plan G's.
+ */
+export const EditBatch: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  args: { onSaving: fn() },
+  render: ({ onSaving }) => (
+    <E2Grid
+      caption="Orders"
+      aria-label={undefined}
+      editing={{ mode: 'batch', allowAdding: true, allowDeleting: true }}
+      initNewRow={() => ({ status: 'new' })}
+      onSaving={onSaving}
+    />
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (real) await real.unhover(root);
+    const bar = () => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-savebar');
+
+    // The new row, filled as the crop draws it: a name, a day, the quantity; the status is the one `initNewRow` gives.
+    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-toolbar button')!.click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Lý Thu Trang');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    const fresh = () => tableOf(root).querySelector<HTMLTableRowElement>('tr[data-new]')!;
+    const freshCell = (caption: string) =>
+      Array.from(fresh().cells)[
+        Array.from(tableOf(root).tHead!.rows[0]!.cells).findIndex(
+          (head) => head.textContent?.trim() === caption,
+        )
+      ] as HTMLElement;
+    freshCell('Order date').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Order date')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Order date'), '13/11/2026');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    freshCell('Qty').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Qty')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.clear(cellEditorOf(root, 'Qty'));
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Qty'), '2');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+
+    // DH-1027 is marked for deletion.
+    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Delete DH-1027"]')!.click();
+
+    // DH-1028: the day, then the status through its listbox.
+    cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Order date').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Order date')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.clear(cellEditorOf(root, 'Order date'));
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Order date'), '06/11/2026');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Status').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Status')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    const status = cellEditorOf(root, 'Status');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{ArrowDown}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the listbox is open').toBe('true'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    const listbox = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
+      `#${status.getAttribute('aria-controls')}`,
+    )!;
+    const choice = Array.from(listbox.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="option"]')).find(
+      (option) => option.textContent?.includes('Delivered'),
+    )!;
+    await userEvent.click(choice);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the listbox is closed').toBe('false'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    // `Enter` on a closed Select opens its list again: `Tab` commits it, and `Esc` gives up the next cell's edit.
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Tab}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Qty'), 'the next cell opened').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(editedCell(root), 'the edit ended').toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    // The crop draws no focus frame and no button of DH-1028's row: the focus leaves the grid (nothing is sent by
+    // that in batch mode) and the pointer is off it.
+    active().blur();
+    if (real) await real.unhover(root);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(root.matches(':focus-within'), 'the grid holds no focus').toBe(false),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(args.onSaving).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    // The bar, the marks and the rows, as the crop draws them.
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(bar()?.textContent, 'the bar counts three rows').toContain('3 unsaved changes'),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(
+      Array.from(bar()!.querySelectorAll('button'), (button) => button.textContent),
+    ).toEqual(['Discard changes', 'Save changes']);
+    await expect(fresh().textContent).toContain('(new)');
+    await expect(freshCell('Customer').textContent).toBe('Lý Thu Trang');
+    await expect(freshCell('Order date').textContent).toBe('13/11/2026');
+    await expect(freshCell('Status').textContent).toBe('New');
+    await expect(freshCell('Qty').textContent).toBe('2');
+    await expect(freshCell('Total').textContent).toBe('—');
+    const deleted = rowOf(root, 'DH-1027');
+    await expect(deleted.hasAttribute('data-deleted')).toBe(true);
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(cellOf(root, 'DH-1027', 'Customer')).textDecorationLine).toBe(
+      'line-through',
+    );
+    await expect(
+      getComputedStyle(deleted.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-badge')!).textDecorationLine,
+    ).toBe('line-through');
+    await expect(
+      getComputedStyle(deleted.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-actions')!)
+        .textDecorationLine,
+    ).toBe('none');
+    await expect(root.querySelector('button[aria-label="Undo deleting DH-1027"]')).not.toBeNull();
+    await expect(
+      Array.from(rowOf(root, 'DH-1028').querySelectorAll('[data-changed]'), (cell) =>
+        cell.textContent?.replace('changed', ''),
+      ),
+    ).toEqual(['06/11/2026', 'Delivered']);
+    await expect(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Order date').textContent).toContain('changed');
+    // The bar is joined to the frame: as wide as it, square where it meets it, and the add button gave way to Save.
+    const frame = tableOf(root).parentElement!;
+    await expect(bar()!.offsetWidth).toBe(frame.offsetWidth);
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(frame).borderTopLeftRadius).toBe('0px');
+    await expect(
+      root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-toolbar button')!.getAttribute('data-variant'),
+    ).toBe('secondary');
+    await expect(rowOf(root, 'DH-1030').offsetHeight).toBe(45);
+    await expect(
+      tableOf(root).querySelector(':focus, :focus-visible'),
+      'no cell draws the focus frame',
+    ).toBeNull();
+    // The buttons sit in a box that is transparent at rest (Edit and Delete show on hover and focus only).
+    await expect(
+      getComputedStyle(
+        root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Delete DH-1028"]')!.parentElement!,
+      ).opacity,
+      'DH-1028 shows no Delete button',
+    ).toBe('0');
+    await noTitleIsCut(canvasElement);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * The marks of batch mode in a pinned column, with the grid scrolled sideways (spec phase 6 §4.4): a pinned cell is solid
+ * while content is under it, and the wash of a new row, of a changed cell, of a deleted row and the colour of an editor
+ * are layered over that solid colour, so a mark does not vanish from the column that stays. A cell with no mark has no
+ * layer. The browser decides what the layers compose to, so this is run in the three engines.
+ */
+export const BatchPinnedMarks: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  render: () => (
+    <div style={{ width: 620 }}>
+      <DataGrid
+        data={E2_ORDERS}
+        rowKey="id"
+        columns={E2_COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+          'field' in column && column.field === 'customer'
+            ? { ...column, pinned: 'left' as const }
+            : column,
+        )}
+        aria-label="Orders"
+        locale="vi-VN"
+        paging={false}
+        editing={{ mode: 'batch', allowAdding: true, allowDeleting: true }}
+        initNewRow={() => ({ status: 'new' as const })}
+        onSaving={() => {}}
+      />
+    </div>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (real) await real.unhover(root);
+    const frame = tableOf(root).parentElement!;
+
+    // A new row with a name, a changed cell and a deleted row, all in the pinned column.
+    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-toolbar button')!.click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Lý Thu Trang');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await userEvent.clear(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'));
+    await userEvent.type(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer'), 'Một tên khác');
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[aria-label="Delete DH-1027"]')!.click();
+    // And an editor open in a pinned cell.
+    cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer').click();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(cellEditorOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+
+    frame.scrollLeft = 200;
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(
+          frame.hasAttribute('data-scrolled-left'),
+          `data-scrolled-left (scrollLeft ${frame.scrollLeft} of ${frame.scrollWidth - frame.clientWidth})`,
+        ).toBe(true),
+      SCROLL_EVENT,
+    );
+
+    const layers = (cell: HTMLElement) => getComputedStyle(cell).backgroundImage;
+    const fresh = tableOf(root).querySelector<HTMLTableRowElement>('tr[data-new]')!;
+    const pinnedOf = (row: HTMLElement) => row.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-pinned="left"]')!;
+    await expect(pinnedOf(fresh).textContent).toContain('Lý Thu Trang');
+    await expect(layers(pinnedOf(fresh)), 'the new row').toContain('linear-gradient');
+    await expect(layers(cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer')), 'the changed cell').toContain(
+      'linear-gradient',
+    );
+    await expect(
+      cellOf(root, 'DH-1028', 'Customer').hasAttribute('data-changed'),
+      'the cell is marked',
+    ).toBe(true);
+    await expect(layers(pinnedOf(rowOf(root, 'DH-1027'))), 'the deleted row').toContain(
+      'linear-gradient',
+    );
+    await expect(layers(cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer')), 'the editor cell').toContain(
+      'linear-gradient',
+    );
+    // A pinned cell with no mark is the solid colour alone.
+    await expect(layers(cellOf(root, 'DH-1030', 'Customer')), 'a cell with no mark').toBe('none');
+  },
+};

+### Batch mode
+
+`mode: 'batch'` edits cells as `'cell'` does (a press, <Kbd keys="enter" />, <Kbd keys="f2" />, a character, <Kbd keys="tab" />
+and <Kbd keys="shift+tab" />, <Kbd keys="space" /> and a press on a boolean), but nothing is sent when a cell is left: the
+change is kept and marked, and one `onSaving` sends all of them when the user asks. <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives up the cell
+being edited and nothing else. The column of buttons is drawn only with `allowDeleting`, as in cell mode.
+
+- **A changed cell** (a value that is not the saved one) has a wash of the accent at 12%, a dashed frame inside it,
+  and the hidden words `labels.changedCell` after its value. A value typed back to the saved one leaves no mark.
+- **Delete** marks the row, with no question: its cells have the red wash, muted text and a line through them (a
+  Badge too), its first cell says `labels.deletedRow` for a screen reader, and `labels.announceRowMarkedDeleted`
+  is said. The cell of buttons holds **Undo** (`labels.undoDelete(name)`), always drawn, which gives the row back
+  with the edits it had. A row marked for deletion cannot be edited. Delete on a new row gives it up.
+- **The save bar** is the first thing in the main part, joined to the top of the frame, while at least one row has
+  a change: the number of **rows** with a change (`labels.unsavedChanges(n)`; a new row and a row marked for
+  deletion each count one, a row of two changed cells one), **Discard changes** and **Save changes**, which loads
+  while the save is pending. The first change is said once. The Add row button is `secondary` while the bar shows.
+  The bar is a stop of Tab between the toolbar and the grid, and when it goes with the focus in it the focus goes
+  to the place of the grid.
+- **Saving** (Save changes, or `ref.current.saveChanges()`) first commits the cell being edited, then checks every
+  field of every changed row that can be edited (a new row: every field it draws) and, if one fails, announces the
+  count (`labels.announceErrors`), opens the editor of the first and sends nothing. Otherwise **one** `onSaving`
+  gets every change, one for each row: `insert`, `update` (the changed fields and the saved `row`) and `remove`.
+  When it answers, the changes sent are cleared; the ones made while it was pending stay, over the row as it is
+  saved now. When it is refused (a reject or a throw) every change stays and the alert shows. The cells the
+  `fieldErrors` name in the rows the grid draws are marked, with the red frame, the icon and the words (hidden in
+  the cell for a screen reader, and in a tooltip); the mark goes when the cell is edited again and at the next
+  save. The words of a field no row draws, or of a row that is not there, are in the alert.
+- **Totals** read the values the cells show, and leave a row marked for deletion out.
+
+`ref.current.saveChanges()` and `cancelChanges()` are the handle of every mode: in `'row'` mode they save and give up
+the row being edited, in `'cell'` mode they commit the cell being edited and send the new rows, or drop them.
+

+/** What a row shows of the change held over it (batch mode): that it is marked for deletion, or which cells changed. */
+export interface RowMarks {
+  readonly deleted: boolean;
+  /** The ids of the columns whose cell is not what the saved row has. */
+  readonly changed: ReadonlySet<string>;
+  /** The cells a refused save named, by column id, with the words it gave. */
+  readonly invalid?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
+}
+
+const NO_COLUMNS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
+const DELETED: RowMarks = { deleted: true, changed: NO_COLUMNS };
+const NOT_CHANGED: RowMarks = { deleted: false, changed: NO_COLUMNS };
+const marked = new WeakMap<object, { columns: readonly unknown[]; marks: RowMarks }>();
+
+/**
+ * The marks of a row that has a change: `remove` marks the whole row and no cell, an `update` marks the cells
+ * whose value is not the saved one. A field column is changed when its field is in the difference from the saved
+ * row; a computed column only when it can be set (`setValue`) and its value is not the saved row's, so the total
+ * that reads a quantity is not marked when the quantity is. An insert marks no cell (a new row has its own marks).
+ */
+export function rowMarks<TRow>(
+  change: PendingChange<TRow>,
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[],
+): RowMarks {
+  if (change.type === 'remove') return DELETED;
+  if (change.type === 'insert') return NOT_CHANGED;
+  // The marks of a change are the same object while the change and the columns are, so a row that is given them
+  // as a prop draws again only when its own change moves.
+  const hit = marked.get(change);
+  if (hit && hit.columns === columns) return hit.marks;
+  const diff = rowDiff(change.row, change.data, columns);
+  const shown = { ...change.row, ...change.data };
+  const changed = new Set<string>();
+  for (const column of columns) {
+    if (!isDataColumn(column)) continue;
+    const { field } = column.column;
+    if (typeof field === 'string') {
+      if (Object.hasOwn(diff, field)) changed.add(column.id);
+    } else if (
+      'setValue' in column.column &&
+      typeof column.column.setValue === 'function' &&
+      !sameValue(column.value(change.row), column.value(shown), column.dataType)
+    ) {
+      changed.add(column.id);
+    }
+  }
+  const marks: RowMarks = { deleted: false, changed };
+  marked.set(change, { columns, marks });
+  return marks;
+}

+
+/**
+ * The words of a cell that a refused save named (`batch` mode), where the cell holds no editor: the value, the icon at the
+ * end and the words hidden in the cell for it to be described by, and the same words in a tooltip below it while the
+ * pointer is on it. The editor's box is no help here: it paints the field's colour and is the editor's own.
+ */
+export function CellFault({
+  message,
+  faultId,
+  children,
+}: {
+  message: string;
+  /** The id the hidden words have, which the cell is described by. */
+  faultId: string;
+  children: ReactNode;
+}) {
+  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
+  return (
+    <TooltipRoot
+      open={over}
+      onOpenChange={(next) => {
+        if (!next) setOver(false);
+      }}
+      describe={false}
+    >
+      <TooltipTrigger>
+        <span
+          className="flg-data-grid-fault"
+          // A focusable box for the tooltip, out of the Tab order, that no press gives the focus to.
+          tabIndex={-1}
+          onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
+          onPointerEnter={() => setOver(true)}
+          onPointerLeave={() => setOver(false)}
+        >
+          <span className="flg-data-grid-fault-value">{children}</span>
+          <AlertCircleIcon
+            className="flg-data-grid-editor-alert"
+            width={16}
+            height={16}
+            aria-hidden="true"
+          />
+          <span id={faultId} className="flg-visually-hidden">
+            {message}
+          </span>
+        </span>
+      </TooltipTrigger>
+      <TooltipContent side="bottom" align="start" sideOffset={6}>
+        <span className="flg-data-grid-error-text">
+          <AlertCircleIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden="true" />
+          {message}
+        </span>
+      </TooltipContent>
+    </TooltipRoot>

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveBar.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveBar.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bc48666
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SaveBar.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import { useId, useRef } from 'react';
+import { PencilIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import type { DataGridLabels } from '../types';
+
+/**
+ * The bar of the changes not saved yet (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 E2 "Batch"): the first child of the main part, joined
+ * to the top of the frame, while a grid in `batch` mode holds a change. It says how many rows have one and has the two
+ * buttons that decide them: Discard changes and Save changes, which is `loading` while the save is pending (it keeps
+ * the focus, and a press on it does nothing). It is a place of Tab before the table, as the toolbar is.
+ *
+ * A press on its words moves no focus (cancelled on the `mousedown`, as a press on a cell that is no place is), so the
+ * grid that held the focus keeps it. When the bar goes (saved, discarded) while the focus is in it, the focus goes to
+ * the place of the grid first, never to the page.
+ */
+export function SaveBar({
+  count,
+  saving,
+  labels,
+  onSave,
+  onDiscard,
+  restoreFocus,
+}: {
+  /** The number of rows that have a change. */
+  count: number;
+  /** Whether the save is pending. */
+  saving: boolean;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  onSave: () => void;
+  onDiscard: () => void;
+  /** Gives the focus to the place of the grid. */
+  restoreFocus: () => void;
+}) {
+  const id = useId();
+  const bar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const restore = useRef(restoreFocus);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    restore.current = restoreFocus;
+  });
+  // The cleanup of a layout effect runs before the bar leaves the DOM, so the focus is still in it.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      if (bar.current?.contains(document.activeElement)) restore.current();
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+  return (
+    // A press on the words of the bar is only cancelled, which keeps the focus: no control of its own.
+    // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions
+    <div
+      ref={bar}
+      className="flg-data-grid-savebar"
+      role="group"
+      aria-labelledby={id}
+      onMouseDown={(event) => {
+        if (!(event.target as Element).closest('button')) event.preventDefault();
+      }}
+    >
+      <PencilIcon width={15} height={15} aria-hidden="true" />
+      <span id={id} className="flg-data-grid-savebar-text">
+        {labels.unsavedChanges(count)}
+      </span>
+      <span className="flg-data-grid-savebar-spacer" />
+      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onDiscard}>
+        {labels.discardChanges}
+      </Button>
+      <Button variant="primary" size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={onSave}>
+        {labels.saveChanges}
+      </Button>
+    </div>
+  );
+}

### Task 9: chế độ `form`: dòng form thay chỗ dòng, `EditFields`, dòng đo được của cửa sổ ảo

Spec §3.5 (dòng form), §3.6 (dòng form là một vị trí; Tab trong form), §3.7 "Dòng có chiều cao thay đổi", "Nội dung trải cả hàng"; §4.3 EF1 "Dòng form"; §4.5 (form); §6.3 trường cột `form`, dòng `form` của bảng chế độ, `saveChanges()` ở `form` (F12a), nhãn; §7 lớp 2 ("form EF1 dính trái khi bảng đã cuộn ngang"); spec 0+1 §4.9 nhãn dòng 6. Mockup EF1 (a) (`EditForm`). Bắt đầu từ commit của Task 8.
- **`mode: 'form'`**: Sửa, `Enter`, `F2` mở một thẻ form thay chỗ dòng (`FlatFormRow`); một `Field` cho mỗi cột theo thứ tự bố cục (OQ 6; `formColumns`, `form.visible`, `form.span`); một hay hai cột theo container query; Huỷ và Lưu (phát hiện 14).
- **`EditFields`** dùng chung với popup; `FieldEditor` và `useDraftValue` trong `CellEditor.tsx`.
- **Cửa sổ ảo:** dòng form là dòng đo được duy nhất (`ResizeObserver` chỉ khi form mở; 8 dòng tới khi đo).
- Chi tiết của dòng ẩn khi form mở (phán quyết của Claude); thẻ dính trái khi khung cuộn ngang.
- **F12a:** `saveChanges()` lưu form đang mở như nút Lưu. **F15:** cột Channel của dữ liệu EF1 có lookup (Select, như EF1).
- Nhãn dòng 6 (gợi ý của form). Story: `FormKeys`, `FormScrolled`, `FormContainer` (`no-visual`), `EditForm` (`viewport-1440x900`). Spec §4.3, §6.3 sửa (phát hiện 24).
