diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.form-virtual.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.form-virtual.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2a60c8e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.form-virtual.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,136 @@
+import { act, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import { FORM_ESTIMATE_ROWS } from './hooks/use-virtual-rows';
+import type { DataGridColumn } from './index';
+
+// The form row of a virtual grid (spec phase 6 §3.7 "Dòng có chiều cao thay đổi"): the one row of the list that is not
+// as tall as the others, so its height is measured and the window is made with it. Before the first measure it counts
+// as eight rows. jsdom has no layout, so the heights are given by the test.
+
+const FRAME = 400;
+const HEAD = 41;
+const ROW = 45;
+let formHeight = 0;
+let watchers: Array<() => void> = [];
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  formHeight = 0;
+  watchers = [];
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'clientHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: HTMLElement,
+  ) {
+    return this.classList.contains('flg-table-frame') ? FRAME : 0;
+  });
+  vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'offsetHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: HTMLElement,
+  ) {
+    if (this.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-form-row')) return formHeight;
+    return this.tagName === 'THEAD' ? HEAD : this.tagName === 'TR' ? ROW : 0;
+  });
+  // A ResizeObserver that the test runs, as the frames of a scroll are.
+  vi.stubGlobal(
+    'ResizeObserver',
+    class {
+      private readonly callback: () => void;
+      constructor(callback: () => void) {
+        this.callback = callback;
+      }
+      observe() {
+        watchers.push(this.callback);
+      }
+      disconnect() {
+        watchers = watchers.filter((one) => one !== this.callback);
+      }
+      unobserve() {}
+    },
+  );
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, index) => ({
+  id: `DH-${index + 1}`,
+  customer: `Customer ${index + 1}`,
+}));
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, allowEditing: false, width: 104 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+];
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid');
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('tbody > .flg-data-grid-row'));
+const formRow = () => grid().querySelector<HTMLElement>('tbody > .flg-data-grid-form-row');
+const spacerBelow = () => {
+  const spacers = Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('tbody > .flg-data-grid-spacer'));
+  return Number.parseFloat((spacers.at(-1)!.firstElementChild as HTMLElement).style.height);
+};
+
+function Orders() {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      height={FRAME}
+      scrolling="virtual"
+      editing={{ mode: 'form' }}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+describe('the form row of a virtual grid', () => {
+  it('is kept in the window, drawn as the one form, with the rows after it', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    act(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-1' }).click());
+    expect(formRow()).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(dataRows().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    expect(dataRows()[0]!.textContent).toContain('DH-2');
+  });
+
+  it('counts as eight rows until it is measured, then as tall as it measures', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const closed = dataRows().length;
+    act(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-1' }).click());
+    // Eight rows are 360px of the 400px frame: the window ends sooner than it did with rows of one height alone.
+    const estimated = dataRows().length;
+    expect(FORM_ESTIMATE_ROWS * ROW).toBe(360);
+    const total = spacerBelow();
+    expect(estimated).toBeLessThan(closed);
+    // The form is measured at 120px: the rows after it that are in the frame are more, and the spacer less.
+    formHeight = 120;
+    act(() => watchers.forEach((watch) => watch()));
+    expect(dataRows().length).toBeGreaterThan(estimated);
+    expect(spacerBelow()).toBeLessThan(total);
+    // It grows (a field got an error): the window follows.
+    const measured = dataRows().length;
+    formHeight = 360;
+    act(() => watchers.forEach((watch) => watch()));
+    expect(dataRows().length).toBeLessThan(measured);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps no machinery of its own while no form is open: nothing observes a row', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const before = watchers.length;
+    act(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit DH-1' }).click());
+    expect(watchers.length).toBe(before + 1);
+    act(() => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }).click());
+    expect(watchers.length).toBe(before);
+  });
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,790 @@
+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { createRef } from 'react';
+import type { Ref } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type {
+  DataGridChange,
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridEditing,
+  DataGridHandle,
+  DataGridProps,
+} from './index';
+
+// Form mode (spec phase 6 §3.5 step 8, §3.6, §4.3 EF1, §6.3): Edit, `Enter` and `F2` open a form in the place of the row,
+// with a field for every data column; Save and `Enter` in a field send it, Cancel and `Esc` give it up. What needs a
+// layout engine (the card sticking left, the container query, the focus of a real browser) is in the stories.
+
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  status: number | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  placed: string | null;
+  paid: boolean;
+  price: number;
+  secret: string;
+  note: string;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { id: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { id: 2, name: 'Processing' },
+];
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  {
+    id: 'DH-1',
+    customer: 'An',
+    status: 1,
+    qty: 3,
+    placed: '2026-11-05',
+    paid: false,
+    price: 10,
+    secret: 's1',
+    note: 'first',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-2',
+    customer: 'Bình',
+    status: 2,
+    qty: 5,
+    placed: '2026-11-06',
+    paid: true,
+    price: 20,
+    secret: 's2',
+    note: 'second',
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'DH-3',
+    customer: 'Chi',
+    status: 1,
+    qty: 1,
+    placed: null,
+    paid: false,
+    price: 30,
+    secret: 's3',
+    note: '',
+  },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, allowEditing: false, width: 100 },
+  {
+    field: 'customer',
+    caption: 'Customer',
+    width: 140,
+    validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }],
+  },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 140,
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+  { field: 'placed', caption: 'Order date', dataType: 'date', width: 150 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 80 },
+  {
+    id: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    value: (row) => row.price * (row.qty ?? 0),
+  },
+  { field: 'secret', caption: 'Secret', width: 100, form: { visible: false } },
+  { field: 'note', caption: 'Note', width: 120, multiline: true },
+];
+const FORM: DataGridEditing<Order> = { mode: 'form' };
+
+function Orders({
+  gridRef,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { gridRef?: Ref<DataGridHandle> }) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      ref={gridRef}
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={FORM}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const rowOf = (name: string) => dataRows().find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const formRow = () =>
+  table().querySelector<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-form-row');
+const form = () => table().querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('form.flg-data-grid-form');
+const field = (label: string) => within(form()!).getByLabelText(label) as HTMLInputElement;
+const fieldLabels = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    form()!.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-form-fields > .flg-field > .flg-field-label'),
+    (label) => label.textContent,
+  );
+const edit = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Edit ${name}` });
+const click = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.click());
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, {
+    key: pressed,
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    ...init,
+  });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const type = (label: string, text: string) =>
+  act(() => void fireEvent.change(field(label), { target: { value: text } }));
+const tick = () => act(async () => void (await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0))));
+const live = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-live="polite"]'),
+    (region) => region.textContent,
+  ).join(' ');
+const sent = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>, call = 0): DataGridChange<Order>[] =>
+  spy.mock.calls[call]![0] as DataGridChange<Order>[];
+const saveButton = () => within(form()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' });
+const cancelButton = () => within(form()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' });
+function deferred() {
+  let resolve!: () => void;
+  let reject!: (reason: unknown) => void;
+  const promise = new Promise<void>((yes, no) => {
+    resolve = yes;
+    reject = no;
+  });
+  return { promise, resolve, reject };
+}

+    const totals = total.mock.calls.length;

+    type('Customer', 'Ze');
+    type('Customer', 'Zed');

+    // The title is made by the form, the static Total by its fields: neither is drawn by a key.
+    expect(title.mock.calls.length).toBe(titles);
+    expect(total.mock.calls.length).toBe(totals);
+  });
+});

+/**
+ * Form mode with real keys (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Chế độ form"): `Enter` on a cell opens the form and the first
+ * editable field has the focus; `Tab` goes through the fields in the order of the columns, then Cancel and Save;
+ * `Enter` in a field submits it (one `onSaving`) and the focus is in the grid after the form goes; `Esc` gives it up and
+ * the focus is in the grid too, never on the page. What a burst of keys does is not counted.
+ */
+export const FormKeys: Story = {

+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {

+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;

+    // `Enter` on a cell opens the form, with the focus on the first field.

+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(formOf(root), 'the form opened').not.toBeNull(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(controlOf(root, 'customer'), 'the first field has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+
+    // `Tab` goes through the fields in the order of the columns, then the two buttons.
+    const seen: string[] = [];
+    for (let step = 0; step < 24 && !seen.includes('Save'); step++) {
+      const at = active();
+      const name = at.closest('[data-column]')?.getAttribute('data-column') ?? at.textContent ?? '';

+    }
+    await expect(seen).toEqual([

+      'date',
+      'status',

+      'note',
+      'Cancel',
+      'Save',
+    ]);
+
+    // `Enter` in a field submits the form: one `onSaving`, the form goes, the focus is in the grid.
+    controlOf(root, 'customer').focus();

+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(saved, 'one onSaving').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1), RENDER_UPDATE);

+    await expect(changes).toMatchObject([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1029', data: { customer: 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa' } },
+    ]);
+    await waitFor(formGone, RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await waitFor(inGrid, RENDER_UPDATE);
+
+    // `Esc` gives a form up and sends nothing; the focus is in the grid.
+    await real.click(cellOf(root, 'DH-1030', 'Customer'));
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(controlOf(root, 'customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(formGone, RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await waitFor(inGrid, RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await expect(saved, 'giving up sends nothing').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  },
+};

+export const FormScrolled: Story = {

+    const inSight = () => {

+### Form mode
+
+`mode: 'form'` opens a form in the place of the row. Edit (always drawn in this mode, with Delete), <Kbd keys="enter" /> or
+
+<Kbd keys="f2" /> on a cell of the row opens it, one at a time: the form that is open is saved
+first, and stays open when its fields fail their rules. The form is one row with one cell across
+every column, and in the cell a floating glass card: a title (`labels.editRowTitle(name)`,
+`labels.newRowTitle` for a new row), the line `labels.requiredHint` when a field is required, the
+fields and the buttons Cancel (`labels.cancelButton`) and Save (`labels.saveButton`, which loads
+while the save is pending).
+
+- **The fields** are every data column in the order of the grid's columns, the hidden ones and the ones the grouping
+  takes out too, but a column that says `form: { visible: false }`. Each is a `Field` with its caption above it, a
+  star and `required` for a column with a `required` rule, and its error under it. The card is one column of fields
+  and two from 480px of its own width; a `multiline` string column (a Textarea, which only the form and the popup
+  edit) and a column with `form: { span: 2 }` span both. A column that cannot be edited is a label over its text,
+  written as the cell writes it. The editors are the ones of Editing, always `md`.
+- **Keys.** The first field that can be edited has the focus when the form opens. <Kbd keys="tab" /> goes through the fields
+  and the buttons in order; <Kbd keys="enter" /> in a field submits the form, which saves (not in a Textarea, nor
+  from a list that is open); <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives it up, a list or a calendar that is open taking the first one. No
+  other key of the grid runs inside the form. The form row is one place of the keyboard, as a detail row is: the
+  arrows land on its cell, and <Kbd keys="enter" /> there goes into the form. When the form goes the focus is in the
+  grid, never on the page.
+- **Saving** checks every field of the form (the fields are checked when the focus leaves them too); a field that
+  fails is not sent, the first has the focus, and `labels.announceErrors` is said. One `onSaving` gets one `update`
+  with the changed fields (or one `insert` for a new row, whose form stands first or last as the new rows do). A refusal keeps the
+  form and shows the alert; what `fieldErrors` names for a field goes under that field.
+- **With a detail,** the row's detail is not drawn while its form is open and comes back with it (its state is kept).
+- **Virtual:** the form row is the one row that is measured; before it is, it counts as eight rows.

+import type { FocusEvent } from 'react';

+
+/**
+ * The fields of the row being edited, as a form lays them out (spec phase 6 §4.3 EF1 "Dòng form", §6.3): one `Field` for
+ * each of `columns`, in the order they are given, a label above, a star and `required` for a column with a `required`
+ * rule, and its error in the Field. A column the row cannot edit (`canEdit` says no: read-only, computed with no
+ * `setValue`) is a label over its text, written as the cell writes it. The editors are the grid's, each reading and
+ * writing its own field of the draft, so a key typed in one draws that one only; a field is checked when the focus
+ * leaves it (a popup of its own is part of it). A field that spans both columns says so with `data-span`, which the
+ * stylesheet reads.
+ *
+ * The form and the popup (`popup` mode) lay their fields out alike, so it is one part: it knows nothing of the card
+ * or the Dialog it is in.
+ */
+export function EditFields<TRow>({
+  row,
+  columns,
+  errors,
+  size,
+  saving,
+  added,
+}: {
+  /** The row the draft is over: the saved row, or the fields of a new one. */
+  row: TRow;
+  /** The fields, in the order they are laid out. */
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The messages of the row's fields, by column id. */
+  errors: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
+  /** The size the editors are drawn at. */
+  size: 'sm' | 'md';
+  /** Whether a save is pending: the editors cannot change. */
+  saving: boolean;
+  /** Whether the row is a new one, which is edited whatever `allowUpdating` says. */
+  added: boolean;
+}) {
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>()!;
+  const { textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  // The field is settled when the focus goes out of it to another place: a popup of the field is part of it.
+  const settle = (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>, id: string): void => {
+    const to = event.relatedTarget;
+    if (to instanceof Element && (event.currentTarget.contains(to) || to.closest(POPUP_SELECTOR))) {
+      return;
+    }
+    edit.commit(id);
+  };
+  return (
+    <div className="flg-data-grid-form-fields">
+      {columns.map((column) => {
+        const span = formSpan(column) === 2 ? '2' : undefined;
+        if (!canEdit(column, row, edit.config, added)) {
+          return (
+            <div key={column.id} className="flg-field" data-span={span} data-column={column.id}>
+              <span className="flg-field-label">{column.caption}</span>
+              <div className="flg-data-grid-form-static">{textOf(row, column)}</div>
+            </div>
+          );
+        }
+        return (
+          <Field
+            key={column.id}
+            label={column.caption}
+            required={isRequired(column)}
+            error={errors.get(column.id)}
+            data-span={span}
+            data-column={column.id}
+            onBlur={(event) => settle(event, column.id)}
+          >
+            <FieldEditor
+              column={column}
+              row={row}
+              edit={edit}
+              size={size}
+              saving={saving}
+              errorId={undefined}
+              takeFocus={false}
+            />
+          </Field>
+        );
+      })}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { memo, useId, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { FormEvent, KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import { getFocusables } from '../../../internal/focus';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { hasModifier, isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import { useEditContext } from '../edit-context';
+import type { EditTarget } from '../edit-context';
+import { canEdit } from '../engine/edit';
+import type { FlatFormRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import { isRequired } from '../engine/validate';
+import { focusInto } from '../grid-dom';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { EditFields } from './EditFields';
+
+interface EditFormProps<TRow> {
+  flat: FlatFormRow<TRow>;
+  /** Whether the form row is the active place, a Tab stop of the grid: a prop, so the keyboard draws only the rows it leaves and enters. */
+  active: boolean;
+  /** The place of the row for a screen reader, in a virtual grid, where the rows are not all drawn. */
+  ariaRowIndex: number | undefined;
+  /** The row being edited: this one, or the form would not be here. */
+  editing: EditTarget;
+}
+
+/** The field of a column in the form, and the first control in it. */
+function controlOf(form: HTMLElement | null, column: string): HTMLElement | undefined {
+  const field = Array.from(form?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-column]') ?? []).find(
+    (one) => one.getAttribute('data-column') === column,
+  );
+  return field ? getFocusables(field)[0] : undefined;
+}
+
+function EditFormImpl<TRow>({ flat, active, ariaRowIndex, editing }: EditFormProps<TRow>) {
+  const { layoutColumns, filler, labels, rowHeader, textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>()!;
+  const titleId = useId();
+  const form = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
+  const { fields } = edit;
+  const added = flat.added;
+  // The row is named by the text of the row header, whether that column is drawn or not; its key when there is none.
+  const text = rowHeader ? textOf(flat.row, rowHeader) : '';
+  const name = text === '' ? String(flat.key) : text;
+  const required = fields.some(
+    (column) => isRequired(column) && canEdit(column, flat.row, edit.config, added),
+  );
+  // The first field that can be edited takes the focus when the form opens, or the one the edit was started on.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const own = editing.focus === null ? undefined : fields.find((one) => one.id === editing.focus);
+    const column =
+      own && canEdit(own, flat.row, edit.config, added)
+        ? own
+        : fields.find((one) => canEdit(one, flat.row, edit.config, added));
+    const control = column ? controlOf(form.current, column.id) : undefined;
+    const cell = form.current?.closest<HTMLElement>('td');
+    if (control && cell) focusInto(control, cell);
+    // Once, when the form appears: a later render never takes the focus back.
+  }, []);
+  // A save that found a field wrong asks for the focus there.
+  const ask = editing.refocus;
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    if (ask === null) return;
+    const control = controlOf(form.current, ask.column);
+    const cell = form.current?.closest<HTMLElement>('td');
+    if (control && cell) focusInto(control, cell);
+  }, [ask]);
+  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    edit.save();
+  };
+  // `Esc` gives the form up, unless a field has a list or a calendar open, which takes that first `Esc`.
+  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void => {
+    if (event.key !== 'Escape' || hasModifier(event) || event.shiftKey || isComposing(event))
+      return;
+    if ((event.target as Element).closest('[aria-expanded="true"]')) return;
+    event.preventDefault();
+    edit.cancel();
+  };
+  return (
+    <tr
+      className="flg-table-row flg-data-grid-form-row"
+      data-editing=""
+      aria-rowindex={ariaRowIndex}
+      aria-level={flat.level > 1 ? flat.level : undefined}
+    >
+      <td
+        colSpan={layoutColumns.length + (filler ? 1 : 0)}
+        className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-form-cell"
+        data-editor=""
+        tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
+      >
+        {/* The form only watches the keys of the fields it holds (for `Esc`): it is no control. */}
+        {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions */}
+        <form
+          ref={form}
+          noValidate
+          className="flg-surface flg-card flg-data-grid-form"
+          aria-labelledby={titleId}
+          onSubmit={onSubmit}
+          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+        >
+          <div className="flg-data-grid-form-head">
+            <span id={titleId} className="flg-data-grid-form-title">
+              {added ? labels.newRowTitle : labels.editRowTitle(name)}
+            </span>
+            {required ? (
+              <span className="flg-data-grid-form-hint">{labels.requiredHint}</span>
+            ) : null}
+          </div>
+          <EditFields
+            row={flat.row}
+            columns={fields}
+            errors={editing.errors}
+            size="md"
+            saving={editing.saving}
+            added={added}
+          />
+          <div className="flg-data-grid-form-foot">
+            <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => edit.cancel()}>
+              {labels.cancelButton}
+            </Button>
+            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="sm" loading={editing.saving}>
+              {labels.saveButton}
+            </Button>
+          </div>
+        </form>
+      </td>
+    </tr>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The form of the row being edited (spec phase 6 §4.3 EF1 "Dòng form", §6.3 `form`), which stands in the place of its
+ * row: one cell across every column, and in it a card with a title, the fields (`EditFields`) and the buttons. It is a
+ * place of the keyboard with one cell, as a detail row is, and a cell that holds editors, so the grid does not order the
+ * controls in it. `Enter` in a field submits the form, which saves; `Esc` and Cancel give it up. The first field that
+ * can be edited has the focus when it opens.
+ */
+export const EditForm = memo(EditFormImpl) as typeof EditFormImpl;

+          var(--flg-data-grid-pinned-right) - 20px
+      ),
+      100%
+    );
+    gap: 14px;
+    padding: 16px;
+    container-type: inline-size;
+    color: var(--flg-text);
+    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-head {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: baseline;
+    gap: 10px;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-title {
+    color: var(--flg-text);
+    font-size: var(--flg-text-sm);
+    font-weight: var(--flg-weight-semibold);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-hint {
+    color: var(--flg-text-muted);
+    font-size: var(--flg-text-xs);
+  }
+  /* The fields: one column, and two from a card of 480px, the one boundary there is (the lesson of Stepper's container query,
+     spec phase 4 §3.5). `minmax(0, 1fr)` lets a wide control shrink with its column. A field that spans says so with
+     `data-span`. A number is no wider than 180px and a date no wider than 240px. */
+  .flg-data-grid-form-fields {
+    display: grid;
+    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
+    gap: 12px 20px;
+  }
+  @container (min-width: 480px) {
+    .flg-data-grid-form-fields {
+      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
+    }
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-fields > [data-span='2'] {
+    grid-column: 1 / -1;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-fields .flg-number-input {
+    max-width: 180px;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-fields .flg-date-picker {
+    max-width: 240px;
+  }
+  /* A boolean is a box at the start of its field here, and in the middle of its cell in a row. */
+  .flg-data-grid-form-fields .flg-data-grid-editor-box {
+    justify-content: flex-start;
+  }
+  /* A field that cannot be edited: its text as high as a control, so the grid of fields keeps its rhythm. */
+  .flg-data-grid-form-static {
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    min-height: var(--flg-control-h-md);
+    color: var(--flg-text);
+    font-size: var(--flg-text-sm);
+    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-form-foot {
+    display: flex;
+    justify-content: flex-end;
+    gap: 8px;
+  }
 }

+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { createRef } from 'react';
+import type { Ref } from 'react';
+import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DIALOG_WIDE_QUERY } from '../dialog/use-movable';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type {
+  DataGridChange,
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridEditing,
+  DataGridHandle,
+  DataGridProps,
+} from './index';
+
+// Popup mode (spec phase 6 §4.3 EF1 "Popup", §6.3 "Popup"): Edit, `Enter` and `F2` open one Dialog with a field for every
+// data column; Save and `Enter` in a field send it, Cancel and `Esc` give it up, and a press outside does not. What a
+// layout engine decides (the full-screen Dialog, the drag, the focus of a real browser) is in the stories.
+
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+const original = {
+  showModal: HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal,
+  close: HTMLDialogElement.prototype.close,
+};
+// jsdom has no showModal(): a stand-in that toggles `open` and fires `close`, as a browser does.
+beforeAll(() => {
+  HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal = function showModal(this: HTMLDialogElement) {
+    this.setAttribute('open', '');
+  };
+  HTMLDialogElement.prototype.close = function close(this: HTMLDialogElement) {
+    if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) return;
+    this.removeAttribute('open');
+    this.dispatchEvent(new Event('close'));
+  };
+});
+afterAll(() => Object.assign(HTMLDialogElement.prototype, original));
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  qty: number | null;
+  price: number;
+  secret: string;
+  note: string;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', customer: 'An', qty: 3, price: 10, secret: 's1', note: 'first' },
+  { id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Bình', qty: 5, price: 20, secret: 's2', note: 'second' },
+  { id: 'DH-3', customer: 'Chi', qty: 1, price: 30, secret: 's3', note: '' },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, allowEditing: false, width: 100 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 140, validationRules: [{ type: 'required' }] },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+  {
+    id: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    value: (row) => row.price * (row.qty ?? 0),
+  },
+  { field: 'secret', caption: 'Secret', width: 100, form: { visible: false } },
+  { field: 'note', caption: 'Note', width: 120, multiline: true },
+];
+const POPUP: DataGridEditing<Order> = { mode: 'popup' };
+
+function Orders({
+  gridRef,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { gridRef?: Ref<DataGridHandle> }) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      ref={gridRef}
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      editing={POPUP}
+      onSaving={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const rowOf = (name: string) => dataRows().find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const dialog = () => document.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>('dialog.flg-dialog[data-kind]')!;
+const opened = () => dialog()?.hasAttribute('open') === true;
+const popup = () => within(dialog());
+const field = (label: string) => popup().getByLabelText(label) as HTMLInputElement;
+const edit = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Edit ${name}` });
+const click = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.click());
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, { key: pressed, bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const type = (label: string, text: string) =>
+  act(() => void fireEvent.change(field(label), { target: { value: text } }));
+const tick = () => act(async () => void (await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0))));
+const save = () => click(popup().getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
+const cancel = () => click(popup().getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
+const sent = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>, call = 0): DataGridChange<Order>[] =>
+  spy.mock.calls[call]![0] as DataGridChange<Order>[];
+function deferred() {
+  let resolve!: () => void;
+  let reject!: (reason: unknown) => void;
+  const promise = new Promise<void>((yes, no) => {
+    resolve = yes;
+    reject = no;
+  });
+  return { promise, resolve, reject };
+}
+
+describe('opening the popup', () => {
+  it('opens a Dialog named by the row, and leaves the row in the table as it was', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(opened()).toBe(false);
+    click(edit('DH-2'));
+    expect(opened()).toBe(true);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit DH-2' })).toBe(dialog());
+    expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(3);
+    expect(table().querySelector('[data-editor], tr[data-editing]')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('opens with Enter and with F2 on a cell of the row', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const cell = within(rowOf('DH-1')).getByText('An').closest('td')!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    expect(press(cell, 'Enter')).toBe(true);
+    expect(opened()).toBe(true);
+    cancel();
+    expect(opened()).toBe(false);
+    const again = within(rowOf('DH-3')).getByText('Chi').closest('td')!;
+    focusOn(again);
+    press(again, 'F2');
+    expect(popup().getByText('Edit DH-3')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('draws Edit and Delete always, as the form does, and no save or cancel button in the rows', () => {
+    render(<Orders editing={{ mode: 'popup', allowDeleting: true }} />);
+    click(edit('DH-1'));
+    const boxes = Array.from(table().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-action-buttons'));
+    expect(boxes).toHaveLength(3);
+    for (const box of boxes) expect(box).toHaveAttribute('data-always');
+    expect(table().querySelector('[data-editing]')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('says what is required in the description, and only when something is', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+    click(edit('DH-2'));
+    expect(popup().getByText('Fields marked * are required.')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(dialog()).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Fields marked * are required.');
+    cancel();
+    rerender(
+      <Orders columns={COLUMNS.map((column) => ({ ...column, validationRules: undefined }))} />,
+    );
+    click(edit('DH-2'));
+    expect(popup().queryByText('Fields marked * are required.')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('has a field for every data column in order, but the one left out, and shows the others as text', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(edit('DH-2'));
+    const labels = Array.from(
+      dialog().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-form-fields > .flg-field > .flg-field-label'),
+      (label) => label.textContent,
+    );

+
+// ---- Popup mode (EF1 (b)) ----
+
+/** The Dialog of the grid in popup mode: one `dialog` of the library, a child of the grid's root. */
+const popupOf = (root: HTMLElement) =>
+  root.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>(
+    'dialog.flg-dialog[data-kind="dialog"]:not([role="alertdialog"])',
+  )!;
+const popupField = (root: HTMLElement, column: string) =>
+  popupOf(root).querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-column="${column}"]`)!;
+const popupControl = (root: HTMLElement, column: string) =>
+  popupField(root, column).querySelector<HTMLElement>('input, textarea, [role="combobox"]')!;
+const popupIsOpen = (root: HTMLElement) => popupOf(root).open;
+/** A Dialog fades in (up to ten seconds on that WebKit): the wait for it says what it waits for. */
+const DIALOG_SHOWN = { timeout: 10000 };
+
+/** EF1's grid with `editing.mode: 'popup'`; the card is as wide as the stage less its padding. */
+const PopupGrid = ({
+  popup,
+  width = 1216,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<FormOrder>> & {
+  popup?: { movable?: boolean };
+  width?: number | string;
+}) => <FormGrid width={width} editing={{ mode: 'popup', allowDeleting: true, popup }} {...props} />;
+
+/**
+ * Popup mode with real keys (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Popup"): `Enter` on a cell opens the Dialog and the first editable
+ * field has the focus; `Tab` goes through the fields in the order of the columns, then Cancel and Save; a press on the
+ * frame around the panel does not close it; `Enter` in a field submits it (one `onSaving`) and the focus goes back to the
+ * cell that opened it; `Esc` gives it up the same way. What a burst of keys does is not counted.
+ */
+export const PopupKeys: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onSaving: fn() },
+  parameters: { stage: 'viewport' },
+  render: ({ onSaving }) => (
+    <PopupGrid onSaving={onSaving as DataGridProps<FormOrder>['onSaving']} />
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    const opened = () =>
+      waitFor(() => expect(popupIsOpen(root), 'the Dialog opened').toBe(true), DIALOG_SHOWN);
+    const closed = () =>
+      waitFor(() => expect(popupIsOpen(root), 'the Dialog closed').toBe(false), DIALOG_SHOWN);
+
+    // `Enter` on a cell opens the Dialog, with the focus on the first field.
+    const opener = cellOf(root, 'DH-1029', 'Customer');
+    await real.click(opener);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(active()).toBe(opener), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await opened();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(popupControl(root, 'customer'), 'the first field has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+
+    // `Tab` goes through the fields in the order of the columns, then the two buttons.
+    const seen: string[] = [];
+    for (let step = 0; step < 24 && !seen.includes('Save'); step++) {
+      const at = active();
+      const name = at.closest('[data-column]')?.getAttribute('data-column') ?? at.textContent ?? '';
+      if (seen.at(-1) !== name) seen.push(name);
+      if (name !== 'Save') await real.tab();
+    }
+    await expect(seen).toEqual([
+      'customer',
+      'assignee',
+      'date',
+      'status',
+      'channel',
+      'qty',
+      'note',
+      'Cancel',
+      'Save',
+    ]);
+
+    // A press on the frame around the panel does not close it.
+    await real.click(popupOf(root), { position: { x: 4, y: 4 } } as Record<string, unknown>);
+    await expect(popupIsOpen(root), 'a press outside closes nothing').toBe(true);
+
+    // `Enter` in a field submits the Dialog: one `onSaving`, the Dialog goes, the focus is back on the cell.
+    popupControl(root, 'customer').focus();
+    await real.fill(popupControl(root, 'customer'), 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(saved, 'one onSaving').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    const [changes] = saved.mock.calls[0] as [{ type: string; key: string; data: object }[]];
+    await expect(changes).toMatchObject([
+      { type: 'update', key: 'DH-1029', data: { customer: 'Nguyễn Văn Hoa' } },
+    ]);
+    await closed();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(active(), 'the focus is back on its cell').toBe(opener),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+
+    // `Esc` gives it up and sends nothing; the focus is back on the cell that opened it.
+    const second = cellOf(root, 'DH-1030', 'Customer');
+    await real.click(second);
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await opened();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popupControl(root, 'customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await closed();
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(active(), 'the focus is back on its cell').toBe(second),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await expect(saved, 'giving up sends nothing').toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+
+    // Edit opens it too, and the focus goes back to Edit (which stays drawn in this mode).
+    const edit = editButton(root, 'DH-1028');
+    edit.focus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await opened();
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await closed();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(active(), 'the focus is back on Edit').toBe(edit), RENDER_UPDATE);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * `Esc` in the popup, with a Select's list open (spec phase 6 §6.3 "Popup"): the first `Esc` closes the list and the
+ * Dialog stays, with the focus on the Select's trigger; the second closes the Dialog and sends nothing. The story waits
+ * for the list to be gone between the two presses.
+ */
+export const PopupSelectEsc: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onSaving: fn() },
+  parameters: { stage: 'viewport' },
+  render: ({ onSaving }) => (
+    <PopupGrid onSaving={onSaving as DataGridProps<FormOrder>['onSaving']} />
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const saved = args.onSaving as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    await real.unhover(root);
+    await real.click(editButton(root, 'DH-1028'));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popupIsOpen(root), 'the Dialog opened').toBe(true), DIALOG_SHOWN);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popupControl(root, 'customer')).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+
+    // The Select of the status: its list opens with a press on the trigger.
+    const status = popupControl(root, 'status');
+    await real.click(status);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the list is open').toBe('true'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+
+    // The first `Esc` closes the list only: the Dialog stays and the trigger has the focus.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(status.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), 'the list is closed').toBe('false'),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await expect(popupIsOpen(root), 'the first Esc only closed the list').toBe(true);

diff --git a/src/styles/forced-colors.test.ts b/src/styles/forced-colors.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e605b44
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/styles/forced-colors.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+
+// The audit of `forced-color-adjust: none` (the final review of Plan E). The property is inherited: an element that opts
+// out of the system's colours keeps the page's colours for everything inside it, which in forced colours can be text
+// the colour of the canvas. So a rule that opts out is safe only where nothing is drawn inside (a pseudo-element, a
+// line, a fill) or where the colours of the subtree are the system's: the element sets a system `color` (text and
+// `currentColor` follow it), or its children are given back to the browser, or each child that has colours of its own
+// has a rule that names system colours. The checks are on the stylesheet, as `row-heights.test.ts` reads heights from
+// it: the runner cannot emulate the mode.
+
+const SYSTEM =
+  /\b(Canvas|CanvasText|Highlight|HighlightText|ButtonText|ButtonFace|GrayText|LinkText|Mark|MarkText)\b/;
+
+/** Elements with no element inside them, which the markup of their component says (text only, or nothing). */
+const LEAVES: Record<string, string> = {
+  '.flg-slider-fill': 'a bar',
+  '.flg-slider-ticks > i': 'a tick',
+  '.flg-progress[data-variant] .flg-progress-fill': 'a bar',
+  '.flg-skeleton': 'a block',
+  '.flg-stepper[data-variant] .flg-step .flg-step-bar': 'a bar',
+  '.flg-data-grid-match': 'a `mark` with text',
+  '.flg-data-grid-drop-line': 'a line',
+};
+
+/**
+ * The elements that opt out and hold an element that is not given back, with the rule that names its system colours.
+ * The thumb of a Slider holds the bubble, a `.flg-surface` whose forced-colours rule sets `Canvas` and `CanvasText`
+ * (the layer of preferences is later than the bubble's own colour); the guide of a column's width holds its label,
+ * which has the system colours of its own.
+ */
+const SUBTREE: Record<string, string> = {
+  '.flg-slider-thumb': '.flg-surface',
+  '.flg-data-grid-resize-guide': '.flg-data-grid-width-pill',
+};
+
+interface Rule {
+  selector: string;
+  body: string;
+}
+
+/** The rules of a stylesheet, flat: the rules of an at-rule are listed as its own, which is what the audit needs. */
+export function rulesOf(css: string): Rule[] {
+  const rules: Rule[] = [];
+  const plain = css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');
+  for (const match of plain.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}/g)) {
+    rules.push({ selector: match[1]!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), body: match[2]! });
+  }
+  return rules;
+}
+
+const parts = (selector: string): string[] =>
+  selector.split(/,(?![^(]*\))/).map((part) => part.trim());
+
+/** The rules of `css` that opt out of the system's colours where something inside may be drawn in the page's own. */
+export function findUnsafe(css: string): string[] {
+  const rules = rulesOf(css);
+  const sets = (selector: string, test: (body: string) => boolean): boolean =>
+    rules.some((rule) => parts(rule.selector).includes(selector) && test(rule.body));
+  const unsafe: string[] = [];
+  for (const rule of rules) {
+    if (!/forced-color-adjust:\s*none/.test(rule.body)) continue;
+    for (const part of parts(rule.selector)) {
+      if (/::(before|after)$/.test(part)) continue;
+      if (part in LEAVES) continue;
+      // A part that ends in a state is the owner's own colours too: the rule for the same part without a `:not()`.
+      const owner = part.replace(/:not\([^)]*\)$/, '');
+      const colours = (body: string) =>
+        new RegExp(`(^|;|\\s)color:\\s*${SYSTEM.source}`).test(body);
+      if (rule.body.match(/(^|;|\s)color:/) ? colours(rule.body) : false) continue;
+      if (sets(part, colours) || sets(owner, colours)) continue;
+      if (sets(`${part} > *`, (body) => /forced-color-adjust:\s*auto/.test(body))) continue;
+      const inner = SUBTREE[part];
+      if (
+        inner !== undefined &&
+        rules.some((one) =>
+          parts(one.selector).some((p) => p.includes(inner) && SYSTEM.test(one.body)),
+        )
+      ) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      unsafe.push(part);
+    }
+  }
+  return unsafe;
+}
+
+describe('the audit of forced-color-adjust: none', () => {
+  it('finds a rule that opts out an element with children and names no system colour for them', () => {
+    const css = `
+      @media (forced-colors: active) {
+        .a-leaf::after { forced-color-adjust: none; background: Highlight; }
+        .a-card { forced-color-adjust: none; background: Highlight; }
+        .b-card { forced-color-adjust: none; background: Highlight; color: HighlightText; }
+        .c-card { forced-color-adjust: none; }
+        .c-card > * { forced-color-adjust: auto; }
+        .d-card { forced-color-adjust: none; background: Canvas; }
+        .d-card { color: CanvasText; }
+        .e-card { forced-color-adjust: none; color: red; }
+      }`;
+    expect(findUnsafe(css)).toEqual(['.a-card', '.e-card']);
+  });
+
+  it('finds none in the stylesheet of preferences', () => {
+    const css = readFileSync('src/styles/preferences.css', 'utf8');
+    expect(rulesOf(css).some((rule) => /forced-color-adjust:\s*none/.test(rule.body))).toBe(true);
+    expect(findUnsafe(css)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the leaves it names in the stylesheet, so a renamed class is not left behind', () => {
+    const css = readFileSync('src/styles/preferences.css', 'utf8');
+    const named = rulesOf(css).flatMap((rule) => parts(rule.selector));
+    for (const leaf of [...Object.keys(LEAVES), ...Object.keys(SUBTREE)]) {
+      expect(named, leaf).toContain(leaf);
+    }
+  });
+});
```

Phát hiện khi lập Plan F: chốt một ô ở `batch` chỉ ghi thay đổi (giá trị gõ lại về giá trị đã lưu thì không còn thay đổi và dấu mất); đánh dấu xoá không hỏi, dòng chờ xoá không sửa được, Hoàn tác trả dòng với các sửa nó đã có; "Lưu thay đổi" (`handle.saveChanges()`) chốt ô đang sửa, kiểm mọi trường sửa được của mọi dòng có thay đổi (dòng mới: mọi trường; dòng chờ xoá không kiểm), lỗi thì thông báo `announceErrors(n)` (n là số trường của mọi dòng), mở trình sửa của trường lỗi đầu tiên và không gửi; không lỗi thì một `onSaving` với mọi thay đổi. Phát hiện khi lập Plan F: kiểu của `editing.popup` là `DataGridPopup` (xuất cùng các kiểu khác); `size` ngoài `sm`, `md`, `lg` thì dùng `lg`; `popup` được giữ theo giá trị, một cấp (đổi `size` của một object viết trong JSX là một thay đổi, một object viết lại giống hệt thì không). Popup mở bằng Sửa, `Enter`/`F2` trên một ô (focus vào trường của cột đó nếu sửa được, không thì trường sửa được đầu tiên, y như form) và `addRow()` (tiêu đề `labels.newRowTitle`); `closeOnOutsideClick={false}`; một Dialog cho cả grid, vẽ sau `<table>`. Dòng đang sửa vẫn là một dòng thường trong bảng (một dòng mới vẫn được vẽ như ở các chế độ khác, và bị bỏ khi Huỷ). Lưu như form (kiểm mọi trường, trường sai nhận focus, `fieldErrors` ở dưới trường), đang chờ Promise thì Dialog ở lại với nút Lưu `loading`, resolve thì đóng, reject thì ở lại với alert. Focus: Dialog trả về phần tử đã có focus lúc mở (ô hay nút Sửa); khi phần tử đó không còn (dòng mới đã lưu) và focus ở `<body>` thì grid đưa nó về ô hoạt động. Khi Dialog mở toàn màn hình trên điện thoại (`fullScreenOnPhone` bật và truy vấn điện thoại của chính Dialog, cùng ngưỡng 640px với CSS của nó, đang khớp lúc mở) thì focus đầu tiên vào tiêu đề (`tabIndex={-1}`, một phần tử tĩnh ở đầu như WAI-ARIA APG khuyên khi nội dung dài), không vào trường, vì một trường có focus sẽ bật bàn phím che nửa form; `Tab` rồi tới trường đầu tiên; dòng mới cũng vậy; rộng hơn thì không đổi (phát hiện khi lập Plan F). `addRow()` mở Dialog với grid như cũ: dòng mới không được cuộn vào cửa sổ của grid ảo và vị trí của bàn phím không dời sang nó, nên sau Huỷ cuộn và ô hoạt động y như trước (phát hiện khi lập Plan F). Popup đóng hẳn khi dòng của nó không còn trong các dòng đang hiện, khi `editing` tắt hay đổi chế độ, và khi grid gỡ; không gì được gửi. `saveChanges()` ở `form` và `popup` lưu form hay Dialog đang mở như nút Lưu (`save()`, đúng một hàm của `row`: kiểm mọi trường, trường sai đầu tiên nhận focus, `fieldErrors` ở dưới trường, đang chờ Promise thì như Lưu) và trả `true` khi dòng đã đi qua (hay khi không có form nào mở, hay form không có thay đổi và đóng), `false` khi một luật sai, một lần lưu đang chờ, hoặc `onSaving` từ chối (phát hiện khi lập Plan F); `cancelChanges()` đóng chúng.

+### Popup mode
+
+`mode: 'popup'` edits a row in a Dialog over the grid. Edit (always drawn in this mode, with Delete),
+
+<Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> on a cell of the row, and `addRow()` open it. It is one
+Dialog for the grid, drawn after the table, and **the row stays in the table as it is**: no editor
+opens in it and its buttons are the same as before. The fields, the title
+(`labels.editRowTitle(name)`, `labels.newRowTitle`), the line `labels.requiredHint` (the Dialog's
+description, when a field is required), the checks, `onSaving` and the errors are those of the form
+(see Form mode); the buttons are Cancel (`labels.cancelButton`) and Save (`labels.saveButton`, which
+loads while the save is pending), at the end of the Dialog's footer.
+
+`editing.popup` sets the Dialog:
+
+| `popup` field       | Does                                                                                                              |
+| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `size`              | `'sm'` (360px), `'md'` (480px) or `'lg'` (640px, default): the width of the panel                                 |
+| `movable`           | `false` (default) or `true`: the Dialog is dragged by its header on screens 640px and wider                       |
+| `fullScreenOnPhone` | `true` (default) or `false`: below 640px the Dialog fills the screen, with Cancel and Save sharing the bottom row |
+
+- **Not movable by default.** The approved look has a header with no grip, and a field that is typed in is no place
+  for a Dialog that moves under a stray drag. `movable: true` is the library's movable Dialog (the grip, the keys of
+  the Dialog stay as they are).
+- **Full screen on phones.** Below 640px the panel is the window, with no margin and no corners, and the fields are
+  one column (two from 480px of the Dialog's own width). `fullScreenOnPhone: false` keeps the centred panel on a phone.
+- **Keys.** The field of the cell that <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> was pressed on has the focus when
+  it opens, when that column can be edited; else the first field that can be (Edit and a new row start there). **On a
+  phone, when the Dialog opens full screen, the focus starts on the title instead**, so the keyboard of the phone does
+  not cover half the form; <Kbd keys="tab" /> then reaches the first field. <Kbd keys="tab" /> stays inside the Dialog;
+  <Kbd keys="enter" /> in a field submits it, which saves (not in a Textarea, nor from a list that
+  is open);
+  <Kbd keys="esc" /> gives it up, a list or a calendar that is open taking the first one. **A press
+  outside the panel does not close it** (`closeOnOutsideClick` is off), so a stray press loses
+  nothing.
+- **Saving** is the form's: every field is checked (the first that fails has the focus, under its error), and one
+  `onSaving` gets one `update`, or one `insert` for a new row. A pending save keeps the Dialog open, with Save
+  loading; it closes when the Promise resolves. A refusal keeps it open with the alert, and what `fieldErrors` names
+  goes under that field.
+- **The focus** goes back to what had it when the Dialog opened (the cell, or Edit). A new row that was saved has no
+  cell to go back to, and then the focus goes to the place of the grid: never to the page.
+- **It goes for good** when its row is no longer among the rows shown, when `editing` turns off or changes its mode,
+  and when the grid unmounts; nothing is sent. A new row is a row of the grid, drawn as in the other modes
+  while its Dialog is open (a virtual grid does not scroll to it), and dropped by Cancel.
+

 ## Props
 
-| Prop                     | Type                                                                                                  | Default      | Does                                                                                      |
-| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
-| `data`                   | `readonly TRow[]`                                                                                     |              | The rows                                                                                  |
-| `rowKey`                 | `keyof TRow` or `(row) => string \| number`                                                           |              | What a row is known by                                                                    |
-| `columns`                | `readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[]`                                                                     |              | The columns; a stable array                                                               |
-| `caption`                | `ReactNode`                                                                                           |              | The title and the name                                                                    |
-| `description`            | `ReactNode`                                                                                           |              | What the grid is about                                                                    |
-| `captionAs`              | `'h2'` to `'h6'` or `'div'`                                                                           | `'h3'`       | The element of the caption                                                                |
-| `toolbar`                | `false \| (items) => ReactNode`                                                                       |              | `false` keeps the caption only; a function places the items                               |
-| `variant`                | `'lined' \| 'striped' \| 'minimal'`                                                                   | `'lined'`    | The look of a Table                                                                       |
-| `density`                | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`                                                            | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                                                       |
-| `rowHeight`              | `number`                                                                                              |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's                                           |
-| `locale`                 | `string`                                                                                              | `'en-US'`    | The language of numbers and dates (see below)                                             |
-| `timeZone`               | `string`                                                                                              | `'UTC'`      | The zone a `datetime` is shown in                                                         |
-| `height`                 | `number \| string`                                                                                    |              | The height of the grid; with it the heading sticks                                        |
-| `scrolling`              | `'standard' \| 'virtual'`                                                                             | `'standard'` | `'virtual'` draws only the rows near the view                                             |
-| `loading`                | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | Skeleton rows with no row, a layer over the rows                                          |
-| `rowClassName`           | `(row) => string \| undefined`                                                                        |              | A class for a row; a stable function                                                      |
-| `allowSorting`           | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowSorting`                                              |
-| `allowResizing`          | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowResizing`                                             |
-| `allowReordering`        | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowReordering`                                           |
-| `allowPinning`           | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowPinning`                                              |
-| `allowHiding`            | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHiding`                                               |
-| `sortMode`               | `'single' \| 'multiple'`                                                                              | `'multiple'` | Whether a press with a modifier adds a level                                              |
-| `sort`                   | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`                                                                         |              | The sort, in order (controlled)                                                           |
-| `defaultSort`            | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`                                                                         |              | The sort at first                                                                         |
-| `onSortChange`           | `(sort) => void`                                                                                      |              | Called with the sort a press asks for                                                     |
-| `filter`                 | `DataGridFilter`                                                                                      |              | The search and the conditions of the columns (controlled)                                 |
-| `defaultFilter`          | `DataGridFilter`                                                                                      |              | The filter at first                                                                       |
-| `onFilterChange`         | `(filter) => void`                                                                                    |              | Called with the filter a change asks for                                                  |
-| `paging`                 | `false \| { pageSize?, pageSizes? }`                                                                  | see above    | A page's size at first, and the sizes offered                                             |
-| `page`                   | `DataGridPage`                                                                                        |              | The page, from 0 (controlled)                                                             |
-| `defaultPage`            | `DataGridPage`                                                                                        |              | The page at first                                                                         |

-| `onStateChange`          | `(state, changed) => void`                                                                            |              | The whole state and the part that changed, after any callback of a part of it             |

-| `columnChooser`          | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | A toolbar button that shows and hides the columns                                         |
-| `searchPanel`            | `boolean \| { placeholder?: string }`                                                                 | `false`      | A search field in the toolbar; see Search                                                 |
-| `groupPanel`             | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | A tray of chips in the toolbar, and a way to drag a title in; see The group panel         |
-| `filterRow`              | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | A row of filter cells under the titles; see The filter row                                |
-| `allowFiltering`         | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowFiltering`                                            |
-| `headerFilter`           | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | A funnel on the titles that list the values; see The header filter                        |
-| `allowHeaderFiltering`   | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHeaderFiltering`                                      |
-| `filterPanel`            | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | A bar that says the conditions, with Clear and Apply; see The filter panel                |

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditPopup.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditPopup.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4ea46e7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/EditPopup.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
+import { getFocusables } from '../../../internal/focus';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import {
+  Dialog,
+  DialogContent,
+  DialogDescription,
+  DialogFooter,
+  DialogHeader,
+  DialogTitle,
+} from '../../dialog/Dialog';
+import type { DialogSize } from '../../dialog/Dialog';
+import { DIALOG_WIDE_QUERY } from '../../dialog/use-movable';
+import { useEditContext } from '../edit-context';
+import type { EditTarget } from '../edit-context';
+import { canEdit } from '../engine/edit';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import { isRequired } from '../engine/validate';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { EditFields } from './EditFields';
+
+const SIZES: readonly DialogSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
+
+/** The field of a column in the popup, and the first control in it. */
+function controlOf(form: HTMLElement | null, column: string): HTMLElement | undefined {
+  const field = Array.from(form?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-column]') ?? []).find(
+    (one) => one.getAttribute('data-column') === column,
+  );
+  return field ? getFocusables(field)[0] : undefined;
+}
+
+interface PopupContentProps<TRow> {
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow>;
+  editing: EditTarget;
+  /** What `DialogContent` gives the focus to when it opens: this part sets it, before the Dialog reads it. */
+  initial: { current: HTMLElement | null };
+  /** `editing.popup.fullScreenOnPhone`: the Dialog fills the screen where the Dialog's own query says it is a phone. */
+  fullScreenOnPhone: boolean;
+}
+
+/** What the Dialog holds while it is open: its title, the fields and the buttons. */
+function PopupContent<TRow>({
+  flat,
+  editing,
+  initial,
+  fullScreenOnPhone,
+}: PopupContentProps<TRow>) {
+  const { labels, rowHeader, textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>()!;
+  const formId = useId();
+  const form = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
+  const title = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
+  const { fields } = edit;
+  const added = flat.added === true;
+  // The row is named by the text of the row header, whether that column is drawn or not; its key when there is none.
+  const text = rowHeader ? textOf(flat.row, rowHeader) : '';
+  const name = text === '' ? String(flat.key) : text;
+  const required = fields.some(
+    (column) => isRequired(column) && canEdit(column, flat.row, edit.config, added),
+  );
+  // The Dialog reads `initialFocus` in its own layout effect, which runs after this one: the field the edit was started
+  // on, else the first that can be edited. Full screen on a phone, where a field with the focus brings up the keyboard
+  // over half the form, it is the title (a static element at the top, WAI-ARIA APG), and Tab reaches the first field.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const phone =
+      fullScreenOnPhone &&
+      typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' &&
+      !window.matchMedia(DIALOG_WIDE_QUERY).matches;
+    if (phone) {
+      initial.current = title.current;
+      return;
+    }
+    const own = editing.focus === null ? undefined : fields.find((one) => one.id === editing.focus);
+    const column =
+      own && canEdit(own, flat.row, edit.config, added)
+        ? own
+        : fields.find((one) => canEdit(one, flat.row, edit.config, added));
+    initial.current = (column ? controlOf(form.current, column.id) : undefined) ?? null;
+    // Once, when the popup appears: a later render never takes the focus back.
+  }, []);
+  // A save that found a field wrong asks for the focus there.
+  const ask = editing.refocus;
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    if (ask === null) return;
+    controlOf(form.current, ask.column)?.focus();
+  }, [ask]);
+  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    edit.save();
+  };
+  return (
+    <>
+      <DialogHeader>
+        {/* Focusable by script only, for the phone's first focus; a heading nobody operates draws no ring. */}
+        <DialogTitle ref={title} tabIndex={-1} className="flg-data-grid-popup-title">
+          {added ? labels.newRowTitle : labels.editRowTitle(name)}
+        </DialogTitle>
+        {required ? <DialogDescription>{labels.requiredHint}</DialogDescription> : null}
+      </DialogHeader>
+      {/* The form is the fields only, so the footer stays a child of the panel (the phone's footer sticks to its bottom); Save
+          belongs to it by `form`, and `Enter` in a field submits it. */}
+      <form
+        ref={form}
+        id={formId}
+        noValidate
+        className="flg-data-grid-popup-form"
+        onSubmit={onSubmit}
+      >
+        <EditFields
+          row={flat.row}
+          columns={fields}
+          errors={editing.errors}
+          size="md"
+          saving={editing.saving}
+          added={added}
+        />
+      </form>
+      <DialogFooter>
+        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={() => edit.cancel()}>
+          {labels.cancelButton}
+        </Button>
+        <Button type="submit" form={formId} variant="primary" loading={editing.saving}>
+          {labels.saveButton}
+        </Button>
+      </DialogFooter>
+    </>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The popup of `popup` mode (spec phase 6 §4.3 EF1 "Popup", §6.3): one Dialog for the grid, after the table, which holds
+ * the fields of the row being edited (`EditFields`) under a title and, when a field is required, the hint. The row
+ * stays in the table as it is. The Dialog is `lg` and neither movable nor full screen unless `editing.popup` says so
+ * below 640px; a press outside does not close it, so a stray press does not lose what was typed. Esc and Cancel give the
+ * edit up, Save checks every field and sends it, and while a save is pending the Dialog stays. It goes for good when its
+ * row is no longer among the rows shown, and with the feature (the grid does not render it then). The Dialog gives the
+ * focus back to what had it when it opened (the cell, or Edit); when that is gone, which a new row's popup comes to,
+ * the focus goes to the place of the grid, never `<body>`.
+ */
+export function EditPopup<TRow>({
+  editing,
+  flat,
+  restoreFocus,
+}: {
+  /** The row being edited; `null` while the popup is closed. */
+  editing: EditTarget | null;
+  /** The row of that key among the rows shown; `undefined` when it is not there. */
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow> | undefined;
+  /** Gives the focus to the place of the grid. */
+  restoreFocus: () => void;
+}) {
+  const edit = useEditContext<TRow>()!;
+  const initial = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
+  const open = editing !== null && flat !== undefined;
+  // A row that went while it was edited: the popup is closed for good.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (editing !== null && flat === undefined) edit.cancel();
+  }, [editing, flat, edit]);
+  // Once, when it goes from open to closed: after the Dialog has given the focus back.
+  const wasOpen = useRef(false);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (open) {
+      wasOpen.current = true;
+    } else if (wasOpen.current) {
+      wasOpen.current = false;
+      const active = document.activeElement;
+      if (active === null || active === document.body) restoreFocus();
+    }
+  }, [open, restoreFocus]);
+  const given = edit.config.popup;
+  const size = SIZES.find((one) => one === given?.size) ?? 'lg';
+  const fullScreenOnPhone = given?.fullScreenOnPhone !== false;
+  return (
+    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(next) => !next && edit.cancel()}>
+      <DialogContent
+        size={size}
+        movable={given?.movable === true}
+        fullScreenOnPhone={fullScreenOnPhone}
+        closeOnOutsideClick={false}
+        initialFocus={initial}
+      >
+        {open ? (
+          <PopupContent
+            flat={flat}
+            editing={editing}
+            initial={initial}
+            fullScreenOnPhone={fullScreenOnPhone}
+          />
+        ) : null}
+      </DialogContent>
+    </Dialog>
+  );
+}

 /** What a row is known by: a string or a number, as the `key` of a React element. */

+export type DataGridEditMode = 'row' | 'cell' | 'batch' | 'form' | 'popup';

Nếu CI visual báo một ảnh cũ đổi, dừng và báo: đó là lỗi của plan. Xem ảnh trước khi xin review:
  - `DialogFullScreenPhone` (390×844) khớp điện thoại của EF1 (b): "Edit order DH-1028", gợi ý bắt buộc, các trường một cột với nhãn trên, Huỷ và Lưu chia hàng đáy, Customer có focus, panel phủ màn hình (không viền, không bo góc).
  - `EditRow` (1440×720) khớp E2 (a): DH-1028 ở chế độ `row`, các ô sửa được là trình sửa (Customer có focus với khung 2px và vầng 18%, một DatePicker, một Select, một NumberInput; Order và Total là chữ), ✓ và ✕ cách 4px; DH-1029 được hover (`data-visual-hover`) hiện Sửa và Xoá cách 2px.

  - `EditCellError` khớp E2 (b) phải: DH-1026 · Customer bị xoá trống và đã nhấn `Enter`: khung danger, icon cuối trình sửa, tooltip lỗi dưới ô, mở khi ô có focus, kết thúc trong stage.
  - `EditBatch` (1440×720) khớp E2 (c): thanh lưu "3 unsaved changes" nối vào đầu khung (khung vuông hai góc trên), Discard changes và Save changes; dòng mới đầu bảng "+ (new)" với "—" ở Total; DH-1027 chờ xoá (dải đỏ, chữ muted gạch ngang cả Badge, ô nút không gạch, Hoàn tác); hai ô đã sửa của DH-1028 (Order date, Status) với dải và khung nét đứt; không ô nào có khung focus, DH-1028 không hiện nút Xoá (F11).
